name.description: A unique name for the recipe.

displayName.description: A display name for the recipe.

website.description: The website URL associated with the recipe.

isSetupRecipe.description: Whether this recipe is a setup recipe.

exportUtc.description: The UTC date/time when the recipe was exported.

requireNewScope.description: Whether the recipe requires a new scope.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier. When supplied and found, the existing connection is updated.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable name shown for the A2A connection in the admin UI.

Endpoint.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS endpoint of the remote A2A server.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp to preserve when importing exported records.

ModifiedUtc.description: Optional last-modified timestamp to preserve when importing exported records.

Author.description: Optional author name recorded with the connection.

Properties.description: Connection metadata grouped by metadata object name. Known built-in metadata currently lives under A2AConnectionMetadata, and extra objects are allowed for future extensions.

A2AConnectionMetadata.description: Known A2A client authentication settings stored for the connection. Additional properties are allowed for future A2A transport extensions.

AuthenticationType.description: How the A2A client authenticates to the remote endpoint.

ApiKeyHeaderName.description: Header name that carries the API key when AuthenticationType is ApiKey.

ApiKeyPrefix.description: Optional prefix placed before the API key value, such as 'Bearer' or a vendor-specific prefix.

ApiKey.description: API key secret. Recipe exports may sanitize this value, so imports can leave it empty to keep an existing stored secret.

BasicUsername.description: Username used when AuthenticationType is Basic.

BasicPassword.description: Password used when AuthenticationType is Basic. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

OAuth2TokenEndpoint.description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint used by client-credentials, private-key JWT, or mutual-TLS authentication.

OAuth2ClientSecret.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret for client-credentials authentication. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

OAuth2KeyId.description: Optional key identifier used when AuthenticationType is OAuth2PrivateKeyJwt.

OAuth2PrivateKey.description: Private key material used for OAuth2PrivateKeyJwt. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

OAuth2ClientCertificate.description: Client certificate payload used for OAuth2Mtls. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

OAuth2ClientCertificatePassword.description: Password for the client certificate when AuthenticationType is OAuth2Mtls. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

AdditionalHeaders.description: Additional HTTP headers sent with each request when AuthenticationType is CustomHeaders.

Connections.description: The A2A connections to create or update.

ContentItemId.description: The content item id, which stays the same across sites.

ContentType.description: The content type.

DisplayText.description: The item's title.

Latest.description: Whether this is the latest version of the item.

items.description: An account: a content item with AccountPart, and the parts other modules add to it, such as AccountMembersPart, AccountLocationsPart and B2BAccountPart.

Accounts.description: The accounts to create or update. An account with an existing ContentItemId is updated. An item without AccountPart is refused.

ContentItemId.description: The content item id, which stays the same across sites.

ContentType.description: The content type.

DisplayText.description: The item's title.

Latest.description: Whether this is the latest version of the item.

items.description: A record an account holds, such as a contact or an opportunity. Its ContainedPart names the account.

Records.description: The records the accounts hold, imported after the accounts.

Id.description: A stable unique identifier for the admin menu. When omitted, one is generated when the recipe runs.

Name.description: The admin menu name shown in the admin menus list.

Enabled.description: Whether the admin menu is active. Defaults to true.

$type.description: The polymorphic admin menu node type discriminator, for example OrchardCore.AdminMenu.AdminNodes.LinkAdminNode, OrchardCore.AdminMenu. Required so the node deserializes correctly.

UniqueId.description: A stable unique identifier for the node. When omitted, one is generated when the recipe runs.

Enabled.description: Whether the node is active. Defaults to true.

MenuName.description: The name of the admin menu the node belongs to. Populated automatically when the recipe runs.

Position.description: The relative position of the node among its siblings, for example '10' or 'after'.

Priority.description: The priority used to resolve which node is marked as selected when several match the request.

LinkToFirstChild.description: Whether the node links to the same URL as its first child.

LocalNav.description: Whether the node is local to the page, such as a tab.

Culture.description: The culture for which the node is shown. Leave null to show it for every culture.

Classes.description: The CSS classes rendered with the node.

MenuName.description: The name of the admin menu the node belongs to. Populated automatically when the recipe runs.

Position.description: The relative position of the node among its siblings, for example '10' or 'after'.

Priority.description: The priority used to resolve which node is marked as selected when several match the request.

LinkToFirstChild.description: Whether the node links to the same URL as its first child.

LocalNav.description: Whether the node is local to the page, such as a tab.

Culture.description: The culture for which the node is shown. Leave null to show it for every culture.

Classes.description: The CSS classes rendered with the node.

ContentTypes.description: The explicit list of content types to add when ShowAll is false.

data.description: The admin menus to create or update.

Description.description: Administrative description of what the template customizes.

AdminTemplates.description: A dictionary keyed by template name. Each value has a Content property with Liquid markup.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the reason code. When it matches a stored reason code, that reason code is updated. Otherwise a new reason code is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique reason code name shown to agents and supervisors.

AppliesTo.description: Presence state an agent enters when they select this reason code.

SortOrder.description: Relative order the reason code is listed in, lowest first.

Enabled.description: Whether the reason code can be selected by agents.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the reason code, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

ReasonCodes.description: The agent state reason codes to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier. When supplied and found, the existing data source is updated.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable name for the data source.

Source.description: Optional data source type. When omitted, the import defaults to SearchIndexProfile for backward compatibility.

SourceIndexProfileName.description: Index profile that provides the raw source documents to ingest.

AIKnowledgeBaseIndexProfileName.description: Knowledge-base index profile that stores the normalized AI-ready documents.

KeyFieldName.description: Field name that uniquely identifies each source record.

TitleFieldName.description: Field name that contains the record title or summary label.

ContentFieldName.description: Field name that contains the main textual content used for AI retrieval.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp to preserve during import.

ModifiedUtc.description: Optional last-modified timestamp to preserve during import.

Author.description: Optional author name recorded with the data source.

Properties.description: Additional provider-specific data source metadata. No built-in metadata objects are currently exported here, but extra keys are allowed for future extensions.

DataSources.description: The AI data sources to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the deployment. When it matches a stored deployment, that deployment is updated; otherwise the deployment is matched by Name and ClientName, and a new one is created under this identifier.

Name.description: Deployment name as specified by the vendor. With ClientName, identifies the deployment when no ItemId matches.

ModelName.description: Optional vendor model name. Defaults to Name when omitted.

ClientName.description: Client name for the registered AI provider.

ProviderName.description: Legacy alias of ClientName, read when ClientName is missing.

ConnectionName.description: Name of the provider connection the deployment uses. Required unless the provider keeps its connection in the deployment (AzureSpeech, ElevenLabs, Cartesia, CascadedRealtime).

Endpoint.description: Alias copied to Properties.Endpoint: the contained-connection endpoint of AzureSpeech, ElevenLabs and Cartesia deployments.

AuthenticationType.description: Alias copied to Properties.AuthenticationType. Supported by AzureSpeech deployments.

ApiKey.description: Alias copied as given to Properties.ApiKey. It must be the protected value (see Properties.ApiKey); a key in clear text does not work.

IdentityId.description: Alias copied to Properties.IdentityId: the managed identity client ID of an AzureSpeech deployment.

Endpoint.description: Contained-connection endpoint. Required by AzureSpeech deployments; an optional absolute address that replaces the provider's default for ElevenLabs and Cartesia deployments.

AuthenticationType.description: Azure authentication type of an AzureSpeech deployment. Supported values are Default, ManagedIdentity, or ApiKey.

ApiKey.description: Contained-connection API key (AzureSpeech, ElevenLabs and Cartesia deployments), stored protected with the 'AIProviderConnection' data protection purpose. The value is read as a protected value when the deployment is used, so a key in clear text does not work: keep the protected value an exported plan carries (it only decrypts on a site that shares the exporting site's data protection keys), or leave it out and enter the key on the deployment in the admin.

IdentityId.description: Optional client ID of a user-assigned managed identity. Used when AuthenticationType is ManagedIdentity.

items.description: Technical name of a registered model feature the underlying model was trained with, for example textGeneration, toolCalling, reasoning, imageInput, audioInput, or realtime.

Features.description: Technical names of the trained model features this deployment supports. Only declared features are offered in editors and sent to the provider.

AllowedValues.description: Subset of the registered allowed values this deployment supports. Omit or leave empty to support every registered value.

DefaultValue.description: Value applied when an operator does not select one.

Minimum.description: Inclusive minimum accepted value for numeric parameters.

Maximum.description: Inclusive maximum accepted value for numeric parameters.

Step.description: Increment applied by numeric editors.

additionalProperties.description: Per-deployment narrowing of a registered model parameter.

Parameters.description: Supported model parameters keyed by their registered technical name (for example reasoningEffort). A parameter that is not present is not exposed by the deployment.

AIDeploymentMetadata.description: Declared model capabilities for the deployment: the trained features it supports and the configurable model parameters it exposes.

SpeechToTextDeploymentName.description: Technical name of the deployment that transcribes the user's speech. Must expose a realtime client.

ChatDeploymentName.description: Technical name of the chat deployment that generates the reply.

TextToSpeechDeploymentName.description: Technical name of the deployment that speaks the reply.

CascadedRealtimeMetadata.description: Set on a deployment created under the CascadedRealtime client to chain a speech-to-text, a chat, and a text-to-speech deployment into one realtime deployment.

Currency.description: The ISO currency code the prices are in, such as USD. Defaults to USD.

Meter.description: The billed unit. Cached, cache-write, audio, and image tokens are taken out of the input and output tokens when they have their own price.

Amount.description: What Per units cost, in the pricing's currency.

Per.description: How many of the meter's base units Amount pays for, such as 1000000 for a price per million tokens, or 60 for a price per minute of audio (AudioSeconds).

CountName.description: For the AdditionalCount meter: the name of the count the provider reports, as shown in the usage report.

AboveInputTokens.description: Long-context price: applies instead of the meter's regular price to requests with more input tokens than this.

Increment.description: Rounds each request's quantity up to a multiple of this many base units, such as 15 for audio billed in 15-second increments. 0 bills the exact quantity.

Prices.description: The prices, one per billed unit. Several prices for the same meter add up.

AIDeploymentPricing.description: What the deployment costs with its provider. Read only when the deployment carries no top-level Pricing; prefer Pricing.

Properties.description: Contained provider connection properties stored directly on the deployment.

Currency.description: The ISO currency code the prices are in, such as USD. Defaults to USD.

Meter.description: The billed unit. Cached, cache-write, audio, and image tokens are taken out of the input and output tokens when they have their own price.

Amount.description: What Per units cost, in the pricing's currency.

Per.description: How many of the meter's base units Amount pays for, such as 1000000 for a price per million tokens, or 60 for a price per minute of audio (AudioSeconds).

CountName.description: For the AdditionalCount meter: the name of the count the provider reports, as shown in the usage report.

AboveInputTokens.description: Long-context price: applies instead of the meter's regular price to requests with more input tokens than this.

Increment.description: Rounds each request's quantity up to a multiple of this many base units, such as 15 for audio billed in 15-second increments. 0 bills the exact quantity.

Prices.description: The prices, one per billed unit. Several prices for the same meter add up.

anyOf.description: What the deployment costs with its provider.

Pricing.description: What the deployment costs with its provider, used to estimate the cost of its usage in the AI usage reports. Leave it out to keep the deployment's current prices.

anyOf.description: Legacy. Declare the model's capabilities under Properties.AIDeploymentMetadata instead. A deployment that names neither is imported as a text chat deployment.

items.description: Legacy deployment purpose identifier, projected onto model capabilities on import.

anyOf.description: Legacy deployment purposes, projected onto model capabilities on import.

Deployments.description: The AI deployments to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier. When supplied and found, the existing persona is updated.

Name.description: Unique technical name. AI profiles, profile templates and chat interactions link to the persona by this name, so it cannot change once created. A persona with the same name is updated.

DisplayText.description: How the persona is shown in editors.

Description.description: Helps editors choose the right persona.

Instructions.description: Liquid persona instructions placed first in the system message of every profile or interaction that links to the persona. Required.

AssistantName.description: The name the assistant uses for itself. The model is told its name, and chat screens show it on assistant messages.

Language.description: BCP-47 language tag, such as en-US, used as the speech language when nothing else sets one.

VoiceName.description: Provider-specific voice the persona speaks with.

VoiceDeploymentName.description: Deployment the voice was chosen from. The voice is only used on deployments of the same provider.

AvatarUrl.description: Optional avatar image URL shown next to assistant messages.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp to preserve during import.

Author.description: Optional author name recorded with the persona.

Properties.description: Additional properties stored with the persona.

personas.description: The AI personas to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier. If provided, used to find existing profile to update.

Source.description: The AI provider source name (e.g., OpenAI, Azure, Ollama). Required for new profiles.

Name.description: Unique technical name for the profile.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable display name.

TitleType.description: How the session title is generated.

PersonaId.description: Optional technical name of the AI persona this profile links to. An empty value unlinks the persona, and leaving the key out keeps the current link.

ConnectionName.description: Optional name of the provider connection the profile uses.

ChatDeploymentName.description: Chat deployment technical name for the AI model.

UtilityDeploymentName.description: Utility deployment technical name for the AI model.

SystemMessage.description: Shortcut for Properties.AIProfileMetadata.SystemMessage. Ignored when the profile's system message is locked.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

Properties.description: Extended profile properties. Known metadata objects are listed here, and additional feature-specific objects are also allowed.

AgentMetadata.description: Known agent metadata for agent profiles.

Availability.description: Controls whether the agent is only available when selected or always injected into orchestration.

AllowToolInvocation.description: When true, the agent runs its own selected tools when another assistant calls it. When false or missing, it runs without tools.

AIProfileMetadata.description: Known prompt and model tuning metadata for the profile.

InitialPrompt.description: Optional initial prompt automatically injected for chat profiles.

SystemMessage.description: The system instructions for the profile.

PastMessagesCount.description: Number of prior chat messages to include in context.

UseCaching.description: Whether distributed caching is enabled for the profile when the tenant allows it.

FunctionInvocationMetadata.description: Known tool selection metadata for the profile.

Names.description: Tool names that can be invoked by this profile.

AgentInvocationMetadata.description: Known on-demand agent selections for the profile.

Names.description: Agent profile names that can be invoked by this profile.

PromptTemplateMetadata.description: Known prompt template selections applied before or alongside the system message.

Parameters.description: Template parameter values. Keys are parameter names and values are strings.

Templates.description: Ordered prompt template selections for the profile.

AIPersonaMetadata.description: The AI persona this resource links to, by the persona's technical name. Applied when the AI Personas feature is enabled.

PersonaId.description: Technical name of the linked persona.

Parameters.description: Liquid arguments used when rendering the persona instructions.

AnalyticsMetadata.description: Known analytics and outcome tracking metadata for chat profiles.

Name.description: Unique goal key.

Description.description: Goal description used for scoring guidance.

ConversionGoals.description: Configured conversion goals for chat analytics.

DataSourceMetadata.description: Known external data source selection for retrieval augmentation.

DataSourceId.description: Identifier of the selected AI data source.

AIDataSourceRagMetadata.description: Known retrieval augmentation parameters for an attached AI data source.

IsInScope.description: Whether answers must stay within the retrieved documents.

Filter.description: Optional OData filter applied to retrieved data.

ObjectTypes.description: Optional object types (for example content types) the retrieved documents are limited to. Empty searches every type.

AIProfileSessionDocumentsMetadata.description: Known session upload capabilities for the profile.

DocumentsMetadata.description: Known profile document attachments and retrieval behavior.

ContentType.description: Document MIME type.

Documents.description: Documents explicitly attached to the profile.

DocumentTopN.description: How many top document matches to include.

MaxIndexableCharacters.description: Optional limit on the characters of a document that are indexed. Null uses the site default.

DescribeFiguresInUploads.description: Whether figures in uploaded documents are described by an AI model while indexing. Null uses the site default.

MemoryMetadata.description: Known AI memory configuration for the profile.

EnableUserMemory.description: Whether user memory is enabled for the profile. Null uses the site default.

EnableSessionMemory.description: Whether the profile keeps a memory of the current session. Null uses the site default.

EnablePastConversations.description: Whether the profile may recall the user's past conversations. Null uses the site default.

ClaudeSessionMetadata.description: Known Claude orchestrator overrides when the AI Claude Orchestrator feature is enabled.

ClaudeModel.description: Claude model override for this profile.

CopilotSessionMetadata.description: Known Copilot orchestrator overrides when the AI Copilot Orchestrator feature is enabled.

CopilotModel.description: Copilot model override for this profile.

IsAllowAll.description: Whether Copilot should run with the allow-all flag.

AIDeploymentParametersMetadata.description: Values of the model parameters the profile's deployments expose (for example reasoningEffort), keyed by the parameter's technical name.

Values.description: Parameter values sent with requests to the chat deployment.

UtilityValues.description: Parameter values sent with requests to the utility deployment.

AIProfileMcpMetadata.description: Known MCP connection selections for this profile.

ToolNames.description: Per connection identifier, the names of the tools the profile may use from it. A connection with no entry, or a null entry, exposes every tool; an empty array exposes none.

AIProfileA2AMetadata.description: Known A2A connection selections for this profile.

Settings.description: Profile settings. Known settings objects are listed here, and additional feature-specific settings are also allowed.

LockSystemMessage.description: Prevents recipe or editor updates from changing the system message.

IsListable.description: Whether the profile is listed in the admin UI. Defaults to true.

IsRemovable.description: Controls whether the profile can be deleted from the admin UI.

InitialResponseHandlerName.description: Initial non-AI response handler to invoke before the main orchestrator.

IsOnAdminMenu.description: Whether the chat profile appears on the Orchard admin menu.

EnableDataExtraction.description: Enables extracting structured values from chat sessions.

ExtractionCheckInterval.description: How often data extraction runs during the session.

SessionInactivityTimeoutInMinutes.description: How long the session must be inactive before final extraction runs.

Name.description: Unique extraction key.

AllowMultipleValues.description: Whether multiple values can be captured.

IsUpdatable.description: Whether later session turns can update the extracted value.

FieldType.description: The type of the extracted value. Enum and List values are limited to AllowedValues.

AllowedValues.description: The values an Enum or List field may take.

ToolInstanceNames.description: Tool instances available to post-session processing.

Name.description: Unique task key.

Type.description: How the task result is generated.

AllowMultipleValues.description: Whether the task can return multiple values.

Value.description: Predefined option value.

Options.description: Predefined options used when Type is PredefinedOptions.

ToolInstanceNames.description: Tool instances the task may call.

PostSessionTasks.description: Tasks executed after the chat session closes.

ChatMode.description: Preferred input mode for this profile.

ConversationDeploymentName.description: Optional technical name of the speech-to-speech (realtime) deployment used in conversation mode. Leave empty to use the site default.

VoiceName.description: Optional speech synthesis voice for conversation mode.

EnableTextToSpeechPlayback.description: Whether assistant responses should be played back with text-to-speech.

AIProfileGuardrailSettings.description: Topic guardrails: what the assistant must not discuss, checked on the customer's messages, the replies, or both.

CheckCustomer.description: Whether the customer's messages are checked against the topics.

CheckReplies.description: Whether the assistant's replies are checked against the topics before they are sent.

Topics.description: Identifiers of the guardrail topics: System Prompt templates in the 'Guardrail topic' category.

OtherTopics.description: Other topics refused, described in a sentence or two, for this profile alone.

PlaceholderReply.description: What the assistant says instead when a guardrail triggers. Empty uses a default.

AIProfileDataPrivacySettings.description: What the profile's conversations keep once they end.

StorageMode.description: Everything keeps the transcript; RedactPersonalData removes personal data from it; MetadataOnly keeps only the conversation's metadata.

StorageModeSinceUtc.description: When the storage mode last changed (ISO 8601, UTC). Conversations active after it get the mode. Set by the admin when the mode changes.

RetentionDays.description: Days without activity after which a conversation is deleted. Null keeps conversations.

NamesToKeep.description: Names that are not personal data and are kept when personal data is redacted, such as the assistant's, the business's and its staff's names.

AIProfileSpeakingStyleSettings.description: The speaking styles the assistant follows.

Styles.description: Identifiers of System Prompt templates in the 'Speaking style' category, for example speaking-style-echo-verification, speaking-style-nato-spelling, speaking-style-speech-normalization, speaking-style-fuzzy-name-matching, speaking-style-ai-disclosure, speaking-style-scope-limits, speaking-style-filler-words or speaking-style-high-empathy.

AIProfileSpeechSettings.description: How the assistant speaks and listens in voice conversations.

SpeakingRate.description: How fast the profile speaks, as a multiple of the voice's normal pace (1 is normal), clamped to 0.25-4. Null uses the deployment's own pace.

SpeakingEmotion.description: Emotion the voice speaks with, as one word such as calm or excited, for providers with an emotion control (Cartesia). Others ignore it.

Text.description: The word or phrase to pronounce differently.

MatchCase.description: Whether Text matches only with the same letter case.

PronunciationEntries.description: Pronunciation replacements applied before text is spoken.

FallbackTextToSpeechDeploymentName.description: Technical name of the text-to-speech deployment used when the primary one fails.

BoostedKeywords.description: Words the speech recognizer is biased toward, such as product names.

RecognitionLanguages.description: Languages the recognizer should expect, as BCP-47 tags. The first is the primary language.

InterruptionSensitivity.description: How readily the caller's speech interrupts the assistant, from 0 (never interrupted) to 1 (any caller speech interrupts it). Null uses the default.

EnableBackchanneling.description: Whether the assistant says short acknowledgements while the caller speaks.

BackchannelPhrases.description: The acknowledgements used for backchanneling. Empty uses a small built-in set.

AIProfileLanguageSettings.description: The languages the assistant may speak.

AllowedLanguages.description: Languages the profile may converse in, as BCP-47 tags. Empty means no restriction.

StartingLanguage.description: BCP-47 tag of the language a conversation starts in. A conversation language set by the host (for example from a conversation variable) overrides it.

AIProfileFlowSettings.description: The conversation flow: a workflow whose AI conversation stages guide the conversation.

WorkflowTypeId.description: Identifier of the workflow type that starts with an AI Conversation Flow Started event and holds the stages. Empty turns the flow off.

Flexible.description: Whether every stage's instructions are given at once, so a caller who jumps between tasks is followed, rather than only the current stage's.

AIProfileContactMemorySettings.description: The memory the assistant keeps about each CRM contact.

UseMemory.description: Whether what is remembered about the contact is given to the assistant.

SaveMemory.description: Whether the memory is updated after each conversation.

AIProfileContactFieldMappingSettings.description: Copies extracted values onto the CRM contact when the conversation closes.

FieldName.description: Name of the data extraction entry the value comes from.

ContactField.description: The contact field the value is written to.

Mode.description: Whether the value replaces the field, fills it only when empty, or is appended to it.

Mappings.description: The mappings, one per extracted value.

PromptSecurityProfileSettings.description: Per-profile overrides of the site's chat rate limits. A null member uses the site setting.

MaxMessagesPerWindow.description: Most messages a signed-in user may send per RateLimitWindow.

RateLimitWindow.description: The message rate limit window, as a time span such as 00:01:00.

Limit.description: How many are allowed in the window.

Window.description: The window, as a time span such as 00:01:00.

AnonymousMessageRateLimitTiers.description: Message limits for anonymous visitors; every tier applies.

Limit.description: How many are allowed in the window.

Window.description: The window, as a time span such as 00:01:00.

AnonymousSessionStartRateLimitTiers.description: Session start limits for anonymous visitors; every tier applies.

MaxAnonymousSessionsPerWindow.description: Most sessions an anonymous visitor may start per AnonymousSessionRateLimitWindow.

AnonymousSessionRateLimitWindow.description: The anonymous session window, as a time span such as 01:00:00.

WebMcpProfileSettings.description: Whether the profile may use the tools the visitor's page offers through WebMCP.

AllowPageTools.description: Whether the assistant may call the page's tools.

AllowConsequentialPageTools.description: Whether the assistant may also call page tools that change something (consequential tools).

Profiles.description: The AI profiles to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier. When it matches a stored template, that template is updated; otherwise the template is matched by Name and Source.

Source.description: Template source identifier. Built-in values are 'Profile' for reusable AI profile templates and 'SystemPrompt' for reusable system prompt templates.

Name.description: Unique technical name for the template.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable display name. Defaults to Name.

IsListable.description: Whether the template appears in the selection dropdown.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

Properties.description: Extended template properties. A Profile template keeps its profile values (type, deployments, system message, model parameters, tools, agents) under ProfileTemplateMetadata and a SystemPrompt template its text under SystemPromptTemplateMetadata; the step reads nothing else from the template besides the members above. This includes the shared AI profile metadata objects plus template-specific metadata and template-stored settings objects, while still allowing additional feature-specific objects.

AgentMetadata.description: Known agent metadata for agent profiles.

Availability.description: Controls whether the agent is only available when selected or always injected into orchestration.

AllowToolInvocation.description: When true, the agent runs its own selected tools when another assistant calls it. When false or missing, it runs without tools.

AIProfileMetadata.description: Known prompt and model tuning metadata for the profile.

DataSourceMetadata.description: Known external data source selection for retrieval augmentation.

EnableSessionMemory.description: Whether the profile keeps a memory of the current session. Null uses the site default.

CopilotSessionMetadata.description: Known Copilot orchestrator overrides when the AI Copilot Orchestrator feature is enabled.

Values.description: Parameter values sent with requests to the chat deployment.

UtilityValues.description: Parameter values sent with requests to the utility deployment.

AIProfileMcpMetadata.description: Known MCP connection selections for this profile.

ToolNames.description: Per connection identifier, the names of the tools the profile may use from it. A connection with no entry, or a null entry, exposes every tool; an empty array exposes none.

ChatMode.description: Chat mode applied to generated profiles.

ChatDeploymentName.description: Text deployment the generated profile talks to. It answers typed messages, including those typed during a voice conversation.

OrchestratorName.description: Orchestrator name applied to generated profiles.

InitialResponseHandlerName.description: Optional response handler that runs before the main orchestrator.

TitleType.description: How new session titles should be produced for generated profiles.

WelcomeMessage.description: Welcome message shown when the generated profile starts a new chat session.

PromptTemplate.description: Optional Liquid prompt template copied into the generated profile.

PromptSubject.description: Optional subject used with the prompt template.

SystemMessage.description: Base system message copied into generated profiles.

Temperature.description: Sampling temperature applied to generated profiles.

TopP.description: Nucleus sampling threshold applied to generated profiles.

FrequencyPenalty.description: Frequency penalty applied to generated profiles.

PresencePenalty.description: Presence penalty applied to generated profiles.

MaxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens copied into generated profiles.

PastMessagesCount.description: Number of prior chat messages that generated profiles should include in context.

ToolNames.description: Tool names automatically selected for generated profiles.

AgentNames.description: On-demand agent profile names automatically selected for generated profiles.

A2AConnectionIds.description: A2A connection identifiers automatically selected for generated profiles.

Description.description: Profile description copied into the generated profile.

AgentAvailability.description: Agent availability applied when the generated profile type is Agent.

AllowToolInvocation.description: When true and the generated profile type is Agent, the agent runs its own selected tools when another assistant calls it.

SystemPromptTemplateMetadata.description: Known system-prompt template metadata stored when the template Source is SystemPrompt.

SystemMessage.description: System message contributed by this reusable system-prompt template.

LockSystemMessage.description: Prevents recipe or editor updates from changing the system message.

IsListable.description: Whether the profile is listed in the admin UI. Defaults to true.

IsRemovable.description: Controls whether the profile can be deleted from the admin UI.

InitialResponseHandlerName.description: Initial non-AI response handler to invoke before the main orchestrator.

IsOnAdminMenu.description: Whether the chat profile appears on the Orchard admin menu.

EnableDataExtraction.description: Enables extracting structured values from chat sessions.

ExtractionCheckInterval.description: How often data extraction runs during the session.

SessionInactivityTimeoutInMinutes.description: How long the session must be inactive before final extraction runs.

Name.description: Unique extraction key.

AllowMultipleValues.description: Whether multiple values can be captured.

IsUpdatable.description: Whether later session turns can update the extracted value.

FieldType.description: The type of the extracted value. Enum and List values are limited to AllowedValues.

AllowedValues.description: The values an Enum or List field may take.

ToolInstanceNames.description: Tool instances available to post-session processing.

Name.description: Unique task key.

Type.description: How the task result is generated.

AllowMultipleValues.description: Whether the task can return multiple values.

Value.description: Predefined option value.

Options.description: Predefined options used when Type is PredefinedOptions.

ToolInstanceNames.description: Tool instances the task may call.

PostSessionTasks.description: Tasks executed after the chat session closes.

ChatMode.description: Preferred input mode for this profile.

ConversationDeploymentName.description: Optional technical name of the speech-to-speech (realtime) deployment used in conversation mode. Leave empty to use the site default.

VoiceName.description: Optional speech synthesis voice for conversation mode.

EnableTextToSpeechPlayback.description: Whether assistant responses should be played back with text-to-speech.

AIProfileGuardrailSettings.description: Topic guardrails: what the assistant must not discuss, checked on the customer's messages, the replies, or both.

CheckCustomer.description: Whether the customer's messages are checked against the topics.

CheckReplies.description: Whether the assistant's replies are checked against the topics before they are sent.

Topics.description: Identifiers of the guardrail topics: System Prompt templates in the 'Guardrail topic' category.

OtherTopics.description: Other topics refused, described in a sentence or two, for this profile alone.

PlaceholderReply.description: What the assistant says instead when a guardrail triggers. Empty uses a default.

AIProfileDataPrivacySettings.description: What the profile's conversations keep once they end.

StorageMode.description: Everything keeps the transcript; RedactPersonalData removes personal data from it; MetadataOnly keeps only the conversation's metadata.

StorageModeSinceUtc.description: When the storage mode last changed (ISO 8601, UTC). Conversations active after it get the mode. Set by the admin when the mode changes.

RetentionDays.description: Days without activity after which a conversation is deleted. Null keeps conversations.

NamesToKeep.description: Names that are not personal data and are kept when personal data is redacted, such as the assistant's, the business's and its staff's names.

AIProfileSpeakingStyleSettings.description: The speaking styles the assistant follows.

Styles.description: Identifiers of System Prompt templates in the 'Speaking style' category, for example speaking-style-echo-verification, speaking-style-nato-spelling, speaking-style-speech-normalization, speaking-style-fuzzy-name-matching, speaking-style-ai-disclosure, speaking-style-scope-limits, speaking-style-filler-words or speaking-style-high-empathy.

AIProfileSpeechSettings.description: How the assistant speaks and listens in voice conversations.

SpeakingRate.description: How fast the profile speaks, as a multiple of the voice's normal pace (1 is normal), clamped to 0.25-4. Null uses the deployment's own pace.

SpeakingEmotion.description: Emotion the voice speaks with, as one word such as calm or excited, for providers with an emotion control (Cartesia). Others ignore it.

Text.description: The word or phrase to pronounce differently.

MatchCase.description: Whether Text matches only with the same letter case.

PronunciationEntries.description: Pronunciation replacements applied before text is spoken.

FallbackTextToSpeechDeploymentName.description: Technical name of the text-to-speech deployment used when the primary one fails.

BoostedKeywords.description: Words the speech recognizer is biased toward, such as product names.

RecognitionLanguages.description: Languages the recognizer should expect, as BCP-47 tags. The first is the primary language.

InterruptionSensitivity.description: How readily the caller's speech interrupts the assistant, from 0 (never interrupted) to 1 (any caller speech interrupts it). Null uses the default.

EnableBackchanneling.description: Whether the assistant says short acknowledgements while the caller speaks.

BackchannelPhrases.description: The acknowledgements used for backchanneling. Empty uses a small built-in set.

AIProfileLanguageSettings.description: The languages the assistant may speak.

AllowedLanguages.description: Languages the profile may converse in, as BCP-47 tags. Empty means no restriction.

StartingLanguage.description: BCP-47 tag of the language a conversation starts in. A conversation language set by the host (for example from a conversation variable) overrides it.

AIProfileFlowSettings.description: The conversation flow: a workflow whose AI conversation stages guide the conversation.

WorkflowTypeId.description: Identifier of the workflow type that starts with an AI Conversation Flow Started event and holds the stages. Empty turns the flow off.

Flexible.description: Whether every stage's instructions are given at once, so a caller who jumps between tasks is followed, rather than only the current stage's.

AIProfileContactMemorySettings.description: The memory the assistant keeps about each CRM contact.

UseMemory.description: Whether what is remembered about the contact is given to the assistant.

SaveMemory.description: Whether the memory is updated after each conversation.

AIProfileContactFieldMappingSettings.description: Copies extracted values onto the CRM contact when the conversation closes.

FieldName.description: Name of the data extraction entry the value comes from.

ContactField.description: The contact field the value is written to.

Mode.description: Whether the value replaces the field, fills it only when empty, or is appended to it.

Mappings.description: The mappings, one per extracted value.

PromptSecurityProfileSettings.description: Per-profile overrides of the site's chat rate limits. A null member uses the site setting.

MaxMessagesPerWindow.description: Most messages a signed-in user may send per RateLimitWindow.

RateLimitWindow.description: The message rate limit window, as a time span such as 00:01:00.

Limit.description: How many are allowed in the window.

Window.description: The window, as a time span such as 00:01:00.

AnonymousMessageRateLimitTiers.description: Message limits for anonymous visitors; every tier applies.

Limit.description: How many are allowed in the window.

Window.description: The window, as a time span such as 00:01:00.

AnonymousSessionStartRateLimitTiers.description: Session start limits for anonymous visitors; every tier applies.

MaxAnonymousSessionsPerWindow.description: Most sessions an anonymous visitor may start per AnonymousSessionRateLimitWindow.

AnonymousSessionRateLimitWindow.description: The anonymous session window, as a time span such as 01:00:00.

WebMcpProfileSettings.description: Whether the profile may use the tools the visitor's page offers through WebMCP.

AllowPageTools.description: Whether the assistant may call the page's tools.

AllowConsequentialPageTools.description: Whether the assistant may also call page tools that change something (consequential tools).

AzureOpenAIConnectionMetadata.description: Legacy metadata alias for Azure OpenAI connections, read when AzureConnectionMetadata is missing.

AzureAIInferenceConnectionMetadata.description: Metadata for Azure AI Inference connections.

Properties.description: Provider-specific connection metadata grouped by metadata object name. Merged into the stored properties.

Connections.description: The AI provider connections to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier. When supplied and found, the existing instance is updated.

Source.description: Tool instance source identifier that defines the shape of the instance. Required when creating a new instance.

Name.description: Unique tool instance name. Used to derive the function name exposed to the AI model and cannot change once created.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp to preserve during import.

Author.description: Optional author name recorded with the instance.

BaseUrl.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL the request targets.

PathTemplate.description: Optional path appended to BaseUrl. It may hold {parameterName} tokens replaced by parameters bound to the path, each escaped as one path segment.

HttpMethod.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

AuthenticationType.description: Authentication type: None, ApiKey, Basic, or OAuth2.

ApiKeyHeaderName.description: Header name used to send the API key when AuthenticationType is ApiKey.

BearerToken.description: Bearer token credential. Encrypted when entered in the admin; a value imported in clear text is used as given. Exported plans leave it blank.

DefaultHeaders.description: Static headers always added to the request.

AllowModelProvidedPath.description: Whether the AI model may supply a relative path.

AllowModelProvidedQuery.description: Whether the AI model may supply query string parameters.

AllowModelProvidedBody.description: Whether the AI model may supply a request body.

IndexUrl.description: Explicit prebuilt search index URL. Leave empty to derive it from the base URL.

MaxResults.description: Maximum passages returned for a single search.

SearchIndexDocumentationToolSettings.description: Settings for the built-in prebuilt search index documentation source.

ApiKey.description: Algolia search-only API key. Encrypted when entered in the admin; a value imported in clear text is used as given. Exported plans leave it blank.

AlgoliaDocumentationToolSettings.description: Settings for the built-in Algolia DocSearch documentation source.

BaseUrl.description: Root URL of the site to search (for example https://www.example.com).

SearchPath.description: Search endpoint path appended to the base URL. Defaults to the WordPress REST search endpoint.

QueryParameter.description: Query-string parameter that carries the model's free-text query. Defaults to 'search'.

ResultsPath.description: Dotted path to the results array in the response. Empty means the response body is itself the array.

UrlPath.description: Dotted path, relative to each result, to the result URL. Defaults to 'url'.

MaxResults.description: Maximum results returned for a single search.

WebsiteSearchToolSettings.description: Settings for the built-in live website search source.

DataSourceId.description: Identifier of the AI data source the instance searches.

RetrievalMode.description: Whether a search returns only the matching chunks or the full source documents they belong to.

TopNDocuments.description: Number of top-scoring documents returned for a single search. Empty uses the site default.

Strictness.description: Relevance threshold a result must clear to be returned. Empty uses the site default.

Filter.description: OData filter expression translated to the index provider's own syntax before the search runs.

ContentTypes.description: The kinds of knowledge searched (knowledge object types). Empty searches every kind.

DataSourceSearchToolSettings.description: Settings for the built-in AI data source vector search source.

Name.description: Parameter name. For model-filled parameters this is the property name in the function schema and must be a valid identifier, unique within the instance.

Description.description: Natural-language description shown to the AI model. Required for model-filled parameters.

Type.description: JSON schema type of the parameter.

Fill.description: Who supplies the value at invocation time: Model (the AI model), Fixed (a pinned value), or Context (resolved server-side from the request context).

Required.description: Whether the AI model must supply the value. Only meaningful when Fill is Model.

DefaultValue.description: Value applied when the model omits an optional parameter, or the pinned value when Fill is Fixed. A Fixed secret value is stored encrypted at rest.

AllowedValues.description: Closed set of accepted values, emitted as the schema enum and enforced by the binder. Empty means any value of the declared type.

ContextKey.description: Well-known context key resolved when Fill is Context, for example user.id.

Binding.description: Source-specific placement of the resolved value, expressed as Target or Target:name (for example Query:orderId). Valid targets are declared by the owning source.

IsSecret.description: Whether a Fixed value is a credential. Secret values are stored encrypted at rest and never returned to the UI in clear text.

Parameters.description: The declared parameters, in the order they appear in the function schema the AI model sees.

AIToolInstanceParametersMetadata.description: User-declared parameters for sources that opt into parameter support.

then.description: Creates or updates asset types, then assets. Records are matched by ItemId only; an existing record takes only the members given. List parent assets before their children.

items.description: An asset type.

ItemId.description: The asset type's id. When it matches a stored asset type, that asset type is updated with the members given here; otherwise a new asset type is created, keeping this id when it is a valid id so other records that point at it still do.

Name.description: The type name.

Category.description: What kind of asset it is.

items.description: An attribute every asset of the type has.

Name.description: The attribute name.

items.description: A meter assets of the type are read on, such as hours or miles.

Name.description: The meter name.

Cumulative.description: Whether readings only go up, like an odometer. Defaults to true.

Meters.description: The meters its assets are read on.

items.description: An asset: a piece of equipment, vehicle, tool, customer unit, component or facility.

ItemId.description: The asset's id. When it matches a stored asset, that asset is updated with the members given here; otherwise a new asset is created, keeping this id when it is a valid id so other records that point at it still do.

Name.description: The asset name.

AssetTypeId.description: The ItemId of its asset type.

ProductId.description: The content item id of the product it is.

OwnerKind.description: Who owns it. The owner itself (OwnerId) is not carried by this step: deployment plans leave it out and an import ignores it.

Name.description: The name of the person or place.

DependentLocality.description: The neighborhood or dependent locality, where the country uses one.

SortingCode.description: The sorting code, where the country uses one.

Phone.description: The phone number at the address.

Latitude.description: The latitude, in degrees, when geocoded.

Longitude.description: The longitude, in degrees, when geocoded.

ParentAssetId.description: The ItemId of the asset it is part of.

Status.description: Where the asset is in its life.

Attributes.description: The values of its type's attributes, by attribute name.

Documents.description: The paths of its documents in the media library.

Fleet.description: Its fleet data, for vehicles, equipment and tools the business owns.

Schedulable.description: Whether it is booked for visits, with its own Equipment calendar that refuses double-booking.

CalendarId.description: The id of its Equipment calendar.

Capacity.description: What it can carry or hold.

Assets.description: The assets, parents first. Their meter readings are never imported.

Settings.description: Asterisk provider settings for the tenant-configured ARI connection.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the tenant-configured Asterisk provider is enabled.

BaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Asterisk ARI endpoint.

Password.description: ARI password. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

ApplicationName.description: Stasis application name used for originated channels.

EndpointTemplate.description: Optional template that turns a dialed destination into an ARI endpoint; use the {number} token for the destination.

OutboundCallerId.description: Caller identifier presented on outbound calls.

VoicemailContext.description: Dialplan context a call continues into when an agent sends an inbound offer to voicemail.

VoicemailExtensionTemplate.description: Template that resolves the voicemail dialplan extension; it may use tokens such as {voicemailRecipientUserName} or {calledAddress}.

VoicemailPriority.description: Dialplan priority used when continuing a call to voicemail.

WebSocketUrl.description: Secure WebSocket URL browser SIP user agents connect to.

SipDomain.description: SIP domain used to compose browser agent addresses of record.

TurnUrls.description: Comma- or newline-delimited STUN/TURN URLs advertised to browser agents.

TurnSharedSecret.description: coturn REST shared secret used to issue time-limited TURN credentials. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

IceTransportPolicy.description: ICE transport policy sent to the browser, for example 'all' or 'relay'.

WebRtcCodecs.description: Comma- or newline-delimited browser audio codec preference list, for example 'opus,g722,ulaw'.

PjsipCredentialLifetimeMinutes.description: Lifetime, in minutes, of the short-lived PJSIP credentials issued to browser agents.

PjsipRealtimeProviderInvariantName.description: ADO.NET provider invariant name used to write PJSIP Realtime rows.

PjsipRealtimeConnectionString.description: PJSIP Realtime database connection string. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

DisplayName.description: Display caption shown for the Azure AD login option.

TenantId.description: Azure AD tenant identifier that owns the application.

CallbackPath.description: Relative callback path that Azure AD redirects back to after sign-in.

Indices.description: Azure AI Search index definitions to create. Each object is forwarded to the Azure AI index recipe handler.

IncludeAll.description: When true, rebuild all Azure AI Search indexes and ignore the Indices list.

Indices.description: Specific Azure AI Search index names to rebuild when IncludeAll is false.

IncludeAll.description: When true, reset all Azure AI Search indexes and ignore the Indices list.

Indices.description: Specific Azure AI Search index names to reset when IncludeAll is false.

then.description: Adds dates to booking products, such as a tour's departures.

items.description: A date of a booking product. A date the product has already is left as it is.

ContentItemId.description: The content item id of the booking product.

Date.description: The date, as yyyy-MM-dd. Give Date or DaysFromToday.

DaysFromToday.description: The date as a number of days from today, so a sample's dates stay ahead.

Time.description: The start time of a time slot, as HH:mm. Leave it out for a whole day.

Capacity.description: The places the date has. 10 when left out.

Price.description: The date's own price, or leave it out for the product's.

itemId.description: The category's id. When it matches a stored category, that category is updated; otherwise a new one is made under this id, so references to it keep working.

color.description: The color of its events, such as #2f9e44.

ownerId.description: The user it belongs to, or null for a category everyone can use.

Categories.description: The categories to create or update, before the calendars.

itemId.description: The calendar's id. When it matches a stored calendar, that calendar is updated; otherwise a new one is made under this id, so references to it keep working.

type.description: The calendar type, such as General, Personal, Team, Room, Equipment or Office; the feature that registers it must be on.

ownerKind.description: What owns it. One of: None, User, Role, Resource (or its number).

ownerId.description: The user id or role name that owns it.

visibility.description: Who can see it. One of: Private, Shared, Public (or its number).

principalKind.description: Who it is shared with. One of: User, Role (or its number).

principalId.description: The user id or role name.

access.description: What they can do. One of: None, FreeBusy, Read, Write, Manage (or its number).

conflictPolicy.description: Whether events may overlap. One of: AllowOverlaps, LimitConcurrent (or its number).

capacity.description: With LimitConcurrent: how many events may overlap.

enabled.description: Whether it is in use.

source.description: The feature that manages it, or null.

sourceId.description: The record of that feature it belongs to.

properties.description: Extension data other features keep on the calendar.

itemId.description: The event's id. When it matches a stored event, that event is updated; otherwise a new one is made under this id, so references to it keep working.

eventType.description: The kind of event, one of the calendar type's event types.

allDay.description: Whether it lasts whole days; end is then the day after the last one.

start.description: When it starts, as a wall-clock time in timeZoneId (no offset), such as 2026-11-03T09:00:00.

end.description: When it ends, as a wall-clock time in timeZoneId.

timeZoneId.description: The IANA time zone of start and end, such as America/New_York.

status.description: The status. One of: Confirmed, Tentative, Cancelled (or its number).

transparency.description: Whether it takes the time. One of: Busy, Free (or its number).

visibility.description: Who sees its details. One of: Default, Public, Private (or its number).

color.description: Its own color, or null for its category's, kind's or calendar's.

categoryId.description: The id of its category (see Categories), or null.

reminderMinutes.description: Minutes before the start its people are reminded: 0, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120 or 1440.

email.description: An email address, for a guest.

resourceCalendarId.description: A room or equipment calendar booked for the event.

role.description: The attendee's role. One of: Required, Optional, Organizer, Resource (or its number).

response.description: The attendee's answer. One of: NeedsAction, Accepted, Tentative, Declined (or its number).

attendees.description: The people, guests, rooms and equipment invited.

exceptionDates.description: Wall-clock starts of occurrences that are skipped.

seriesId.description: For a changed occurrence of a repeating event: the series it belongs to.

originalStartUtc.description: For a changed occurrence: the UTC start it replaces.

source.description: The feature that manages the event, such as Scheduling, or null.

sourceId.description: The record of that feature the event belongs to.

editable.description: Whether it can be changed on the calendar.

properties.description: Extension data other features keep on the event.

Events.description: Its events (when the deployment step included them). Unlike the other members, this one is read with a capital E.

Calendars.description: The calendars to create or update, each with its events.

Commands.description: Commands to execute in order. Each entry is a single command line string.

ItemId.description: Optional identifier of the data set. When it matches a stored data set, that data set is updated; otherwise the data set is matched by Name. A new data set keeps this identifier when it is up to 26 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, and gets a generated one otherwise.

Name.description: Technical name of the data set, which reports, pipelines and its read permission store. A data set without a matching ItemId is matched by this name. It can't change once created. Made from DisplayText when omitted.

DisplayText.description: Name of the data set shown in the admin UI and in data source pickers.

Description.description: Optional description of the data set.

ConnectionId.description: Identifier of the connection the data set reads.

ConnectionName.description: Technical name of the connection the data set reads, used when no connection has ConnectionId.

Resource.description: What the data set reads at the connection: a table or view, an index, an API path, or a media file.

AccessMode.description: Live reads the source on every read; Imported copies the rows into the site on a schedule. Defaults to Live when the connector can read live.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the data set is offered to reports and pipelines and refreshed. Defaults to true.

Name.description: Name reports and pipelines read the field by. Made from SourceName when omitted.

SourceName.description: Name of the column, property or member at the source.

DisplayName.description: Label of the field. Defaults to Name.

Type.description: Type the field is read as.

IsIdentifier.description: Whether the field identifies a row. An incremental refresh needs at least one.

IsIncluded.description: Whether reports and pipelines see the field. Defaults to true.

Fields.description: The fields of the data set. When omitted on a new data set, they are read from the source if it can be reached, and otherwise at the first refresh.

DefaultDateField.description: Name of an included date field that reports filter by default.

Mode.description: Whether a refresh reads every row, or only the rows changed since the last one.

IncrementalField.description: For an incremental refresh: the date or number field that grows when a row changes.

IntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between scheduled refreshes. Null refreshes only on demand.

SchemaChangePolicy.description: Whether a refresh accepts a change of the source's fields, or fails and keeps the rows it has.

Refresh.description: How an imported data set is refreshed.

Query.description: Optional SELECT statement read instead of the table or view named by Resource.

RelationalDataSetSettings.description: The settings of a data set of a SqlServer (relational) connection.

RecordsPath.description: The path to the array of records in the response.

Pagination.description: How pages are requested: Type, PageParameter, FirstPage, OffsetParameter, SizeParameter, PageSize, CursorParameter, NextPath and MaxPages.

HttpApiDataSetSettings.description: The settings of a data set of an HttpApi connection.

ElasticsearchDataSetSettings.description: The settings of a data set of an Elasticsearch connection.

MediaFileDataSetSettings.description: The settings of a data set of a MediaFiles connection.

Properties.description: The connector's settings of the data set, keyed by the name of their type. Each settings object given replaces the stored one; settings not given are kept. Enumerations travel as their names.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp to preserve when importing exported records.

ModifiedUtc.description: Optional last-modified timestamp to preserve when importing exported records.

Author.description: Optional author name recorded with the data set.

DataSets.description: The connected data sets to create or update. Imported data sets that hold no rows yet are queued for their first import.

UserName.description: User name of the target Orchard user the entitlement is applied to. Entries without a user name are skipped.

DisplayName.description: Display name for the agent. When empty, the resolved user name is used.

MaxConcurrentInteractions.description: Maximum number of interactions the agent may handle at once. Values below 1 are raised to 1.

items.description: A queue identifier the agent is entitled to. Identifiers that no longer exist are filtered out.

AllowedQueueIds.description: Queue identifiers the agent is entitled to work.

items.description: A campaign identifier the agent is entitled to. Identifiers that no longer exist are filtered out.

AllowedCampaignIds.description: Campaign identifiers the agent is entitled to work.

items.description: A skill identifier granted to the agent.

Skills.description: Skill identifiers granted to the agent.

Proficiency.description: How well the agent holds the skill, from 1 to 5.

SkillProficiencies.description: How well the agent holds each skill. Skills listed only in 'Skills' are read at the default proficiency.

QueueId.description: The queue the membership is for.

Priority.description: How strongly the agent is pulled toward this queue; lower is served first.

DelaySeconds.description: How long an item must have waited before this agent is offered it, which is how a backup (overflow) membership is expressed.

QueueMemberships.description: How the agent serves each queue: its priority and the wait before the agent is offered work from it.

Agents.description: The Contact Center agent entitlements to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the calendar. When it matches a stored calendar, that calendar is updated. Otherwise a new calendar is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique name of the calendar.

TimeZoneId.description: Time zone the weekly schedule and holidays are evaluated in. When empty, UTC is used.

Day.description: The day of the week this window applies to.

IsOpen.description: Whether the queue is open on this day.

OpenMinute.description: Local time, in minutes from midnight, the open window starts.

CloseMinute.description: Local time, in minutes from midnight (exclusive), the open window ends.

WeeklySchedule.description: Per-day open windows that define the weekly schedule.

items.description: A closed date in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format.

Holidays.description: Dates the queue is closed all day regardless of the weekly schedule.

Enabled.description: Whether the calendar is enabled. Disabled calendars do not gate routing.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the calendar, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

Calendars.description: The Contact Center business-hours calendars to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the dialer profile. When it matches a stored dialer profile, that dialer profile is updated. Otherwise a new dialer profile is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique name of the dialer profile.

Mode.description: Dialing mode that controls pacing and agent reservation behavior.

ProviderName.description: Technical name of the Contact Center voice provider that places calls, or null for the default.

CallsPerAgent.description: Number of calls placed per available agent for power dialing.

MaxAttempts.description: Maximum number of dialing attempts allowed per activity.

RetryDelayMinutes.description: Delay, in minutes, before a no-answer activity is retried.

AnsweringMachineDetection.description: Whether Power and Progressive dialing asks the provider to screen out answering machines before connecting an agent. A machine-answered call is hung up and retried.

RingTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a Power, Progressive or Predictive call rings before it is given up as unanswered, from 15 to 120 (0 for the default of 30). Automated calls never ring for less than 15 seconds.

PreviewOfferTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a preview record stays reserved for the agent it is offered to before it goes back to the queue. Zero uses the default.

PreviewExtensionSeconds.description: Seconds each extension adds when a preview agent asks for more time to review a record before it is dialed.

MaxPreviewExtensions.description: How many times one preview offer may be extended.

CallerId.description: Caller identifier presented to the customer when supported.

AlwaysUseCallerId.description: Whether the caller identifier is presented even for an agent who has their own outbound line; when false, agents with a line call from it.

DefaultRegionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region a destination is read in when it carries no country calling code.

RespectDoNotCall.description: Whether do-not-call and communication preferences suppress activities.

EnforceCallingWindow.description: Whether calls are restricted by business-hours calendars.

EnforceAbandonmentCap.description: Whether outbound dialing is gated by a rolling abandonment-rate cap.

MaxAbandonmentRatePercent.description: Maximum tolerated rolling abandonment rate, expressed as a percentage of calls a live person answered.

AbandonmentSampleFloor.description: Minimum number of live-answered calls that must accumulate in the rolling window before the abandonment rate is enforced.

SafeHarborEnabled.description: Whether an abandoned automated call plays the abandoned-call message instead of being hung up silently. Required when an automated profile enforces the abandonment cap.

SafeHarborMessage.description: The abandoned-call message spoken to a person who answered when no agent can be connected. '{company}' is replaced with the site name and '{number}' with the number the call came from.

PredictivePacingModel.description: How a Predictive profile paces its calls: 'ReservedPerCall' reserves an agent for every call; 'OverDial' places more calls than there are free agents, sized from the measured answer rate, and claims a free agent when a person answers, falling back to 'ReservedPerCall' whenever the measurements cannot be trusted. Requires an enforced abandonment cap, the abandoned-call message and a target below the cap. Requires the Contact Center Paced Dialing feature.

TargetAbandonmentRatePercent.description: Abandonment rate, in percent of calls a person answered, that Predictive over-dialing steers toward. Must be greater than 0 and, for over-dialing, lower than MaxAbandonmentRatePercent.

MaxLinesPerAgent.description: Most calls Predictive over-dialing may have ringing per free agent, from 1 to 5.

MaxCallsInFlight.description: Most calls a Predictive profile may have in flight for one campaign, from 1 to 1000.

AnswerRateSampleFloor.description: Fewest settled calls the answer rate must be measured from before Predictive over-dialing trusts it, from 10 to 10000.

AnswerRateWindowMinutes.description: Minutes of history the Predictive answer rate is measured over, from 5 to 240.

CreditAgentsFreeingUp.description: Whether Predictive over-dialing also counts agents expected to finish their call and wrap-up before a new call is answered.

FreeUpCreditPercent.description: Percentage, from 0 to 100, of the agents expected to free up that Predictive over-dialing counts when CreditAgentsFreeingUp is true.

ConnectWaitMilliseconds.description: Milliseconds, from 0 to 1500, a person who answered an over-dialed call may wait for an agent to free up before the abandoned-call message plays.

AbandonedRetryRequiresAgent.description: Whether a Predictive call that was abandoned is retried only with an agent reserved for it.

ShowDialProgressToAgent.description: Whether the agent's screens show who is being dialed and each step of an automated dial placed for them, rather than only that they are waiting for a connected call.

CallingCalendarId.description: Default business-hours calendar used to evaluate outbound calls.

RegionalCallingCalendarIds.description: Region-specific business-hours calendar overrides keyed by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code.

Enabled.description: Whether the dialer profile is enabled.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the dialer profile, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

DialerProfiles.description: The Contact Center dialer profiles to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the entry point. When it matches a stored entry point, that entry point is updated. Otherwise a new entry point is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique name of the entry point.

Channel.description: Channel the entry point answers, named as the address capability: 'Phone' for calls. Empty means calls.

AddressIds.description: Identifiers of the omnichannel addresses whose traffic on the channel this entry point answers. Import the addresses first.

items.description: A typed number.

DialedNumbers.description: Numbers typed on an entry point exported before entry points picked their numbers from the address list. They still route calls; prefer 'AddressIds'.

TargetType.description: Whether calls route to a queue ('TargetQueueId'), ring one agent directly ('TargetAgentId'), or are answered by an AI voice agent ('TargetAIProfileId', calls only).

TargetAIProfileId.description: Identifier of the AI chat profile that answers calls when 'TargetType' is 'AIAgent'.

TargetAgentId.description: Identifier of the agent profile calls ring directly when 'TargetType' is 'Agent'. There is no queue fallback.

VoicemailEnabled.description: Whether an unanswered direct-to-agent call is sent to the agent's voicemail. When disabled the caller keeps ringing until answered or they hang up. Applies only when 'TargetType' is 'Agent'.

RingTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a direct-to-agent call rings before it is sent to the agent's voicemail. Applies only when 'TargetType' is 'Agent' and 'VoicemailEnabled' is true.

VoicemailGreetingText.description: Default text-to-speech voicemail greeting for calls through this entry point, used when the agent reached has not recorded their own greeting.

VoicemailRecipientAgentId.description: Identifier of the agent profile whose voicemail inbox receives messages left on this line when the call has no agent of its own.

VoicemailDestination.description: Where a queue line delivers a message the call has no agent for: the inbox of 'VoicemailRecipientAgentId' or the shared voicemail box of the queue the caller was in. Does not apply to an agent-target entry point.

RootNodeId.description: Identifier of the node the caller hears first.

MaxRetries.description: How many times a caller may fail to choose before the fallback action takes over.

TargetId.description: What the action acts on: a queue identifier, an agent profile identifier, a child node identifier, or an approved external transfer destination identifier.

FallbackAction.description: What happens when the retries run out.

NodeId.description: Identifier other nodes and the flow refer to.

PromptMediaId.description: Voice media played instead of speaking the prompt, when configured.

Digit.description: The telephone key the caller presses (0-9, * or #).

TargetId.description: What the action acts on: a queue identifier, an agent profile identifier, a child node identifier, or an approved external transfer destination identifier.

IvrFlow.description: Optional menu callers hear before they are routed. An entry point with no flow, or a flow with no nodes, routes straight to its target. The flow is validated as a runnable menu tree on import.

TargetQueueId.description: Identifier of the queue calls route to while the entry point is open.

Priority.description: Priority assigned to calls entering through this entry point.

BusinessHoursCalendarId.description: Identifier of the business-hours calendar that gates when the entry point is open. When empty, the entry point is always open.

ClosedAction.description: Action taken for calls while the entry point is closed.

OverflowQueueId.description: Identifier of the queue used when 'ClosedAction' is 'Overflow'.

WelcomeMessage.description: Message spoken once to a caller while the entry point is open, before the IVR menu or the target.

ClosedMessage.description: Message spoken to a caller while the entry point is closed, before the closed action is applied.

Enabled.description: Whether the entry point is enabled.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the entry point, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

EntryPoints.description: The Contact Center entry points to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the queue. When it matches a stored queue, that queue is updated. Otherwise a new queue is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

QueueGroupId.description: Optional queue-group identifier used for catalog organization and reporting. Queue groups do not affect routing.

Name.description: Unique name of the queue.

DefaultPriority.description: Default priority applied to items added to the queue.

RoutingStrategy.description: Strategy used to choose which available agent receives the next queued item.

PreferStickyAgent.description: Whether routing prefers the activity's last assigned user when that agent is eligible and available.

EnableSlaAging.description: Whether a waiting item's effective priority increases the longer it waits beyond the SLA threshold.

SlaThresholdSeconds.description: Service-level threshold, in seconds, after which a waiting item breaches SLA.

ReservationTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a reservation remains valid before it expires and the item is re-queued.

UnansweredOfferAction.description: What happens when an offered reservation expires before the agent accepts it.

BusinessHoursCalendarId.description: Identifier of the business-hours calendar that gates when the queue routes work. When empty, the queue routes around the clock.

AfterHoursAction.description: Action taken for waiting items while the queue's business-hours calendar reports closed.

OverflowQueueId.description: Identifier of the queue that receives overflowed items. When empty, overflow is disabled.

OverflowAfterSeconds.description: Seconds an item may wait before it overflows to the overflow queue. Zero disables wait-time overflow.

items.description: A skill identifier required to handle work from this queue.

RequiredSkills.description: Skills required to be eligible to handle work from this queue.

Enabled.description: Whether the queue is enabled for routing.

InboundChannelEndpointId.description: Identifier of the inbound channel endpoint (dialed number or DID) whose calls are routed to this queue.
