FirstResponseTargetSeconds.description: Seconds a messaging contact may wait for a first reply on this queue before the thread is treated as breached. Zero disables the first-response target.

SkillId.description: Identifier of the skill the requirement describes.

MinimumProficiency.description: Proficiency an agent must reach to satisfy the requirement.

Required.description: Whether an agent who does not meet the requirement is excluded. When false, the requirement is a preference that ranks candidates instead of eliminating them.

RelaxAfterSeconds.description: Seconds a contact may wait before the requirement is dropped, or null when it never is.

SkillRequirements.description: What the queue needs from the agent who takes its work: the proficiency of each skill, whether it is required or preferred, and when it relaxes. Skills listed only in 'RequiredSkills' are read as hard requirements at the default proficiency.

QueueId.description: Identifier of the queue a waiting caller moves to.

AfterSeconds.description: Seconds the caller must have waited before this hop applies.

OverflowTargets.description: Ordered overflow chain describing where a waiting caller widens to and after how long. It supersedes the single 'OverflowQueueId' hop.

MaxWaitSeconds.description: Longest time, in seconds, the queue makes anybody wait. Zero means no limit.

MaxWaitAction.description: What happens to a caller who reaches 'MaxWaitSeconds'.

MaxQueueSize.description: How many callers may wait at once. Zero means no limit.

QueueFullAction.description: What happens to a caller who arrives at a full queue.

WelcomeMessage.description: Message played once when the caller enters the queue.

AnnouncementIntervalSeconds.description: How often, in seconds, the periodic announcement repeats. Zero means never.

AnnouncePosition.description: Whether the announcement states the caller's position in line.

AnnounceEstimatedWait.description: Whether the announcement states the estimated wait.

HoldMusicMediaId.description: Voice media reference of the hold music.

CallbackDtmfKey.description: Single telephone key that accepts a callback, or null when no callback is offered.

CallbackOfferAfterSeconds.description: Seconds the caller waits before the callback is offered.

MinimumEstimateSeconds.description: Shortest wait, in seconds, the queue quotes.

MaximumEstimateSeconds.description: Longest wait, in seconds, the queue quotes. Past it the announcement says nothing about time.

AverageHandleTimeSeconds.description: Configured average handle time, in seconds, used to estimate the wait.

Treatment.description: What callers hear while they wait: the welcome message, periodic announcements, hold music and the callback offer.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the queue, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

Queues.description: The Contact Center queues to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the queue group. When it matches a stored queue group, that queue group is updated. Otherwise a new queue group is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique queue-group name.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the queue group, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

QueueGroups.description: The Contact Center queue groups to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the skill. When it matches a stored skill, that skill is updated. Otherwise a new skill is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique skill name.

Enabled.description: Whether the skill can be selected by agents and queues.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the skill, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

Skills.description: The Contact Center skills to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the voice media clip. When it matches a stored voice media clip, that voice media clip is updated. Otherwise a new voice media clip is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique, admin-facing name of the clip.

Description.description: Optional description, for example the business or line the clip is for.

ProviderName.description: Technical name of the telephony provider whose copy 'MediaReference' plays (for example 'Telnyx'). Kept for plans written when an entry recorded a single provider copy; 'ProviderReferences' records every provider's copy, and this pair is folded into it when the entry is read.

MediaReference.description: Reference the provider named by 'ProviderName' plays the clip by (for Telnyx, the Media Storage media name). The audio itself is not carried by the recipe.

Format.description: Audio format the clip was uploaded in, for example 'mp3' or 'wav'.

MasterStorageReference.description: Reference of the master copy in the platform's own media store (the Telephony recording media store: the tenant's application-data folder, or Azure Blob Storage when that feature is enabled). The audio itself is not carried by the recipe, so the reference resolves only where the destination shares that media store; otherwise upload the clip again in the destination. Null for a clip that exists only at a provider.

ContentType.description: Content type the audio was uploaded with, for example 'audio/mpeg', given to a provider again when it is sent a copy from the master copy.

additionalProperties.description: The reference that provider plays the clip by.

ProviderReferences.description: The copy each telephony provider holds, keyed by the provider's technical name (for example 'Telnyx'). A provider without an entry is given a copy from the master copy when it first plays the clip. A reference resolves only in the destination provider account it was made in.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the voice media clip, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

VoiceMedia.description: The voice media clips to create or update.

ContentItemId.description: The unique identifier for the content item.

ContentItemVersionId.description: The version identifier for the content item.

ContentType.description: The type of content item.

DisplayText.description: The display text for the content item.

Latest.description: Whether this is the latest version.

Published.description: Whether this content item is published.

ModifiedUtc.description: The UTC date/time when the content item was last modified.

PublishedUtc.description: The UTC date/time when the content item was published.

CreatedUtc.description: The UTC date/time when the content item was created.

Owner.description: The owner of the content item.

Author.description: The author of the content item.

data.description: Content items to import or update. Each item must match the schema for its content type.

ContentTypes.description: List of content types. Fields must be attached through a content part whose PartName matches the content type's Name. Those parts must also appear in the ContentPartFieldDefinitionRecords inside ContentParts. Fields cannot be used directly in PartName.

Name.description: Technical content type name.

DisplayName.description: Display name shown in the Orchard admin UI.

Creatable.description: Whether editors can create new items of this type.

Listable.description: Whether items of this type appear in content lists.

Draftable.description: Whether items of this type support drafts.

ContentTypeSettings.description: Standard Orchard Core content type settings.

Settings.description: Content type settings object, including standard Orchard ContentTypeSettings.

PartName.description: Attached part type name. Known part names are surfaced as suggestions, but any custom part name is allowed.

Name.description: Attachment name used on the content type. Usually matches PartName.

DisplayName.description: Display label shown in the admin UI.

Position.description: Placement position used by Orchard when rendering the part or field.

DisplayMode.description: Display mode selected for the part or field.

Editor.description: Editor name used to edit the part or field.

Settings.description: Attachment settings for this part on the content type.

AccountPartSettings.description: The settings of the account part.

OfferedContentTypes.description: The record types (such as contacts and opportunities) already added to the account type's list. The Accounts feature adds every new record type to the list once and records it here, so a type an administrator removes from the list is not added back.

Pattern.description: Pattern for generating the alias. Must be valid Liquid syntax.

Options.description: Whether the alias is editable or auto-generated.

Pattern.description: The pattern used to build the Path. Must be valid Liquid syntax.

LeadPartSettings.description: How a lead of this type is converted.

TargetContactContentType.description: The contact content type a lead of this type becomes when it is converted.

DefaultOpportunityContentType.description: The opportunity content type offered first when a conversion creates an opportunity.

RequireTimeZone.description: Require a time zone for the contact.

AutoDetectTimeZone.description: Automatically detect the contact time zone from the contact's phone number when one was not selected.

UseDoNotCall.description: Show the Do not call preference.

UseDoNotSms.description: Show the Do not SMS preference.

UseDoNotEmail.description: Show the Do not email preference.

OpportunityPartSettings.description: The pipeline of an opportunity type.

StageIds.description: The ItemIds of the stages (see the OmnichannelOpportunityStage step) an opportunity of this type moves through. Empty uses every stage.

Pattern.description: Pattern for building the preview path or display content.

Type.description: The kind of product the part represents.

DefaultCurrency.description: The ISO-4217 currency code applied to products of this type when an item does not set its own currency.

SalesMode.description: Whether products of this type can be bought online, are only listed, or decide per item.

PriceDisplay.description: How the price of products of this type is shown to visitors.

OnRequestLabel.description: The text shown instead of the price when the price is shown on request.

AllowPriceDisplayOverride.description: Whether each product may choose how its own price is shown.

IsContentRestricted.description: Whether content that uses this part is restricted to the selected roles.

Required.description: Whether at least one role must be picked.

AllowSelectMultiple.description: Whether more than one role may be picked.

ExcludedRoles.description: The role names that are not offered.

Hint.description: The hint shown under the picker.

SchemaOrgPartSettings.description: The schema.org type of the content items and where each of their properties comes from.

SchemaType.description: The schema.org type, such as BlogPosting, Article, Event or Product. When empty, a module may choose one (a product is a Product); other items are a WebPage.

Name.description: The schema.org property, such as headline. A dotted name, such as offers.price, sets a property of a nested object.

Source.description: Where the value comes from: Content (a field or value of the item), Fixed (the same value for every item), Editor (entered on each item) or Liquid (a template).

Value.description: What the source needs: for Content the key of a field or value, such as Field:BlogPost.Image or Item:DisplayText; for Fixed the value itself; for Liquid the template; unused for Editor.

Properties.description: The properties and where their values come from, in the order they are written.

ContentTypes.description: The content types for which the subscription flow collects content item data.

DefaultTaxCategoryCode.description: The default tax category code applied to new content items.

DefaultTaxClassificationCode.description: The default tax classification code applied to new content items.

AllowClassificationOverride.description: Whether the tax classification fields are shown to editors.

Pattern.description: This string must be a valid Liquid syntax

allOf.description: The part has no settings of its own.

WizardPartSettings.description: How the wizard's steps are authored and how a started wizard behaves.

ContainedContentTypes.description: The content types allowed as steps. Empty allows every type that matches ContainedStereotypes.

ContainedStereotypes.description: The stereotypes allowed as steps. Empty does not filter by stereotype.

DisplayType.description: The display type each step is rendered with in the authoring editor.

CollapseContainedItems.description: Whether steps are collapsed by default in the authoring editor.

RequiresAuthenticatedUser.description: Whether a visitor must be signed in to start the wizard.

CompletionPolicy.description: What happens to the collected responses when the wizard completes: 0 = None (kept only in the session for a workflow or handler), 1 = Draft (created as drafts), 2 = Publish (created and published, the default).

ContentTypePartDefinitionRecords.description: Parts attached to this content type.

Name.description: Reusable content part name.

Settings.description: Part definition settings, including part-specific settings envelopes.

FieldName.description: Field type name. Known Orchard field types are surfaced as suggestions, but any custom field type name is allowed.

Name.description: Field name used inside the content part.

DisplayName.description: Display label shown in the admin UI.

Position.description: Placement position used by Orchard when rendering the part or field.

DisplayMode.description: Display mode selected for the part or field.

Editor.description: Editor name used to edit the part or field.

Settings.description: Field definition settings, including Orchard placement/editor settings and field-specific settings envelopes.

Hint.description: The hint shown under the field in the editor.

Required.description: Whether an address must be entered.

ShowName.description: Whether the editor asks for the recipient's name.

ShowCompany.description: Whether the editor asks for a company.

ShowPhone.description: Whether the editor asks for a phone number.

Countries.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries offered; empty or null for every country.

DefaultCountry.description: The country a new address starts in.

Hint.description: The hint shown under the field in the editor.

Required.description: Whether a phone number must be entered.

InitialCountryMode.description: The country the editor starts on: Globe (0, none), CurrentCulture (1, the request culture's country) or Specific (2, SpecificCountryCode).

SpecificCountryCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the editor starts on when InitialCountryMode is Specific.

Pattern.description: This string must be valid Liquid syntax when provided.

MinLength.description: The minimum number of characters allowed. Omit it for no minimum.

MaxLength.description: The maximum number of characters allowed. Omit it for no maximum.

ContentPartFieldDefinitionRecords.description: Field definitions that belong to this reusable part.

items.description: A coupon or automatic discount. It is matched by Code (without case sensitivity) and checked with the same rules as the coupon editor. How often it was used is never imported.

Code.description: The code the buyer enters, which the step matches coupons by. An automatic discount needs one too: it identifies the discount's uses.

Method.description: Whether the buyer enters the code (Code) or the discount applies by itself to every checkout that meets its conditions (Automatic). Defaults to Code.

OnlyGeneratedCodes.description: Whether only the unique codes generated for the coupon work, and not its own code.

Description.description: What the buyer sees on their invoice. Required for an automatic discount.

Kind.description: How the reduction is calculated. Defaults to Percentage.

Percentage.description: The percentage taken off (1 to 100) for Percentage and BuyXGetY coupons; 100 makes the items a buyer gets free.

Amount.description: The amount taken off for a FixedAmount coupon. Must be greater than zero.

Currency.description: The ISO-4217 currency a fixed amount is in. Required for a FixedAmount coupon, which only applies to invoices in that currency.

Target.description: What the coupon reduces: OneTime (one-time amount), FirstCycle (first recurring cycle only) or Shipping. Defaults to OneTime.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the coupon can be used. Defaults to true.

StartsUtc.description: The UTC time the coupon starts being valid.

EndsUtc.description: The UTC time the coupon stops being valid. Must be after StartsUtc.

MaxRedemptions.description: How many times the coupon may be used in total, or null for no limit.

MaxRedemptionsPerCustomer.description: How many times one customer (account, or guest email) may use the coupon, or null for no limit.

MinimumAmount.description: The amount the items the coupon applies to must reach.

MaximumAmount.description: The most the items the coupon applies to may come to, or null for no maximum. Can't be less than MinimumAmount.

MinimumQuantity.description: How many of the items it counts the order must have, or null for no minimum.

BuyQuantity.description: For a BuyXGetY offer: how many qualifying items the buyer buys each time the offer applies (1 or more). Ignored for other kinds.

GetQuantity.description: For a BuyXGetY offer: how many items the buyer gets at Percentage off each time the offer applies (1 or more). Ignored for other kinds.

BuyProductIds.description: For a BuyXGetY offer: the product content item ids that count toward what the buyer buys. Empty, with BuyCategoryIds empty, counts every item.

BuyCategoryIds.description: For a BuyXGetY offer: the category (taxonomy term) content item ids whose products count toward what the buyer buys.

MaxApplicationsPerOrder.description: For a BuyXGetY offer: the most times it applies to one order, or null for no limit.

CombinesWithProductDiscounts.description: Whether the coupon can be used with discounts off some products.

CombinesWithOrderDiscounts.description: Whether the coupon can be used with discounts off the order.

CombinesWithShippingDiscounts.description: Whether the coupon can be used with discounts off shipping.

ProductIds.description: The product content item ids the coupon is limited to. With CategoryIds empty too, it applies to every item.

CategoryIds.description: The category (taxonomy term) content item ids the coupon is limited to.

Sources.description: The checkout sources the coupon is limited to, matched without case sensitivity. Empty means any source.

ReferenceTypes.description: The reference types (what a checkout pays for, such as Transaction) the coupon is limited to. Empty means any.

CustomerId.description: The id of the one customer (user id or guest customer id) who may use the coupon, or null for anyone.

CustomerEmail.description: The email address of the one customer who may use the coupon, or null for anyone.

Coupons.description: The coupons to create, or to update when a stored coupon has the same code.

TemplateId.description: Required identifier or name of an AI template whose source is Profile. The template is applied first, then any properties in this object override the generated profile.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier. If provided, used to find an existing profile to update.

Source.description: Overrides the AI provider source name.

Name.description: Overrides the profile name.

DisplayText.description: Overrides the human-readable profile display name.

WelcomeMessage.description: Overrides the initial greeting shown to users.

TitleType.description: Overrides how the session title is generated.

PromptTemplate.description: Overrides the Liquid template for TemplatePrompt profiles.

ChatDeploymentName.description: Overrides the chat deployment technical name.

UtilityDeploymentName.description: Overrides the utility deployment technical name.

Properties.description: Overrides extended profile properties. Known metadata objects are listed here, and additional feature-specific objects are also allowed.

AgentMetadata.description: Known agent metadata for agent profiles.

Availability.description: Controls whether the agent is only available when selected or always injected into orchestration.

AllowToolInvocation.description: When true, the agent runs its own selected tools when another assistant calls it. When false or missing, it runs without tools.

AIProfileMetadata.description: Known prompt and model tuning metadata for the profile.

InitialPrompt.description: Optional initial prompt automatically injected for chat profiles.

SystemMessage.description: The system instructions for the profile.

PastMessagesCount.description: Number of prior chat messages to include in context.

UseCaching.description: Whether distributed caching is enabled for the profile when the tenant allows it.

FunctionInvocationMetadata.description: Known tool selection metadata for the profile.

Names.description: Tool names that can be invoked by this profile.

AgentInvocationMetadata.description: Known on-demand agent selections for the profile.

Names.description: Agent profile names that can be invoked by this profile.

PromptTemplateMetadata.description: Known prompt template selections applied before or alongside the system message.

Parameters.description: Template parameter values. Keys are parameter names and values are strings.

Templates.description: Ordered prompt template selections for the profile.

AIPersonaMetadata.description: The AI persona this resource links to, by the persona's technical name. Applied when the AI Personas feature is enabled.

PersonaId.description: Technical name of the linked persona.

Parameters.description: Liquid arguments used when rendering the persona instructions.

AnalyticsMetadata.description: Known analytics and outcome tracking metadata for chat profiles.

Name.description: Unique goal key.

Description.description: Goal description used for scoring guidance.

ConversionGoals.description: Configured conversion goals for chat analytics.

DataSourceMetadata.description: Known external data source selection for retrieval augmentation.

DataSourceId.description: Identifier of the selected AI data source.

AIDataSourceRagMetadata.description: Known retrieval augmentation parameters for an attached AI data source.

IsInScope.description: Whether answers must stay within the retrieved documents.

Filter.description: Optional OData filter applied to retrieved data.

ObjectTypes.description: Optional object types (for example content types) the retrieved documents are limited to. Empty searches every type.

AIProfileSessionDocumentsMetadata.description: Known session upload capabilities for the profile.

DocumentsMetadata.description: Known profile document attachments and retrieval behavior.

ContentType.description: Document MIME type.

Documents.description: Documents explicitly attached to the profile.

DocumentTopN.description: How many top document matches to include.

MaxIndexableCharacters.description: Optional limit on the characters of a document that are indexed. Null uses the site default.

DescribeFiguresInUploads.description: Whether figures in uploaded documents are described by an AI model while indexing. Null uses the site default.

MemoryMetadata.description: Known AI memory configuration for the profile.

EnableUserMemory.description: Whether user memory is enabled for the profile. Null uses the site default.

EnableSessionMemory.description: Whether the profile keeps a memory of the current session. Null uses the site default.

EnablePastConversations.description: Whether the profile may recall the user's past conversations. Null uses the site default.

ClaudeSessionMetadata.description: Known Claude orchestrator overrides when the AI Claude Orchestrator feature is enabled.

ClaudeModel.description: Claude model override for this profile.

CopilotSessionMetadata.description: Known Copilot orchestrator overrides when the AI Copilot Orchestrator feature is enabled.

CopilotModel.description: Copilot model override for this profile.

IsAllowAll.description: Whether Copilot should run with the allow-all flag.

AIDeploymentParametersMetadata.description: Values of the model parameters the profile's deployments expose (for example reasoningEffort), keyed by the parameter's technical name.

Values.description: Parameter values sent with requests to the chat deployment.

UtilityValues.description: Parameter values sent with requests to the utility deployment.

AIProfileMcpMetadata.description: Known MCP connection selections for this profile.

ToolNames.description: Per connection identifier, the names of the tools the profile may use from it. A connection with no entry, or a null entry, exposes every tool; an empty array exposes none.

AIProfileA2AMetadata.description: Known A2A connection selections for this profile.

Settings.description: Overrides profile settings. Known settings objects are listed here, and additional feature-specific settings are also allowed.

LockSystemMessage.description: Prevents recipe or editor updates from changing the system message.

IsListable.description: Whether the profile is listed in the admin UI. Defaults to true.

IsRemovable.description: Controls whether the profile can be deleted from the admin UI.

InitialResponseHandlerName.description: Initial non-AI response handler to invoke before the main orchestrator.

IsOnAdminMenu.description: Whether the chat profile appears on the Orchard admin menu.

EnableDataExtraction.description: Enables extracting structured values from chat sessions.

ExtractionCheckInterval.description: How often data extraction runs during the session.

SessionInactivityTimeoutInMinutes.description: How long the session must be inactive before final extraction runs.

Name.description: Unique extraction key.

AllowMultipleValues.description: Whether multiple values can be captured.

IsUpdatable.description: Whether later session turns can update the extracted value.

FieldType.description: The type of the extracted value. Enum and List values are limited to AllowedValues.

AllowedValues.description: The values an Enum or List field may take.

ToolInstanceNames.description: Tool instances available to post-session processing.

Name.description: Unique task key.

Type.description: How the task result is generated.

AllowMultipleValues.description: Whether the task can return multiple values.

Value.description: Predefined option value.

Options.description: Predefined options used when Type is PredefinedOptions.

ToolInstanceNames.description: Tool instances the task may call.

PostSessionTasks.description: Tasks executed after the chat session closes.

ChatMode.description: Preferred input mode for this profile.

ConversationDeploymentName.description: Optional technical name of the speech-to-speech (realtime) deployment used in conversation mode. Leave empty to use the site default.

VoiceName.description: Optional speech synthesis voice for conversation mode.

EnableTextToSpeechPlayback.description: Whether assistant responses should be played back with text-to-speech.

AIProfileGuardrailSettings.description: Topic guardrails: what the assistant must not discuss, checked on the customer's messages, the replies, or both.

CheckCustomer.description: Whether the customer's messages are checked against the topics.

CheckReplies.description: Whether the assistant's replies are checked against the topics before they are sent.

Topics.description: Identifiers of the guardrail topics: System Prompt templates in the 'Guardrail topic' category.

OtherTopics.description: Other topics refused, described in a sentence or two, for this profile alone.

PlaceholderReply.description: What the assistant says instead when a guardrail triggers. Empty uses a default.

AIProfileDataPrivacySettings.description: What the profile's conversations keep once they end.

StorageMode.description: Everything keeps the transcript; RedactPersonalData removes personal data from it; MetadataOnly keeps only the conversation's metadata.

StorageModeSinceUtc.description: When the storage mode last changed (ISO 8601, UTC). Conversations active after it get the mode. Set by the admin when the mode changes.

RetentionDays.description: Days without activity after which a conversation is deleted. Null keeps conversations.

NamesToKeep.description: Names that are not personal data and are kept when personal data is redacted, such as the assistant's, the business's and its staff's names.

AIProfileSpeakingStyleSettings.description: The speaking styles the assistant follows.

Styles.description: Identifiers of System Prompt templates in the 'Speaking style' category, for example speaking-style-echo-verification, speaking-style-nato-spelling, speaking-style-speech-normalization, speaking-style-fuzzy-name-matching, speaking-style-ai-disclosure, speaking-style-scope-limits, speaking-style-filler-words or speaking-style-high-empathy.

AIProfileSpeechSettings.description: How the assistant speaks and listens in voice conversations.

SpeakingRate.description: How fast the profile speaks, as a multiple of the voice's normal pace (1 is normal), clamped to 0.25-4. Null uses the deployment's own pace.

SpeakingEmotion.description: Emotion the voice speaks with, as one word such as calm or excited, for providers with an emotion control (Cartesia). Others ignore it.

Text.description: The word or phrase to pronounce differently.

MatchCase.description: Whether Text matches only with the same letter case.

PronunciationEntries.description: Pronunciation replacements applied before text is spoken.

FallbackTextToSpeechDeploymentName.description: Technical name of the text-to-speech deployment used when the primary one fails.

BoostedKeywords.description: Words the speech recognizer is biased toward, such as product names.

RecognitionLanguages.description: Languages the recognizer should expect, as BCP-47 tags. The first is the primary language.

InterruptionSensitivity.description: How readily the caller's speech interrupts the assistant, from 0 (never interrupted) to 1 (any caller speech interrupts it). Null uses the default.

EnableBackchanneling.description: Whether the assistant says short acknowledgements while the caller speaks.

BackchannelPhrases.description: The acknowledgements used for backchanneling. Empty uses a small built-in set.

AIProfileLanguageSettings.description: The languages the assistant may speak.

AllowedLanguages.description: Languages the profile may converse in, as BCP-47 tags. Empty means no restriction.

StartingLanguage.description: BCP-47 tag of the language a conversation starts in. A conversation language set by the host (for example from a conversation variable) overrides it.

AIProfileFlowSettings.description: The conversation flow: a workflow whose AI conversation stages guide the conversation.

WorkflowTypeId.description: Identifier of the workflow type that starts with an AI Conversation Flow Started event and holds the stages. Empty turns the flow off.

Flexible.description: Whether every stage's instructions are given at once, so a caller who jumps between tasks is followed, rather than only the current stage's.

AIProfileContactMemorySettings.description: The memory the assistant keeps about each CRM contact.

UseMemory.description: Whether what is remembered about the contact is given to the assistant.

SaveMemory.description: Whether the memory is updated after each conversation.

AIProfileContactFieldMappingSettings.description: Copies extracted values onto the CRM contact when the conversation closes.

FieldName.description: Name of the data extraction entry the value comes from.

ContactField.description: The contact field the value is written to.

Mode.description: Whether the value replaces the field, fills it only when empty, or is appended to it.

Mappings.description: The mappings, one per extracted value.

PromptSecurityProfileSettings.description: Per-profile overrides of the site's chat rate limits. A null member uses the site setting.

MaxMessagesPerWindow.description: Most messages a signed-in user may send per RateLimitWindow.

RateLimitWindow.description: The message rate limit window, as a time span such as 00:01:00.

Limit.description: How many are allowed in the window.

Window.description: The window, as a time span such as 00:01:00.

AnonymousMessageRateLimitTiers.description: Message limits for anonymous visitors; every tier applies.

Limit.description: How many are allowed in the window.

Window.description: The window, as a time span such as 00:01:00.

AnonymousSessionStartRateLimitTiers.description: Session start limits for anonymous visitors; every tier applies.

MaxAnonymousSessionsPerWindow.description: Most sessions an anonymous visitor may start per AnonymousSessionRateLimitWindow.

AnonymousSessionRateLimitWindow.description: The anonymous session window, as a time span such as 01:00:00.

WebMcpProfileSettings.description: Whether the profile may use the tools the visitor's page offers through WebMCP.

AllowPageTools.description: Whether the assistant may call the page's tools.

AllowConsequentialPageTools.description: Whether the assistant may also call page tools that change something (consequential tools).

Profiles.description: The AI profiles to create or update from Profile templates. Each entry starts from the selected template and then applies any explicitly provided overrides.

Id.description: Optional unique identifier for the index profile.

Name.description: Unique index profile name.

ProviderName.description: Index provider name, such as Lucene, Elasticsearch, or AzureAI.

Type.description: Index profile type used by the target feature or indexing task.

Indexes.description: Index profiles to create or update.

PolicyId.description: The identifier of the policy. A policy with the same identifier, or else with the same name, is updated; otherwise a policy is created.

Name.description: The unique name of the policy.

OwnerId.description: The identifier of the user who owns the policy, for example "[js: parameters('AdminUserId')]".

Author.description: The user name of the author of the policy, for example "[js: parameters('AdminUsername')]".

Scope.description: Which requests the policy limits: every request, the requests to one path, or the endpoints of a rate-limit group.

Path.description: The request path that starts with '/'. Required when the scope is 'Endpoint'.

GroupName.description: The rate-limit group of the endpoints. Required when the scope is 'Group'.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the policy is enforced.

EnabledUtc.description: The UTC date and time when the policy was enabled. Set automatically when omitted.

Id.description: The identifier of the limiter, for example "[js: uuid()]".

Source.description: The algorithm of the limiter.

PermitLimit.description: The number of requests allowed in a window.

WindowSeconds.description: The length of the window, in seconds.

QueueLimit.description: The number of requests that wait when the limit is reached.

PermitLimit.description: The number of requests allowed in a window.

WindowSeconds.description: The length of the window, in seconds.

SegmentsPerWindow.description: The number of segments the window is divided into.

QueueLimit.description: The number of requests that wait when the limit is reached.

TokenLimit.description: The maximum number of tokens in the bucket.

TokensPerPeriod.description: The number of tokens added at each period.

ReplenishmentPeriodSeconds.description: The period between two replenishments, in seconds.

QueueLimit.description: The number of requests that wait when no token is left.

QueueProcessingOrder.description: The order in which queued requests are processed.

PermitLimit.description: The number of requests processed at the same time.

QueueLimit.description: The number of requests that wait when the limit is reached.

QueueProcessingOrder.description: The order in which queued requests are processed.

Properties.description: The settings of the limiter, under the name of the data type of its algorithm.

Limiters.description: The limiters of the policy. A request must be allowed by every limiter.

policies.description: The rate-limit policies to create or update.

items.description: A currency, matched by ItemId, then by its code.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the currency. When it matches a stored currency, that currency is updated. Otherwise a new currency is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The three-letter ISO-4217 currency code in upper case, for example USD. A currency without a matching ItemId is matched by this code.

DisplayName.description: The friendly name shown in currency dropdowns, for example US Dollar.

Currencies.description: The currencies to create or update.

then.description: Each additional property is a custom settings content type name with its content item data.

ContentType.description: Custom user settings content type to create or update for the user.

items.description: Single custom user settings content item payload.

user-custom-user-settings.description: Custom user settings content items assigned to the user.

items.description: Custom settings group for one user.

additionalProperties.description: Groups of users and their custom settings items.

then.description: Each additional property can use any collection name and must contain an array of user custom settings entries.

items.description: A guest customer, matched by ItemId, then by the email of a guest. It needs a name, a company or an email. Every member is replaced, so omitted ones are cleared. Customers linked to a user account, erased or merged are left as they are.

ItemId.description: The stable identifier of the customer. Preserved across environments; generated when empty or invalid.

Kind.description: Whether the customer is a person or a business.

DisplayName.description: The name shown for the customer. When empty, the person's name or the company name is shown.

CompanyName.description: The company name of a business customer.

TaxId.description: The tax identifier of a business customer.

IsTaxExempt.description: Whether the customer is exempt from tax.

TaxExemptionReason.description: Why the customer is exempt from tax, such as a resale certificate number, for the store's records.

Email.description: The customer's email. A guest with the same email is updated rather than duplicated.

AddressId.description: The identifier of the address within the customer's address book. Generated when empty. 'DefaultBillingAddressId' and 'DefaultShippingAddressId' refer to it.

Label.description: A label for the address, for example 'Home' or 'Office'.

Name.description: The name of the recipient.

AddressLine2.description: The second street address line, such as an apartment or suite.

DependentLocality.description: The dependent locality, such as a neighborhood, where the country uses one.

SortingCode.description: The sorting code, where the country uses one.

Country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example 'US' or 'CA'.

Region.description: The state, province or region code, for example 'WA' or 'ON'.

County.description: The county, where the country uses one.

District.description: The district, where the country uses one.

Phone.description: The phone number for deliveries to this address.

Latitude.description: The latitude, when the address was geocoded or pinned on a map.

Longitude.description: The longitude, when the address was geocoded or pinned on a map.

GeocodedUtc.description: When the coordinates were found, in UTC.

GeocodeSource.description: Where the coordinates came from, such as a geocoding provider's name or 'Manual'.

Addresses.description: The customer's address book. It replaces the stored one.

DefaultBillingAddressId.description: The 'AddressId' of the default billing address.

DefaultShippingAddressId.description: The 'AddressId' of the default shipping address.

Customers.description: The customers to add or update.

ItemId.description: Optional identifier of the connection. When it matches a stored connection, that connection is updated; otherwise the connection is matched by Name. A new connection keeps this identifier when it is up to 26 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, and gets a generated one otherwise.

Name.description: Technical name of the connection: a letter, then letters, digits and underscores. A connection without a matching ItemId is matched by this name. Made from DisplayText when omitted.

DisplayText.description: Name of the connection shown in the admin UI.

Connector.description: The connector the connection uses. Its feature must be enabled. An existing connection's connector can't change.

Server.description: The server name or address, with an optional instance or port.

Authentication.description: How the site signs in, by name or by position from 0: SqlLogin, Integrated, EntraServicePrincipal, EntraManagedIdentity or EntraDefault. SqlLogin and EntraServicePrincipal take their password or client secret from the 'Password' secret.

UserName.description: The login name, the client id of a service principal, or the client id of a user-assigned managed identity.

TrustServerCertificate.description: Whether the server's certificate is trusted without validation.

ReadOnlyIntent.description: Whether the connection declares read-only intent, so it can be routed to a readable secondary.

ConnectTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for a connection.

SqlServerConnectionSettings.description: The settings of a SqlServer connection.

BaseUrl.description: The base address the data sets' paths are resolved against.

Authentication.description: How requests authenticate. Its secrets (such as Password, ApiKey, BearerToken or ClientSecret) travel in Secrets.

TimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for a response.

HttpConnectionSettings.description: The settings of an HttpApi connection.

MediaFilesConnectionSettings.description: The settings of a MediaFiles connection.

ElasticsearchDataConnectionSettings.description: The settings of an Elasticsearch connection.

Properties.description: The connector's settings, keyed by the name of their type, as a deployment plan exports them. Each settings object given replaces the stored one; settings not given are kept. Enumerations travel as their names.

Secrets.description: The connection's secrets in clear text, keyed by name (for example Password, ApiKey, BearerToken or ClientSecret). They are encrypted when stored. A deployment plan never exports them; an empty or missing secret keeps the one already stored.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp to preserve when importing exported records.

ModifiedUtc.description: Optional last-modified timestamp to preserve when importing exported records.

Author.description: Optional author name recorded with the connection.

Connections.description: The data connections to create or update.

PipelineId.description: The identifier of the pipeline, at most 26 characters. An existing pipeline with this identifier gets the imported definition as its draft; otherwise a pipeline is created, with a new identifier when none is given.

Name.description: The name of the pipeline.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the pipeline can run.

StepId.description: The identifier of the step in the pipeline, referenced by the connections.

Type.description: The type of the step, for example 'DataSource' or 'CreateFile'.

Title.description: The title of the step shown in the designer.

X.description: The horizontal position of the step in the designer.

Y.description: The vertical position of the step in the designer.

Properties.description: The settings of the step, under the name of their type, for example { "DataSourceStepSettings": { "Source": "Contents", "DataSet": "BlogPost" } }. Settings whose names start with 'Protected' hold secrets, which are not exported: enter them again before publishing.

SourceStepId.description: The identifier of the step whose output is connected.

SourcePort.description: The output port of the source step, for example 'Output'.

TargetStepId.description: The identifier of the step that receives the rows.

TargetPort.description: The input port of the target step, for example 'Input'.

Connections.description: The connections between the ports of the steps.

Definition.description: The steps and connections of the pipeline. The definition is imported as a draft and runs only once a user publishes it.

Pipelines.description: The data pipelines to create or update.

IncludeAll.description: When true, all deployments will be removed.

DeploymentNames.description: Specific deployment names to delete. Ignored when IncludeAll is true.

ContentTypes.description: Content type names to delete.

ContentParts.description: Reusable content part names to delete.

Name.description: Deployment plan name.

Type.description: The deployment step type name, which is the step's CLR type name, for example ContentDeploymentStep. The well known payload of 'Step' depends on this value.

Step.description: The deployment step payload. The well known members depend on the value of 'Type'. Marker steps that export everything of a kind use an empty object.

items.description: A deployment step that belongs to the plan.

Step.description: AI Personas step. Exports all or the selected saved AI personas. Persona files ship with the code and are not exported. Payload for the 'AIPersonaDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all saved AI personas and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

PersonaIds.description: The item ids of the saved AI personas to export when IncludeAll is false.

Step.description: Child tenant access step. Exports who in the parent tenant may sign in to child tenants, and with which roles there. Payload for the 'AccessGrantsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Accounts step. Exports every account with its members, locations and other parts, and optionally the records the accounts hold. Payload for the 'AccountsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeRecords.description: Whether the records the accounts hold, such as their contacts and opportunities, are exported too.

Step.description: All admin templates step. Exports every admin template. Payload for the 'AllAdminTemplatesDeploymentStep' deployment step.

ExportAsFiles.description: When true, exports each admin template as a separate file rather than embedding them in the recipe.

Step.description: All content step. Exports every content item on the tenant. Payload for the 'AllContentDeploymentStep' deployment step.

ExportAsSetupRecipe.description: When true, exports the content in a form suitable for a setup recipe, resetting owner and identifier information.

Step.description: All features step. Exports the list of enabled features. Payload for the 'AllFeaturesDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IgnoreDisabledFeatures.description: When true, the exported recipe only enables features and does not disable any that are currently off.

Step.description: All Rate Limit Policies step. Exports every rate-limit policy as a 'CreateOrUpdateRateLimitPolicies' recipe step. Payload for the 'AllRateLimitPoliciesDeploymentStep' deployment step.
All templates step. Exports every front end template. Payload for the 'AllTemplatesDeploymentStep' deployment step.

ExportAsFiles.description: When true, exports each template as a separate file rather than embedding them in the recipe.

Step.description: Asset types and assets step. Exports every asset type, and every asset with its owner, place and parent. Payload for the 'AssetsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAssets.description: When true, exports the assets too.

Step.description: Azure AI Search index settings step. Exports the settings of the selected Azure AI Search indexes. Payload for the 'AzureAISearchIndexDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Azure AI Search indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the Azure AI Search indexes to export.

Step.description: Azure AI Search index rebuild step. Instructs the target to rebuild the selected Azure AI Search indexes. Payload for the 'AzureAISearchIndexRebuildDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Azure AI Search indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

Indices.description: The names of the Azure AI Search indexes to rebuild.

Step.description: Azure AI Search index reset step. Instructs the target to reset the selected Azure AI Search indexes. Payload for the 'AzureAISearchIndexResetDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Azure AI Search indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

Indices.description: The names of the Azure AI Search indexes to reset.

Step.description: Booking dates step. Exports the booking products' upcoming open dates with their capacity and price. Payload for the 'BookingDatesDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Calendars step. Exports every calendar, optionally with its events and everyone's categories. Payload for the 'CalendarsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeEvents.description: When true, exports the events of each calendar too, up to 10,000 per calendar.

IncludeCategories.description: When true (the default), exports everyone's categories too, so the events keep their colors.

Step.description: Content definitions step. Exports the selected content type and content part definitions. Payload for the 'ContentDefinitionDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all content type and content part definitions and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

ContentTypes.description: The technical names of the content type definitions to export.

ContentParts.description: The technical names of the content part definitions to export.

Step.description: Content step. Exports the content items of the selected content types. Payload for the 'ContentDeploymentStep' deployment step.

ContentTypes.description: The technical names of the content types whose items are exported.

ExportAsSetupRecipe.description: When true, exports the content in a form suitable for a setup recipe, resetting owner and identifier information.

Step.description: Content item step. Exports a single content item selected by its identifier. Payload for the 'ContentItemDeploymentStep' deployment step.

ContentItemId.description: The identifier of the content item to export.

Step.description: Coupons step. Exports every coupon and automatic discount, without how often it was used. Payload for the 'CouponsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Custom file step. Adds an arbitrary text file, with the supplied content, to the deployment package. Payload for the 'CustomFileDeploymentStep' deployment step.

FileName.description: The name of the file written to the deployment package.

FileContent.description: The text content of the file.

Step.description: Custom settings step. Exports the site settings for the selected custom settings types. Payload for the 'CustomSettingsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all custom settings types and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

SettingsTypeNames.description: The technical names of the custom settings content types to export.

Step.description: Custom user settings step. Exports the custom user settings for the selected settings types. Payload for the 'CustomUserSettingsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all custom user settings types and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

SettingsTypeNames.description: The technical names of the custom user settings content types to export.

Step.description: Customers step. Exports the guest and business customers with their addresses. Customers with a user account, and erased or merged customers, are left out. Payload for the 'CustomersDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Data Pipelines step. Exports the data pipelines with their published definition, or their draft when they were never published. The secrets of the steps are not exported. Payload for the 'DataPipelinesDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all data pipelines, including the ones created after the step was added to the plan, and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

PipelineIds.description: The identifiers of the data pipelines to export when 'IncludeAll' is false.

Step.description: Delete content definitions step. Deletes the selected content type and content part definitions on the target. Payload for the 'DeleteContentDefinitionDeploymentStep' deployment step.

ContentTypes.description: The technical names of the content type definitions to delete.

ContentParts.description: The technical names of the content part definitions to delete.

Step.description: Deployment plans step. Exports the selected deployment plans. Payload for the 'DeploymentPlanDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all deployment plans and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

DeploymentPlanNames.description: The names of the deployment plans to export.

Step.description: Elasticsearch index settings step. Exports the settings of the selected Elasticsearch indexes. Payload for the 'ElasticsearchIndexDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Elasticsearch indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the Elasticsearch indexes to export.

Step.description: Elasticsearch index rebuild step. Instructs the target to rebuild the selected Elasticsearch indexes. Payload for the 'ElasticsearchIndexRebuildDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Elasticsearch indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

Indices.description: The names of the Elasticsearch indexes to rebuild.

Step.description: Elasticsearch index reset step. Instructs the target to reset the selected Elasticsearch indexes. Payload for the 'ElasticsearchIndexResetDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Elasticsearch indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

Indices.description: The names of the Elasticsearch indexes to reset.

Step.description: Exemption certificates step. Exports customers' tax exemption certificates with their types, jurisdictions and dates. Payload for the 'ExemptionCertificateDeploymentStep' deployment step.
File sources step. Exports every file source with its connector settings. Passwords, keys and other secrets are never exported. Payload for the 'FileSourcesDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Service territories step. Exports every service territory, with its shape or postal codes, parent and time zone. Payload for the 'GeoDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Index profile settings step. Exports the settings of the selected index profiles. Payload for the 'IndexProfileDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all index profiles and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the index profiles to export.

Step.description: JSON recipe step. Adds the supplied raw JSON recipe steps to the deployment package. Payload for the 'JsonRecipeDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Json.description: The raw JSON, containing one or more recipe steps, added to the deployment package.

Step.description: Local DNC lists step. Exports every imported local do-not-call list with its phone numbers. Phone numbers are personal data. Payload for the 'LocalDncListsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Loyalty points step. Exports every customer's loyalty points, with their activity. Payload for the 'LoyaltyAccountsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Lucene index settings step. Exports the settings of the selected Lucene indexes. Payload for the 'LuceneIndexDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Lucene indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the Lucene indexes to export.

Step.description: Lucene index rebuild step. Instructs the target to rebuild the selected Lucene indexes. Payload for the 'LuceneIndexRebuildDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Lucene indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the Lucene indexes to rebuild.

Step.description: Lucene index reset step. Instructs the target to reset the selected Lucene indexes. Payload for the 'LuceneIndexResetDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Lucene indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the Lucene indexes to reset.

Step.description: Marketing segments and campaigns step. Exports every marketing segment and campaign. Campaigns are exported without their status and counts, and import as drafts. Payload for the 'MarketingDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Markets step. Exports every market with its countries, currency, exchange rate and rounding. Payload for the 'MarketsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Media step. Exports the selected media files and directories. Payload for the 'MediaDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all media files and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

FilePaths.description: The paths of the individual media files to export.

DirectoryPaths.description: The paths of the media directories to export, including their contents.

Step.description: Memberships step. Exports every membership with its member by user name, its product, roles and dates. Payload for the 'MembershipsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Tax registrations step. Exports the store's own tax registrations with their jurisdictions, numbers and thresholds. Payload for the 'MerchantTaxRegistrationDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Messaging broadcasts step. Exports every broadcast with its message and recipients, without its status or counts. Broadcasts import as drafts, so nothing is sent. Payload for the 'MessagingBroadcastsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Price Lists step. Exports every price list with its prices. Payload for the 'PriceListsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Query based content step. Exports the content items returned by a named query. Payload for the 'QueryBasedContentDeploymentStep' deployment step.

QueryName.description: The name of the query whose returned content items are exported.

QueryParameters.description: A JSON object, serialized as a string, holding the parameter values passed to the query.

ExportAsSetupRecipe.description: When true, exports the content in a form suitable for a setup recipe, resetting owner and identifier information.

Step.description: Index rebuild step. Instructs the target to rebuild the selected index profiles. Payload for the 'RebuildIndexDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all index profiles and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the index profiles to rebuild.

Step.description: Recipe metadata step. Writes the recipe metadata, such as name, author and version, into the exported recipe file. Payload for the 'RecipeFileDeploymentStep' deployment step.

DisplayName.description: The human readable recipe name.

Description.description: A description explaining what the recipe does.

WebSite.description: A website URL associated with the recipe.

IsSetupRecipe.description: Whether the recipe can be used to set up a new tenant.

Categories.description: A comma separated list of categories the recipe belongs to.

Tags.description: A comma separated list of tags describing the recipe.

Step.description: Referral codes step. Exports every customer's referral code, with the referrals it earned. Payload for the 'ReferralProfilesDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Registers step. Exports every point-of-sale register with its store location, address, currency and roles. Payload for the 'RegistersDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Replace content definitions step. Exports the selected content type and content part definitions so they replace, rather than merge with, the definitions on the target. Payload for the 'ReplaceContentDefinitionDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all content type and content part definitions and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

ContentTypes.description: The technical names of the content type definitions to export.

ContentParts.description: The technical names of the content part definitions to export.

Step.description: Designed Reports and Views step. Exports designed reports, the views they read and their report groups. Share links are never exported. Payload for the 'ReportDesignsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all reports, views and report groups and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

ReportIds.description: The itemIds of the reports to export when IncludeAll is false. Their groups and every view they read are exported too.

ViewIds.description: The itemIds of extra views to export when IncludeAll is false. The views they read are exported too.

Step.description: Index reset step. Instructs the target to reset the selected index profiles. Payload for the 'ResetIndexDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all index profiles and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the index profiles to reset.

Step.description: Scheduling step. Exports appointment types and scheduling resources, and optionally the appointments and the waitlist. Payload for the 'SchedulingDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAppointments.description: When true, exports every appointment too, with its customer's details but without its manage link.

IncludeWaitlist.description: When true, exports the waitlist too.

Step.description: Secrets step. Exports the secrets. Without an encryption key, only their metadata is exported, and the importing site reads the values from its configuration. Payload for the 'SecretsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

EncryptionKeyName.description: The name of the RsaKeySecret or X509Secret that holds the public key of the destination. When set, the secret values are exported encrypted with it; otherwise only the metadata is exported.

Step.description: Shipping zones step. Exports every shipping zone with its countries, regions and shipping methods. Payload for the 'ShippingZonesDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Site settings step. Exports the selected sections of the site settings. Payload for the 'SiteSettingsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Settings.description: The names of the site settings sections to export, for example BaseUrl or TimeZoneId.

Step.description: Skills and certifications step. Exports every skill and certification, and optionally the skills and certificates people hold. Payload for the 'SkillsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAssignments.description: When true, exports the skills people hold too, with the skill name so they import on another site.

IncludeCertificationRecords.description: When true, exports the certificates people hold too.

Step.description: Stock locations step. Exports the store's own stock locations, with their ids, so stock and registers keep pointing at them. Payload for the 'StockLocationsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Store credit step. Exports every customer's store credit, with its balance and activity. Payload for the 'StoreCreditAccountsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Teams step. Exports every team, with its parent by name. Payload for the 'TeamsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Time stages, categories and entries step. Exports the time categories and stages, and optionally the entries of the last days. Payload for the 'TimeTrackerDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeEntries.description: When true, exports the time entries too.

Days.description: How many days back entries are exported.

Step.description: Data translations step. Exports the data localization translations for the selected cultures and categories. Payload for the 'TranslationsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all cultures and categories and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

Cultures.description: The culture codes whose translations are exported, for example fr-FR.

Step.description: Vendors step. Exports every marketplace vendor with its users by name and its commission. Payout accounts are not exported. Payload for the 'VendorsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Web crawlers step. Exports every web crawler with its crawl settings. Secrets are never exported. Payload for the 'WebCrawlersDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Webhook subscriptions step. Exports every webhook subscription without its signing secret. Payload for the 'WebhookSubscriptionsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Work order settings step. Exports work order types, checklists, service levels and sub-statuses, and service agreements when asked. Payload for the 'WorkOrdersDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAgreements.description: When true, exports the agreements too.

Step.description: Adherence rule sets step. Exports every adherence rule set, with the teams it applies to and its rules. Payload for the 'WorkforceAdherenceDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Workforce teams and workers step. Exports the activity codes and the team hierarchy, and optionally the workers. Payload for the 'WorkforceDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeWorkers.description: When true, exports every worker too, with their teams by name. Sensitive details such as the date of birth are left out.

Step.description: Forecasting setup step. Exports every planning group, forecast event and capacity plan. Payload for the 'WorkforceForecastingDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Workforce settings step. Exports shift templates, rotations, coverage requirements, time-off settings, time clock settings (with kiosks, never their tokens, and the payroll CSV columns) and labor rule sets, for the features that are on. Payload for the 'WorkforceSettingsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Steps.description: Deployment steps that belong to the plan.

Plans.description: Deployment plans to create or update.

items.description: A file to store privately and add to a product's digital files. A product that already has a file of that name (without case sensitivity) keeps it, so running the recipe again adds nothing.

ProductId.description: The content item id of the product the file is delivered with. The latest version of the product is updated.

FileName.description: The name the file is stored and downloaded under, such as manual.pdf. Unsafe characters are removed.

Base64.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded. Takes precedence over Text.

Text.description: The file's content as UTF-8 text, used when Base64 is not given.

Files.description: The files to add. Each must be between 1 byte and 10 MB.

Name.description: Logical translation set name.

Context.description: Optional localization context used to disambiguate the translation key.

Key.description: Translation key to replace or add.

Value.description: Localized value to store for the key.

items.description: A named dynamic-data translation entry.

Translations.description: Dynamic data translation entries to import.

IncludeAll.description: When true, rebuild all Elasticsearch indexes and ignore the Indices list.

Indices.description: Specific Elasticsearch index names to rebuild when IncludeAll is false.

IncludeAll.description: When true, reset all Elasticsearch indexes and ignore the Indices list.

Indices.description: Specific Elasticsearch index names to reset when IncludeAll is false.
Elasticsearch index definitions to create or update. Each object is forwarded to the index settings handler.

then.description: Creates or updates customers' tax exemption certificates, matched by ItemId, then by customer and number. Import the customers first.

items.description: A customer's tax exemption certificate.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The certificate's name.

CustomerId.description: The id of the customer the certificate belongs to.

ExemptionType.description: The kind of exemption, such as Resale.

Status.description: The certificate's status: only an active certificate exempts.

TaxTypes.description: The tax types it exempts from, or none for every type.

JurisdictionIds.description: The jurisdictions it applies in, or none for every one.

ClassificationCodes.description: The product classification codes it covers, or none for every product.

ExemptionCertificates.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

AppSecret.description: Facebook application secret. The step stores the value as given, and Orchard Core decrypts it with the tenant's Data Protection keys, so a clear value does not work. Prefer a secret: create it with the 'Secrets' step and reference it with 'AppSecretSecretName' in the 'FacebookSettings' property of the 'Settings' step.

SdkJs.description: Optional URL override for the Facebook JavaScript SDK.

FBInit.description: Whether Orchard should emit the FB.init JavaScript bootstrap call.

FBInitParams.description: JSON object serialized as the arguments for FB.init.

Version.description: Facebook Graph API version to target, for example 'v20.0'.

CallbackPath.description: Relative callback path that Facebook redirects back to after sign-in.

Id.description: Optional unique identifier for the feature profile.

Name.description: Display name of the feature profile.

FeatureRules.description: Rules that determine which features belong to the profile.

FeatureProfiles.description: Dictionary of tenant feature profiles keyed by their technical name.

then.description: Creates or updates file sources, matched by ItemId, then by DisplayText within the same connector. The connector must be enabled on the site.

items.description: A file source: the connector it reads with, the AI data source it feeds and the connector's settings in Properties.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Source.description: The name of the ingestion connector, such as 'FileSystem', 'Ftp' or 'Sftp'.

DisplayText.description: The name of the file source.

AIDataSourceId.description: The id of the AI data source the files are indexed into. Import the data sources first.

Enabled.description: Whether the file source runs.

ReindexIntervalMinutes.description: How often the files are read again, in minutes.

Properties.description: The connector's settings, such as the folder to read. Passwords and keys left out keep the stored ones.

Sources.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

then.description: Creates or updates service territories. Territories are matched by ItemId only; an existing territory takes only the members given. List parent territories before their children.

items.description: A service territory: an area served together, drawn as a shape, listed as postal codes, or both.

ItemId.description: The territory's id. When it matches a stored territory, that territory is updated with the members given here; otherwise a new territory is created, keeping this id when it is a valid id so other records that point at it still do.

Name.description: The territory name.

ParentId.description: The ItemId of the territory it is part of.

Shape.description: The shape, as GeoJSON text: a Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry, Feature or FeatureCollection.

PostalCodes.description: The postal codes; one ending with * matches every code that starts with the rest.

TimeZoneId.description: The IANA time zone; null for the site's.

TravelSpeedKmh.description: The average travel speed in km/h; null for the site's.

items.description: A team or person that serves the territory.

Kind.description: The kind of member, by the module that owns it, such as Team or Worker.

Id.description: The member's identifier in the module that owns it.

Role.description: Whether the territory is theirs first or as a backup.

Members.description: The people and teams that serve it.

ConsumerSecret.description: GitHub OAuth application client secret. The step stores the value as given, and Orchard Core decrypts it with the tenant's Data Protection keys, so a clear value does not work. Prefer a secret: create it with the 'Secrets' step and reference it with 'ClientSecretSecretName' in the 'GitHubAuthenticationSettings' property of the 'Settings' step.

CallbackPath.description: Relative callback path that GitHub redirects back to after sign-in.

IncludeDisabledUsers.description: Whether disabled users are indexed too. By default only enabled users are.

BatchSize.description: How many users are re-saved per batch so their indexes are rebuilt. Defaults to 250; values over 1000 are capped at 1000.

Name.description: Layer name. Re-running the recipe with the same name updates the existing layer instead of creating a duplicate.

Description.description: Administrative description of when the layer should be used.

Rule.description: A legacy JavaScript rule expression, for example isHomepage(). Prefer 'LayerRule' for new layers; this is only used when 'LayerRule' is not supplied.

Name.description: An optional name for the rule shown in the layer editor.

ConditionId.description: A stable unique identifier for the rule. When omitted, one is generated when the recipe runs.

$type.description: The polymorphic condition type discriminator, for example OrchardCore.Rules.Models.UrlCondition, OrchardCore.Rules. Required so nested conditions deserialize correctly.

Name.description: The condition type name, for example UrlCondition. Used to resolve the condition factory when the recipe runs.

ConditionId.description: A stable unique identifier for the condition. When omitted, one is generated when the recipe runs.

$type.description: All conditions condition. A condition group that requires every nested condition to be true. Fixed '$type' for the 'AllConditionGroup' condition.
