then.description: Queues local do-not-call lists for import, as if their numbers were uploaded in a file. A list whose name and country already exist is skipped.

items.description: A local do-not-call list and its phone numbers.

Name.description: The name of the list. A list with the same name and country is skipped.

CountryCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code the numbers belong to, such as 'US'.

PhoneNumbers.description: The phone numbers, one per item.

then.description: Creates or updates customers' loyalty points, matched by ItemId, then by customer.

items.description: A customer's loyalty points.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

CustomerId.description: The id of the customer who holds the points. Import the customers first.

Activity.description: The points earned, spent, taken back and adjusted, oldest first.

Accounts.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

Indices.description: Lucene index definitions to create or update. Each object is forwarded to the Lucene index handler.

IncludeAll.description: When true, rebuild all Lucene indexes and ignore the Indices list.

Indices.description: Specific Lucene index names to rebuild when IncludeAll is false.

IncludeAll.description: When true, reset all Lucene indexes and ignore the Indices list.

Indices.description: Specific Lucene index names to reset when IncludeAll is false.

then.description: Creates or updates marketing campaigns, matched by ItemId. A new campaign is always a draft, and a campaign that is scheduled or sending is left as it is.

items.description: An email campaign to a segment.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The name of the campaign. Only staff see it.

SegmentId.description: The ItemId of the segment the campaign goes to. Import the segments first.

Campaigns.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

then.description: Creates or updates marketing segments, matched by ItemId.

items.description: A segment of customers, chosen by their orders, spending and country.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The name of the segment.

Rules.description: The rules a customer matches: MinOrders, MaxOrders, MinSpent, MaxSpent, LastOrderAtLeastDaysAgo, LastOrderWithinDays, FirstOrderWithinDays and Country (a two-letter code).

Segments.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

then.description: Creates or updates markets, matched by ItemId, then by name. A country can be in one market only.

items.description: A market: the countries it sells to, in one currency.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The market's name, such as Europe.

Countries.description: The two-letter country codes the market covers. A country is in one market only.

Currency.description: The three-letter currency code prices are shown and charged in.

ExchangeRate.description: How much of the market's currency one unit of the store's currency is worth.

Rounding.description: How converted prices are rounded: None, WholeUnits, EndIn99 or EndIn95.

Culture.description: The language shoppers in the market see, or none to keep theirs.

PricesIncludeTax.description: Whether the market's prices include tax.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the market is in use.

Markets.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

Resource.description: The MCP resource definition exposed to clients.

Properties.description: Source-specific resource metadata grouped by metadata object name. Known built-in metadata objects are FtpConnectionMetadata and SftpConnectionMetadata, and extra objects are allowed for future resource sources.

FtpConnectionMetadata.description: Known FTP connection settings for ftp:// MCP resources. Additional properties are allowed for provider-specific extensions.

Host.description: FTP or FTPS server host name.

Port.description: Optional FTP server port. Common defaults are 21 for FTP and 990 for implicit FTPS.

Username.description: Username used to authenticate to the FTP server.

Password.description: Password used to authenticate to the FTP server. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

EncryptionMode.description: FTP encryption mode. Use None for plain FTP, Explicit or Implicit for FTPS, or Auto to let the client decide.

DataConnectionType.description: FTP data channel mode used for directory listings and file transfers.

ValidateAnyCertificate.description: Whether to accept any SSL/TLS certificate, including self-signed certificates.

ReadTimeout.description: Read timeout in seconds for FTP operations.

RetryAttempts.description: How many times failed FTP operations should be retried.

SftpConnectionMetadata.description: Known SFTP connection settings for sftp:// MCP resources. Additional properties are allowed for provider-specific extensions.

Port.description: Optional SFTP server port. The usual default is 22.

Username.description: Username used to authenticate to the SFTP server.

Password.description: Password used for SFTP password authentication. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

PrivateKey.description: Private key payload used for SFTP key-based authentication. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

Passphrase.description: Optional passphrase for the private key. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

ProxyType.description: Optional proxy type used when the SFTP server is reached through a proxy.

ProxyHost.description: Proxy host name when ProxyType is not None.

ProxyPort.description: Proxy port when ProxyType is not None.

ProxyPassword.description: Optional proxy password. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

KeepAliveInterval.description: Optional keep-alive interval in seconds to keep idle SFTP sessions active.

Resources.description: The MCP resources to create or update.

TargetPath.description: Media library path where the file will be stored, for example 'images/logo.png'. It must be a relative file path without '..' segments, and its extension must be allowed by the media options; otherwise the file is rejected.

Path.description: Alias for TargetPath. Path where the content will be written.

SourcePath.description: Relative path from the recipe file to the source media.

SourceUrl.description: Absolute URL to download the media from.

Hint.description: Short note shown to editors explaining when to use the media profile.

Quality.description: Encoder quality percentage used by formats that support lossy compression.

BackgroundColor.description: Background color used by pad-style resize modes.

MediaProfiles.description: A dictionary keyed by profile name. Each value is a media profile object.

then.description: Creates or updates memberships, matched by ItemId, then by member, product and start. The member is named by UserName and must exist on the site. An active membership grants its roles.

items.description: A member's membership from a membership product.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

UserName.description: The member's user name. The user must exist on the site.

ContentItemId.description: The content item id of the membership product.

Title.description: The membership's title, such as the product's.

RoleNames.description: The roles the membership gives its member while it is active.

OrderIds.description: The orders that bought or renewed the membership.

EndsUtc.description: When the membership ends, or none for one that doesn't.

Status.description: The membership's status: Active, Expired or Revoked (or 0, 1, 2).

EndedReason.description: Why the membership ended early, such as the order being refunded.

Memberships.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

then.description: Creates or updates the store's own tax registrations, matched by ItemId, then by name.

items.description: A tax registration: where the store collects a tax, under which number.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The registration's name.

JurisdictionId.description: The id of the tax jurisdiction the store is registered in.

TaxType.description: The tax type the registration covers, or none for every type.

RegistrationNumber.description: The number the tax authority gave the store.

IsActive.description: Whether the store collects the tax under this registration.

ThresholdAmount.description: The sales above which the store must collect the tax, or none.

ThresholdAccumulatedAmount.description: The sales recorded into the jurisdiction so far, measured against ThresholdAmount. It is kept up to date as sales are recorded, so it is usually left out.

RegistrationDateUtc.description: When the tax authority granted the registration.

MerchantTaxRegistrations.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

then.description: Creates or updates messaging broadcasts, matched by ItemId. A new broadcast is always a draft, and a broadcast that is queued or sent is left as it is, so a recipe never sends a message.

items.description: A message to send to many recipients from one address.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The name of the broadcast.

Channel.description: The channel the broadcast is sent on, such as 'sms'.

ServiceAddress.description: The address the broadcast is sent from, such as the business phone number.

Recipients.description: The addresses the message goes to.

OwnerAgentId.description: The user id of the agent who owns the replies.

Broadcasts.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

AppSecret.description: Microsoft application client secret. The step stores the value as given, and Orchard Core decrypts it with the tenant's Data Protection keys, so a clear value does not work. Prefer a secret: create it with the 'Secrets' step and reference it with 'AppSecretSecretName' in the 'MicrosoftAccountSettings' property of the 'Settings' step.

CallbackPath.description: Relative callback path that Microsoft redirects back to after sign-in.

ContentTypes.description: Optional content type filter. Omit this property to process every content type that contains a Media Field configured with the Attached editor.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the cadence. When it matches a stored cadence, that cadence is updated. Otherwise a new cadence is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

DisplayText.description: Name of the cadence shown when it is selected on a loading campaign.

DelayMinutes.description: Minutes the contact must be silent since the automation's previous message before this nudge is sent. The clock restarts after each nudge.

IsAiGenerated.description: Whether the AI composes this nudge. When false, 'Message' is sent verbatim.

Message.description: The exact text sent when 'IsAiGenerated' is false (required in that case), or optional guidance the AI composes the nudge from when it is true.

Steps.description: Ordered nudges. The number of steps caps how many nudges are ever sent; an empty list never nudges.

Enabled.description: Whether the cadence is enabled. A disabled cadence never nudges.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the cadence, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

Cadences.description: The re-engagement cadences to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the campaign. When it matches a stored campaign, that campaign is updated. Otherwise a new campaign is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable name of the campaign.

CampaignGroupId.description: Identifier of the campaign group this campaign is reported under.

InteractionType.description: Whether the campaign is handled manually by an agent or automated by AI.

Channel.description: Communication channel used by the campaign, for example 'SMS', 'Chat', or 'Email'.

InitialOutboundPromptPattern.description: For automated campaigns, the initial message used to start the conversation with the customer.

CampaignGoal.description: Description of what success looks like, used by the AI to decide when the conversation can end.

ProviderName.description: Name of the AI provider used for automation.

ConnectionName.description: Name of the provider connection used for automation.

DeploymentName.description: Name of the model deployment used for automation.

SystemMessage.description: System message that steers the automated conversation.

Temperature.description: Sampling temperature applied to the automated completions.

TopP.description: Nucleus sampling probability applied to the automated completions.

FrequencyPenalty.description: Frequency penalty applied to the automated completions.

PresencePenalty.description: Presence penalty applied to the automated completions.

MaxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the automated completions may generate.

ToolNames.description: Names of the tools the automation is allowed to invoke.

AllowAIToUpdateContact.description: Whether the AI is allowed to update the contact during an automated conversation.

AllowAIToUpdateSubject.description: Whether the AI is allowed to update the subject during an automated conversation.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the campaign, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the campaign group. When it matches a stored campaign group, that campaign group is updated. Otherwise a new campaign group is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable name of the campaign group.

Description.description: Administrative description of the campaign group.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the campaign group, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

CampaignGroups.description: Campaign groups to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the channel endpoint. When it matches a stored channel endpoint, that channel endpoint is updated. Otherwise a new channel endpoint is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable name of the address.

AddressType.description: Kind of address: 'PhoneNumber' or 'EmailAddress'. When empty, it is taken from 'Channel'.

Capabilities.description: What the address is used for, named by channel, for example ['Phone', 'SMS'] for a number used for calls and texts.

MergedItemIds.description: Identifiers of records merged into this address; history that names them finds this address.

Channel.description: Single channel of an address exported before addresses had capabilities, for example 'SMS' or 'Phone'. Read only when 'AddressType' and 'Capabilities' are absent.

Value.description: Address of the endpoint on the channel, for example a phone number or email address.

Description.description: Administrative description of the channel endpoint.

ProviderName.description: Technical name of the messaging or telephony provider that owns this address (for example 'Twilio', 'Telnyx' or 'AzureCommunicationServices'). When empty, the tenant-default provider is used.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the channel endpoint, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

ChannelEndpoints.description: Channel endpoints to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the disposition. When it matches a stored disposition, that disposition is updated. Otherwise a new disposition is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique name of the disposition.

DisplayText.description: Legacy display text. Prefer 'Name'; this is only used to seed the name when 'Name' is not supplied.

CaptureDate.description: Whether selecting this disposition prompts the agent to capture a follow-up date.

Outcome.description: The outcome the platform applies this disposition for when a call ends in a way nobody chose: NotInService (the dialer or an automated call found the number dead; recording it also excludes the number from future dialing), NoAnswer, Busy or AnsweringMachine (the dialer or an automated call), or Rejected, Failed or Disconnected (a dialer call that ended before an agent was connected).

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the disposition, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the lead status. When it matches a stored lead status, that lead status is updated. Otherwise a new lead status is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique name of the lead status. An entry whose ItemId matches no stored status is matched by this name, so a second run updates it.

Description.description: Administrative description of the lead status.

Order.description: Position of the status in lists, lowest first.

IsDefault.description: Whether a new lead starts in this status.

IsClosed.description: Whether a lead in this status is closed.

IsConverted.description: Whether this is the status a lead takes when it is converted.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the lead status, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

LeadStatuses.description: The lead statuses to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the message template. When it matches a stored message template, that message template is updated. Otherwise a new message template is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique template name shown in the composer picker.

Body.description: Text inserted into the composer when the template is picked.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the message template, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

Templates.description: The message templates to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the opportunity stage. When it matches a stored opportunity stage, that opportunity stage is updated. Otherwise a new opportunity stage is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique name of the opportunity stage. An entry whose ItemId matches no stored stage is matched by this name, so a second run updates it.

Description.description: Administrative description of the opportunity stage.

Order.description: Position of the stage in the pipeline, lowest first.

Probability.description: Default chance, from 0 to 100, that an opportunity in this stage is won.

IsClosed.description: Whether an opportunity in this stage is closed.

IsWon.description: Whether an opportunity in this stage is won.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the opportunity stage, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

OpportunityStages.description: The opportunity stages to create or update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the subject action. When it matches a stored subject action, that subject action is updated. Otherwise a new subject action is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Source.description: Source that owns the subject action. A subject action cannot be imported without a source.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable name of the subject action.

SubjectContentType.description: Subject content type this action belongs to.

DispositionId.description: Identifier of the disposition that triggers this action.

DispositionGuidance.description: What this disposition means for this subject, given to the AI when it dispositions an automated call or message. Replaces the disposition's own description.

SetDoNotCall.description: Whether to set the contact's 'Do Not Call' preference when this action runs.

SetDoNotSms.description: Whether to set the contact's 'Do Not SMS' preference when this action runs.

SetDoNotEmail.description: Whether to set the contact's 'Do Not Email' preference when this action runs.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the subject action, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

SubjectActions.description: Subject actions to create or update.

DisplayName.description: Human-readable application name shown to users and administrators.

RedirectUris.description: Space-separated or serialized list of allowed redirect URIs.

PostLogoutRedirectUris.description: Space-separated or serialized list of allowed post-logout redirect URIs.

ConsentType.description: How user consent is handled for the application.

ClientSecret.description: Client secret used by confidential applications.

Name.description: Role name granted to the application.

items.description: Roles granted to the client application.

Name.description: Scope name granted to the application.

items.description: Scopes granted to the client application.

AllowPasswordFlow.description: Whether the resource owner password flow is allowed for this client.

AllowClientCredentialsFlow.description: Whether the client credentials flow is allowed for this client.

AllowAuthorizationCodeFlow.description: Whether the authorization code flow is allowed for this client.

AllowRefreshTokenFlow.description: Whether the client can request refresh tokens.

AllowHybridFlow.description: Whether hybrid response types are allowed for this client.

AllowImplicitFlow.description: Whether implicit response types are allowed for this client.

AllowLogoutEndpoint.description: Whether the client can use the logout endpoint.

AllowIntrospectionEndpoint.description: Whether the client can call the introspection endpoint.

AllowRevocationEndpoint.description: Whether the client can call the revocation endpoint.

RequireProofKeyForCodeExchange.description: Whether PKCE is required for authorization code requests.

RequirePushedAuthorizationRequests.description: Whether the client must use pushed authorization requests.

DisplayName.description: Display caption shown for the OpenID client login option.

Authority.description: Authority or issuer base URL of the external OpenID provider.

ClientSecret.description: Registered OpenID client secret. The step stores the value as given, and Orchard Core decrypts it with the tenant's Data Protection keys, so a clear value does not work. Prefer a secret: create it with the 'Secrets' step and reference it with 'ClientSecretSecretName' in the 'OpenIdClientSettings' property of the 'Settings' step.

CallbackPath.description: Relative callback path that the provider redirects back to after sign-in.

SignedOutRedirectUri.description: Absolute URI the provider should redirect to after sign-out completes.

SignedOutCallbackPath.description: Relative callback path that handles the post-logout response from the provider.

Scopes.description: Space-separated list of scopes requested from the provider.

ResponseType.description: OpenID Connect response type sent to the provider.

ResponseMode.description: How the provider should return the response payload.

StoreExternalTokens.description: Whether external access and refresh tokens should be stored for later use.

Name.description: Additional protocol parameter name.

Value.description: Additional protocol parameter value.

items.description: Additional protocol parameters appended to the authentication request.

Description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this scope grants.

DisplayName.description: Display caption shown for the scope.

ScopeName.description: Unique scope name exposed by the OpenID server.

Resources.description: Space-separated resource names associated with this scope.

AccessTokenFormat.description: Format used when issuing access tokens.

Authority.description: Public authority or issuer URL exposed by the OpenID server.

DisableAccessTokenEncryption.description: Whether encrypted access tokens should be disabled.

EncryptionCertificateStoreLocation.description: Windows certificate store location that contains the encryption certificate.

EncryptionCertificateStoreName.description: Windows certificate store name that contains the encryption certificate.

EncryptionCertificateThumbprint.description: Thumbprint of the certificate used for token encryption.

SigningCertificateStoreLocation.description: Windows certificate store location that contains the signing certificate.

SigningCertificateStoreName.description: Windows certificate store name that contains the signing certificate.

SigningCertificateThumbprint.description: Thumbprint of the certificate used for signing tokens.

EnableTokenEndpoint.description: Whether the token endpoint is enabled.

EnableAuthorizationEndpoint.description: Whether the authorization endpoint is enabled.

EnableLogoutEndpoint.description: Whether the logout endpoint is enabled.

EnableUserInfoEndpoint.description: Whether the user info endpoint is enabled.

EnableIntrospectionEndpoint.description: Whether the introspection endpoint is enabled.

EnablePushedAuthorizationEndpoint.description: Whether the pushed authorization endpoint is enabled.

EnableRevocationEndpoint.description: Whether the revocation endpoint is enabled.

AllowPasswordFlow.description: Whether the resource owner password flow is allowed.

AllowClientCredentialsFlow.description: Whether the client credentials flow is allowed.

AllowAuthorizationCodeFlow.description: Whether the authorization code flow is allowed.

AllowRefreshTokenFlow.description: Whether refresh tokens can be exchanged for new access tokens.

AllowHybridFlow.description: Whether hybrid response types are allowed.

AllowImplicitFlow.description: Whether implicit response types are allowed.

DisableRollingRefreshTokens.description: Whether refresh token rolling should be disabled.

RequireProofKeyForCodeExchange.description: Whether PKCE is required for authorization code flows.

RequirePushedAuthorizationRequests.description: Whether clients must use pushed authorization requests.

RequireEndSessionConfirmation.description: Whether the logout endpoint asks the user to confirm the sign-out. Defaults to true when omitted.

UseReferenceAccessTokens.description: Whether reference access tokens should be issued instead of self-contained tokens.

MetadataAddress.description: Absolute URL of the OpenID Connect metadata document.

Authority.description: Authority or issuer base URL used for token validation.

DisableTokenTypeValidation.description: Whether token type checks should be skipped during validation.

Tenant.description: Optional tenant or issuer hint used by the validation handler.

place.description: The placement location, such as 'Content:1', a zone and position, or '-' to hide the shape.

displayType.description: The display type the placement applies to, such as Detail, Summary or Edit. Leave it empty to apply to every display type.

differentiator.description: The differentiator that narrows the placement to a specific named shape, such as a specific field name.

shape.description: The shape type the placement renders instead of the default shape.

alternates.description: The alternates added to the shape so a template can override its rendering.

wrappers.description: The wrapper shapes rendered around the shape.

oneOf.description: A single content part name to match, such as BodyPart.
A set of content part names, any of which matches.

contentPart.description: Applies the placement only when the content item has a matching content part. Accepts a single content part or an array of content parts.

oneOf.description: A single content type or stereotype to match, such as Article or Widget*.
A set of content types or stereotypes, any of which matches.

contentType.description: Applies the placement only when the shape belongs to a matching content type or stereotype. A trailing '*' matches by prefix. Accepts a single content type or an array of content types.

oneOf.description: A single request path to match, such as /about or ~/blog/*.
A set of request paths, any of which matches.

path.description: Applies the placement only when the current request path matches. A trailing '*' matches by prefix. Accepts a single path or an array of paths.

items.description: A placement node describing where and how a shape is rendered, optionally narrowed by filters.

Placements.description: A dictionary keyed by shape type. Each value is an array of placement nodes applied to that shape.

ItemId.description: The price list's id. A list with this id is updated; otherwise a list with the same name is, or a new one is made with this id.

Name.description: The price list's name, as shown in an account's B2B settings.

PercentOff.description: A discount off the store's price for every SKU without its own price, from 0 to 100.

Currency.description: The currency the list's prices are in, such as 'USD'. Its prices apply only to buyers shopping in it.

UnitPrice.description: The price of one unit, in the list's currency.

PriceLists.description: The price lists to create or update.

Name.description: The technical name of the query. Must be unique on the tenant.

Source.description: The query source provider name, such as Sql, Lucene or Elasticsearch. The well known members of the query depend on this value.

Schema.description: The optional return schema of the query, used to shape the results when content items are not returned. It supports script expressions such as [js: ...].

ReturnContentItems.description: Whether the query returns full content items instead of the raw source results.

items.description: A query to create or update.

Source.description: Elasticsearch query. Runs an Elasticsearch query against an Elasticsearch index. Fixed 'Source' for the 'Elasticsearch' query source.

Index.description: The name of the Elasticsearch index the query runs against.

Template.description: The Elasticsearch query JSON executed against the index. It supports Liquid and file expressions such as [file:text('Snippets/query.json')].

Source.description: Lucene query. Runs a Lucene query against a Lucene index. Fixed 'Source' for the 'Lucene' query source.

Index.description: The name of the Lucene index the query runs against.

Template.description: The Lucene query JSON executed against the index. It supports Liquid and file expressions such as [file:text('Snippets/query.json')].

Source.description: SQL query. Runs a SQL query against the tenant database. Fixed 'Source' for the 'Sql' query source.

Template.description: The SQL query text executed against the tenant database. It supports Liquid expressions and query parameters such as @limit:3.

Queries.description: The queries to create or update.

IncludeAll.description: When true, rebuild all index profiles and ignore the IndexNames list.

IndexNames.description: Specific index profile names to rebuild when IncludeAll is false.

executionid.description: Unique execution identifier used to track the nested recipe execution.

name.description: Name of the non-startup recipe to execute.

Values.description: Referenced recipes to execute from this step.

then.description: Creates or updates customers' referral codes, matched by ItemId, then by customer. A code another customer uses is refused.

items.description: A customer's referral code and the referrals it earned.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

CustomerId.description: The id of the customer who shares the code. Import the customers first.

Code.description: The referral code, unique across customers.

Referrals.description: The friends who ordered with the code and the rewards the customer earned.

Profiles.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

then.description: Creates or updates point-of-sale registers, matched by ItemId, then by name. Import the stock locations first.

items.description: A register: a till at one of the store's locations.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The register's name, such as the store and till it's at.

LocationId.description: The id of the stock location the register sells from.

Address.description: The store's address, with AddressLine1, City and a two-letter Country: its sales are taxed by it.

Currency.description: The three-letter currency the register sells in, or none for the store's.

Roles.description: The roles whose users can sell on the register.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the register is in use.

Registers.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

then.description: Requests a reload of the tenant when the recipe completes. Place it after the steps whose settings must become active, such as a 'Settings' step that changes CORS policies.

ContentTypes.description: List of content types. Fields must be attached through a content part whose PartName matches the content type's Name. Those parts must also appear in the ContentPartFieldDefinitionRecords inside ContentParts. Fields cannot be used directly in PartName.

Name.description: Technical content type name.

DisplayName.description: Display name shown in the Orchard admin UI.

Creatable.description: Whether editors can create new items of this type.

Listable.description: Whether items of this type appear in content lists.

Draftable.description: Whether items of this type support drafts.

ContentTypeSettings.description: Standard Orchard Core content type settings.

Settings.description: Content type settings object, including standard Orchard ContentTypeSettings.

PartName.description: Attached part type name. Known part names are surfaced as suggestions, but any custom part name is allowed.

Name.description: Attachment name used on the content type. Usually matches PartName.

DisplayName.description: Display label shown in the admin UI.

Position.description: Placement position used by Orchard when rendering the part or field.

DisplayMode.description: Display mode selected for the part or field.

Editor.description: Editor name used to edit the part or field.

Settings.description: Attachment settings for this part on the content type.

AccountPartSettings.description: The settings of the account part.

OfferedContentTypes.description: The record types (such as contacts and opportunities) already added to the account type's list. The Accounts feature adds every new record type to the list once and records it here, so a type an administrator removes from the list is not added back.

Pattern.description: Pattern for generating the alias. Must be valid Liquid syntax.

Options.description: Whether the alias is editable or auto-generated.

Pattern.description: The pattern used to build the Path. Must be valid Liquid syntax.

LeadPartSettings.description: How a lead of this type is converted.

TargetContactContentType.description: The contact content type a lead of this type becomes when it is converted.

DefaultOpportunityContentType.description: The opportunity content type offered first when a conversion creates an opportunity.

RequireTimeZone.description: Require a time zone for the contact.

AutoDetectTimeZone.description: Automatically detect the contact time zone from the contact's phone number when one was not selected.

UseDoNotCall.description: Show the Do not call preference.

UseDoNotSms.description: Show the Do not SMS preference.

UseDoNotEmail.description: Show the Do not email preference.

OpportunityPartSettings.description: The pipeline of an opportunity type.

StageIds.description: The ItemIds of the stages (see the OmnichannelOpportunityStage step) an opportunity of this type moves through. Empty uses every stage.

Pattern.description: Pattern for building the preview path or display content.

Type.description: The kind of product the part represents.

DefaultCurrency.description: The ISO-4217 currency code applied to products of this type when an item does not set its own currency.

SalesMode.description: Whether products of this type can be bought online, are only listed, or decide per item.

PriceDisplay.description: How the price of products of this type is shown to visitors.

OnRequestLabel.description: The text shown instead of the price when the price is shown on request.

AllowPriceDisplayOverride.description: Whether each product may choose how its own price is shown.

IsContentRestricted.description: Whether content that uses this part is restricted to the selected roles.

Required.description: Whether at least one role must be picked.

AllowSelectMultiple.description: Whether more than one role may be picked.

ExcludedRoles.description: The role names that are not offered.

Hint.description: The hint shown under the picker.

SchemaOrgPartSettings.description: The schema.org type of the content items and where each of their properties comes from.

SchemaType.description: The schema.org type, such as BlogPosting, Article, Event or Product. When empty, a module may choose one (a product is a Product); other items are a WebPage.

Name.description: The schema.org property, such as headline. A dotted name, such as offers.price, sets a property of a nested object.

Source.description: Where the value comes from: Content (a field or value of the item), Fixed (the same value for every item), Editor (entered on each item) or Liquid (a template).

Value.description: What the source needs: for Content the key of a field or value, such as Field:BlogPost.Image or Item:DisplayText; for Fixed the value itself; for Liquid the template; unused for Editor.

Properties.description: The properties and where their values come from, in the order they are written.

ContentTypes.description: The content types for which the subscription flow collects content item data.

DefaultTaxCategoryCode.description: The default tax category code applied to new content items.

DefaultTaxClassificationCode.description: The default tax classification code applied to new content items.

AllowClassificationOverride.description: Whether the tax classification fields are shown to editors.

Pattern.description: This string must be a valid Liquid syntax

allOf.description: The part has no settings of its own.

WizardPartSettings.description: How the wizard's steps are authored and how a started wizard behaves.

ContainedContentTypes.description: The content types allowed as steps. Empty allows every type that matches ContainedStereotypes.

ContainedStereotypes.description: The stereotypes allowed as steps. Empty does not filter by stereotype.

DisplayType.description: The display type each step is rendered with in the authoring editor.

CollapseContainedItems.description: Whether steps are collapsed by default in the authoring editor.

RequiresAuthenticatedUser.description: Whether a visitor must be signed in to start the wizard.

CompletionPolicy.description: What happens to the collected responses when the wizard completes: 0 = None (kept only in the session for a workflow or handler), 1 = Draft (created as drafts), 2 = Publish (created and published, the default).

ContentTypePartDefinitionRecords.description: Parts attached to this content type.

Name.description: Reusable content part name.

Settings.description: Part definition settings, including part-specific settings envelopes.

FieldName.description: Field type name. Known Orchard field types are surfaced as suggestions, but any custom field type name is allowed.

Name.description: Field name used inside the content part.

DisplayName.description: Display label shown in the admin UI.

Position.description: Placement position used by Orchard when rendering the part or field.

DisplayMode.description: Display mode selected for the part or field.

Editor.description: Editor name used to edit the part or field.

Settings.description: Field definition settings, including Orchard placement/editor settings and field-specific settings envelopes.

Hint.description: The hint shown under the field in the editor.

Required.description: Whether an address must be entered.

ShowName.description: Whether the editor asks for the recipient's name.

ShowCompany.description: Whether the editor asks for a company.

ShowPhone.description: Whether the editor asks for a phone number.

Countries.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries offered; empty or null for every country.

DefaultCountry.description: The country a new address starts in.

Hint.description: The hint shown under the field in the editor.

Required.description: Whether a phone number must be entered.

InitialCountryMode.description: The country the editor starts on: Globe (0, none), CurrentCulture (1, the request culture's country) or Specific (2, SpecificCountryCode).

SpecificCountryCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the editor starts on when InitialCountryMode is Specific.

MinLength.description: The minimum number of characters allowed. Omit it for no minimum.

itemId.description: The identifier of the group: up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores. A group without a valid itemId is refused.

displayText.description: The name of the group. A group without a name is refused.

parentId.description: The itemId of the group this group is nested in, or null for a top-level group.

order.description: The position of the group among its siblings.

createdUtc.description: The time the group was created.

modifiedUtc.description: The time the group was last changed.

items.description: A report group, which files reports in a tree.

Groups.description: The report groups, imported before the views and reports. A group is matched by its itemId and replaced, or created under that identifier. A group whose parent is missing once every group is in moves to the top level.

itemId.description: The identifier of the view: up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores. A view without a valid itemId is refused.

displayText.description: The title of the view. A view without a title is refused.

alias.description: The alias fields of this data set are named by, as in 'alias.Field'.

dataSet.description: The data set within the source, such as a content type, a query name or the itemId of a view.

displayName.description: The label of the data set in the designer.

rightField.description: The field key on the right side, as 'alias.Field'.

name.description: The name the field is referred to by.

expression.description: The formula. A row-level field may refer only to data set fields and to calculated fields listed before it.

field.description: What the filter applies to: a field key ('alias.Field' or a calculated field name) for the Rows stage, or a column id for the Result stage.

stage.description: Whether the filter applies to rows before grouping or to the result after grouping.

values.description: The comparison values in the invariant culture (dates as yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm in the tenant time zone). For an exposed filter, the default values.

field.description: The field key the column reads: 'alias.Field' or a calculated field name.

aggregate.description: The aggregate that makes the column a measure, or None for a dimension.

transform.description: A transform applied to the field before grouping, such as a date part.

format.description: A .NET format string applied to the values.

hidden.description: Whether the column is computed but not shown.

shelf.description: The shelf a pivot places the column on.

colors.description: The colors of the column's header and cells: headerColor, headerBackgroundColor, color, backgroundColor, a color scale and color rules.

showAs.description: How a measure's values are shown.

showAsDirection.description: The direction a showAs calculation runs in a pivot.

items.description: A result column of a query.

sorts.description: The sort order of the result.

limit.description: The most rows the result holds, or null for the default limit.

refreshIntervalMinutes.description: How often the view's result is computed ahead and stored: 0 runs it live on every read, otherwise at least every 15 minutes (60, 360 and 1440 are offered). Other values are normalized on import.

ownerId.description: The user id of the view's owner, whose access the view runs with. Used when OwnerUserName names no user of the site.

OwnerUserName.description: The user name of the view's owner, written by a deployment plan so the owner is found on a site where they have another user id. When neither this nor ownerId names an owner, the person who runs the recipe owns the view.

author.description: The name of the person who created the view.

createdUtc.description: The time the view was created.

modifiedUtc.description: The time the view was last changed. Set to the import time.

items.description: A reusable view.

Views.description: The reusable views (saved queries that other reports and views read as the 'ReportViews' data source), imported before the reports. A view is matched by its itemId and replaced, or created under that identifier.

itemId.description: The identifier of the report: up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores. A report without a valid itemId is refused.

displayText.description: The title of the report. A report without a title is refused.

groupId.description: The itemId of the report group the report is in. When no group has this identifier, the group is taken from 'group'.

group.description: A path of group names, such as 'Sales / Regional', used when groupId names no group. Missing groups along the path are created.

category.description: Obsolete. A top-level group name written before report groups existed; read only when neither groupId nor group places the report.

items.description: An extra query of a report.

queries.description: Extra queries the report runs besides the main query, so visuals can show the data grouped another way.

id.description: The identifier of the visual, unique within the report.

title.description: The title shown above the visual.

width.description: The width of the visual on a twelve-column grid (of its container's width when it is in one).

containerId.description: The id of the container that holds the visual, or null when it stands on its own.

queryId.description: The id of the extra query whose columns the visual shows, or null for the main query.

action.description: What clicking a value does: columnId names the clicked column and targets lists the visuals ({ visualId, field }) filtered by the value.

categoryColumnId.description: The id of the column that labels a chart's categories.

seriesColumnId.description: The id of a dimension column whose values become a chart's series or a pivot table's columns.

valueColumnIds.description: The ids of the measure columns a chart plots, a metrics row shows or a pivot table sums.

columnIds.description: The ids of the columns a table shows, in order (every visible column when empty), or the row columns of a pivot table.

showTotals.description: Whether a table or pivot table ends with a totals row.

showSubtotals.description: Whether a table of a grouped report shows subtotal rows after each group of its leading dimensions.

stacked.description: Whether a bar or area chart stacks its series.

showLegend.description: Whether a chart shows its legend.

columnId.description: The id of the value column the line belongs to.

kind.description: Whether the line marks the column's average, its median or a constant value.

value.description: The value of a Constant line.

referenceLines.description: Lines a chart draws across its values.

items.description: A visual of a report.

visuals.description: The tables, charts, metric rows and pivot tables of the report, in display order.

id.description: The identifier of the container, unique within the report, which visuals name in containerId.

title.description: The title shown in the container's header band.

width.description: The width of the container on a twelve-column grid.

height.description: The height of the container's body in pixels, which scrolls when its visuals are taller, or 0 to grow with its visuals.

items.description: A container of a report.

containers.description: Framed blocks that hold visuals under one title.

showInAdminMenu.description: Whether the report is listed in the admin menu under Reports.

sharedUserNames.description: The user names the report is shared with.

sharedRoles.description: The role names the report is shared with.

allowExport.description: Whether the people who run the report may export it.

ownerId.description: The user id of the report's owner, whose access the report runs with. Used when OwnerUserName names no user of the site.

OwnerUserName.description: The user name of the report's owner, written by a deployment plan so the owner is found on a site where they have another user id. When neither this nor ownerId names an owner, the person who runs the recipe owns the report.

author.description: The name of the person who created the report.

createdUtc.description: The time the report was created.

modifiedUtc.description: The time the report was last changed. Set to the import time.

items.description: A designed report.

Reports.description: The designed reports. A report is matched by its itemId and replaced, or created under that identifier. Share links are never imported.

IncludeAll.description: When true, reset all index profiles and ignore the IndexNames list.

IndexNames.description: Specific index profile names to reset when IncludeAll is false.

Name.description: Role name. Existing roles are surfaced as suggestions, but any role name is allowed, including new roles to create.

Permissions.description: Permissions assigned to the role. Well-known permissions are surfaced as suggestions, but any valid permission name is allowed, including dynamic per-content-type permissions (for example, 'EditContent_Article') and permissions provided by third-party modules.

PermissionBehavior.description: How permissions are merged: Add (default), Replace, or Remove.

itemId.description: The resource's id. When it matches a stored resource, that resource is replaced; otherwise a new one is made under this id, so references to it keep working.

kind.description: What it is. One of: Staff, Room, Equipment, Other (or its number).

calendarId.description: The calendar that holds its appointments (see the Calendars step).

timeZoneId.description: The IANA time zone of its working hours.

availabilityMode.description: Where its hours come from. One of: WorkingHours, Shifts (or its number).

shiftCalendarId.description: With Shifts: the calendar whose Shift events name it. Kept for older resources; shiftCalendarIds is read too.

shiftCalendarIds.description: With Shifts: the workforce calendars whose shifts it works, such as one for each team a staff member is on.

day.description: The day. One of: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday (or its number).

workingHours.description: Its weekly hours; several on a day leave the gaps as breaks.

closed.description: Whether it is closed that day.

start.description: Otherwise, when it opens, as HH:mm.

end.description: And when it closes, as HH:mm.

enabled.description: Whether it can be booked.

properties.description: Extension data other features keep on the resource.

Resources.description: The staff, rooms and equipment to create or replace.

itemId.description: The appointment type's id. When it matches a stored appointment type, that appointment type is replaced; otherwise a new one is made under this id, so references to it keep working.

slug.description: The address of its public booking page (book/{slug}).

slotIntervalMinutes.description: How far apart the start times are.

bufferBeforeMinutes.description: Free time kept before each appointment.

bufferAfterMinutes.description: Free time kept after each appointment.

minimumNoticeMinutes.description: How long before an appointment it can still be booked.

horizonDays.description: How far ahead it can be booked.

maxPerDay.description: The most a resource takes a day; 0 for no limit.

maxPerWeek.description: The most a resource takes a week (Monday to Sunday in its time zone); 0 for no limit.

maxUpcomingPerCustomer.description: The most upcoming appointments of this type one customer can book themselves; 0 for no limit.

cancelNoticeMinutes.description: How soon before the start a customer can still cancel it themselves; 0 for any time.

rescheduleNoticeMinutes.description: How soon before the start a customer can still move it themselves; 0 for any time.

capacity.description: How many people one appointment takes (more than 1 for group sessions).

resourceIds.description: The resources that can take it. With resourceRequirements, every resource of every requirement.

assignment.description: How a resource is chosen, when there are no resourceRequirements. One of: AnyAvailable, RoundRobin, AllTogether (or its number).

name.description: The group's name, such as Staff or Room.

resourceIds.description: The resources in the group, in order of preference.

assignment.description: How the group's resources are picked. One of: AnyAvailable, RoundRobin, AllTogether (or its number).

weights.description: Round-robin weights by resource id; a resource with 2 takes about twice as many appointments as one with 1, the default.

resourceRequirements.description: Groups of resources each appointment needs, such as one person from the staff and one room; a time is offered only when every group can be met. When empty, resourceIds and assignment make the only group.

requiresConfirmation.description: Whether bookings wait for someone to confirm them.

holdMinutes.description: How long a held time is kept.

allowSelfService.description: Whether customers can book it themselves.

enabled.description: Whether it can be booked.

AppointmentTypes.description: The appointment types to create or replace.

itemId.description: The appointment's id. When it matches a stored appointment, that appointment is replaced; otherwise a new one is made under this id, so references to it keep working.

status.description: Its status. One of: Held, Requested, Confirmed, Completed, NoShow, Cancelled, Expired (or its number).

holdExpiresUtc.description: When a held time is let go.

userId.description: The customer's user, if they have one.

calendarEventId.description: Its calendar event (see the Calendars step).

Appointments.description: The appointments to create or replace. Import the Calendars step with its events first, so their calendar events exist.

itemId.description: The waitlist entry's id. When it matches a stored waitlist entry, that waitlist entry is replaced; otherwise a new one is made under this id, so references to it keep working.

fromUtc.description: The start of the times wanted.

toUtc.description: The end of the times wanted.

status.description: Its status. One of: Waiting, Notified, Booked, Removed (or its number).

notifiedUtc.description: When the customer was told a time opened.

Waitlist.description: The waitlist entries to create or replace.

Name.description: The name of the secret, for example 'Smtp.Password'. Settings reference the secret by this name.

Store.description: The name of the secret store. When omitted, the default store is used.

Value.description: The clear value of the text secret. Avoid it in recipes that are committed: when omitted, the value is read from the 'OrchardCore:Secrets:{Name}' configuration key, and the secret is skipped when no value is found.

oneOf.description: Text secrets to create or update.

Store.description: The name of the secret store.

Type.description: The type of the secret. Defaults to 'TextSecret'.

ExpiresUtc.description: The UTC date and time when the secret expires.

Version.description: The version of the encryption format of an encrypted secret.

EncryptedKey.description: The encrypted symmetric key of an encrypted secret.

EncryptedData.description: The encrypted value of an encrypted secret.

IV.description: The initialization vector of an encrypted secret.

Tag.description: The authentication tag of an encrypted secret.

oneOf.description: Secrets keyed by name, as the Secrets deployment step exports them. An entry without encrypted data takes its value from the 'OrchardCore:Secrets:{Name}' configuration key and is skipped when no value is found.

Secrets.description: The secrets to create. Use an array to declare text secrets whose values come from the recipe or, preferably, from the 'OrchardCore:Secrets:{Name}' configuration key (environment variable 'OrchardCore__Secrets__{Name}'). Use an object keyed by secret name to import the output of the Secrets deployment step.

EncryptionKeyName.description: The name of the RsaKeySecret or X509Secret of this tenant that holds the private key used to decrypt the encrypted secrets of an exported object. Required when the secrets are encrypted.

BaseUrl.description: Optional absolute base URL of the site, for example 'https://www.example.com'. A relative URL is rejected; an empty value or null clears it.

Calendar.description: Optional calendar system identifier used by the site.

MaxPagedCount.description: Maximum number of items Orchard may return from paged queries.

MaxPageSize.description: Maximum page size allowed by Orchard paging APIs.

PageSize.description: Default page size used by Orchard lists and queries.

AllowPageSizeSelection.description: Whether admin lists show a selector that lets users pick the page size from PageSizeOptions.

PageSizeOptions.description: The page sizes offered when AllowPageSizeSelection is true. Defaults to [10, 25, 50, 100].

ResourceDebugMode.description: Controls whether resource debugging stays with configuration, is forced on, or is forced off.

PageTitleFormat.description: Page title format string, typically including placeholders like '{{ Site.SiteName }}'.

SiteSalt.description: Application salt used by Orchard security and hashing features.

SuperUser.description: User name of the Orchard super user account.

UseCdn.description: Whether Orchard should serve static assets from a CDN base URL.

CdnBaseUrl.description: Absolute CDN base URL used when UseCdn is enabled, for example 'https://cdn.example.com'. A relative URL is rejected; an empty value or null clears it.

AppendVersion.description: Whether Orchard should append file version hashes to resource URLs.

HomeRoute.description: Optional route object that overrides the site's home page target.

CacheMode.description: Controls Orchard cache behavior for the tenant.

AIChatAdminWidgetSettings.description: Configuration for the AI chat widget displayed in the admin dashboard.

ProfileId.description: The AI profile identifier used by the admin chat widget.

MaxSessions.description: The maximum number of concurrent chat sessions allowed.

PrimaryColor.description: The primary color for the chat widget UI.

AIContactMemorySettings.description: How the AI rewrites a CRM contact's memory note after each conversation.

Instructions.description: The instructions the memory writer follows. Empty uses the built-in instructions.

AICostSettings.description: What the phone lines cost, used to estimate the cost of each AI call. What the AI costs is set on each AI deployment (its Pricing).

Currency.description: The ISO currency code the carrier's prices are in, such as USD.

TelephonyPerMinute.description: What a minute of a phone call costs with the carrier.

SmsPerMessage.description: What one text message costs with the carrier.

AIDataSourceSettings.description: Default configuration for AI data source retrieval behavior.

DefaultStrictness.description: The default strictness level for data source queries (higher values are more strict).

DefaultTopNDocuments.description: The default number of top documents to retrieve from data sources.

AIMemorySettings.description: Configuration for AI memory storage and retrieval.

IndexProfileName.description: The name of the index profile used for memory storage.

TopN.description: The maximum number of memory entries to retrieve per query.

AIVisitorIdentityOptions.description: Configuration for anonymous AI chat visitor identity and remote-address handling.

CookieName.description: The cookie name used to persist the anonymous visitor identifier.

CookieLifetime.description: The visitor cookie lifetime as a .NET TimeSpan string.

AllowCrossSiteEmbedding.description: Whether the visitor cookie is written SameSite=None; Secure so it survives inside a frame on another site. A request that did not arrive over HTTPS keeps the SameSite=Lax cookie either way.

UsePartitionedCookie.description: Whether the visitor cookie carries the Partitioned attribute while AllowCrossSiteEmbedding is on, which keeps the cookie written in a frame apart from the first-party one of the same name.

RemoteAddressHashSalt.description: The application-specific salt used when hashing remote addresses.

AbstractApiPhoneNumberVerificationSettin.description: The AbstractAPI phone number verification provider.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the provider is enabled and can be selected to verify phone numbers.

AuthenticationType.description: How the provider authenticates: with the API key, or with a user name and password.

ProtectedApiKey.description: The API key, used with ApiKey authentication. The Settings step stores it exactly as given, so it must already be encrypted by the destination tenant with the 'PhoneNumberVerifications.AbstractApi' data protection purpose; a clear-text value cannot be read. Prefer entering it on the settings screen.

Username.description: The user name, used with Basic authentication.

ProtectedPassword.description: The password, used with Basic authentication. The Settings step stores it exactly as given, so it must already be encrypted by the destination tenant with the 'PhoneNumberVerifications.AbstractApi' data protection purpose; a clear-text value cannot be read. Prefer entering it on the settings screen.

AdminSettings.description: Configuration for the admin dashboard appearance and behavior.

DisplayThemeToggler.description: Whether to display the light/dark theme toggler in the admin.

DisplayMenuFilter.description: Whether to display the menu filter input in the admin navigation.

DisplayQuickNavigation.description: Whether to display the quick navigation palette (Ctrl+K / Cmd+K) in the admin navbar.

DisplayNewMenu.description: Whether to display the 'New' menu in the admin navigation.

DisplayTitlesInTopbar.description: Whether to display page titles in the top bar.

ShowBreadcrumb.description: Whether to display the breadcrumb trail above admin page titles.

MenuBehavior.description: How the sections of the admin menu open and close.

ListLayout.description: The layout of admin lists. When omitted, AdminListOptions.DefaultLayout is used.

ActionsLayout.description: The layout of the row actions of admin lists and of the secondary actions of the bottom action bar of edit pages. When omitted, AdminListOptions.DefaultActionsLayout is used.

AllowUserListLayoutSelection.description: Whether each admin list shows a layout selector whose choice is kept per user, per list, in a cookie.

AsteriskSettings.description: Asterisk provider settings for the tenant-configured ARI connection.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the tenant-configured Asterisk provider is enabled.

BaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Asterisk ARI endpoint.

Password.description: ARI password. Secret: stored exactly as given, so it must already be data-protected by the destination tenant. Prefer the provider's own recipe step, which takes the value in clear text and protects it.

ApplicationName.description: Stasis application name used for originated channels.

EndpointTemplate.description: Optional template that turns a dialed destination into an ARI endpoint; use the {number} token for the destination.

OutboundCallerId.description: Caller identifier presented on outbound calls.

VoicemailContext.description: Dialplan context a call continues into when an agent sends an inbound offer to voicemail.

VoicemailExtensionTemplate.description: Template that resolves the voicemail dialplan extension; it may use tokens such as {voicemailRecipientUserName} or {calledAddress}.

VoicemailPriority.description: Dialplan priority used when continuing a call to voicemail.

WebSocketUrl.description: Secure WebSocket URL browser SIP user agents connect to.

SipDomain.description: SIP domain used to compose browser agent addresses of record.

TurnUrls.description: Comma- or newline-delimited STUN/TURN URLs advertised to browser agents.

CanadaDnclRegistrySettings.description: Configuration for the Canada LNNTE-DNCL Registry provider.

AccountNumber.description: The Canada LNNTE-DNCL account number used for registry lookups.

CarrierProviderSettings.description: Which carrier provider the store uses, on the Providers tab of Settings › Commerce › Shipping.

DefaultProviderName.description: The technical name of the default carrier provider, or null for none.

CashOnDeliverySettings.description: The site settings of the Cash on delivery payment method.

Instructions.description: What the buyer is told at checkout, for example which payments the courier takes.

ChangeEmailSettings.description: Configuration for the change email feature.

AllowChangeEmail.description: Whether to allow users to change their email address.

ChatInteractionChatModeSettings.description: Configuration for the default chat interaction mode.

ChatMode.description: The default chat input mode for interactions.

EnableTextToSpeechPlayback.description: Whether to enable text-to-speech playback of AI responses.

CheckoutSettings.description: The site-level settings that govern checkout behavior across every checkout scenario.

DefaultPaymentMethod.description: The key of the payment provider selected by default when a checkout offers more than one.

Currency.description: The default ISO-4217 currency used when a checkout does not specify one.

SessionLifetimeHours.description: How long an unpaid checkout is kept before it expires and whatever the provider was holding for it is released. Defaults to one day.

Layout.description: How the checkout's steps are laid out: a page per step, or all on one page.

ClaudeSettings.description: Configuration for the Claude AI chat integration.

AuthenticationType.description: The authentication method used by the Claude integration.

BaseUrl.description: The base URL for the Claude API.

ProtectedApiKey.description: The encrypted API key for the Claude provider.

DefaultModel.description: The default Claude model to use for interactions.

ContactCenterDefaultAddressSettings.description: The numbers used when an agent has none of their own: the number calls are placed from and the number texts are sent from.

DefaultPhoneAddressId.description: The ItemId of the phone channel endpoint (see the OmnichannelChannelEndpoint step) calls are placed from by default.

DefaultSmsAddressId.description: The ItemId of the SMS channel endpoint (see the OmnichannelChannelEndpoint step) texts are sent from by default.

ContactCenterExternalTransferSettings.description: The operator-curated catalog of approved external transfer destinations.

Id.description: Opaque stable identifier callers supply when requesting a transfer to this destination.

DisplayName.description: Operator-assigned display name of the destination.

E164Address.description: Canonical E.164 address the call is transferred to.

Enabled.description: Whether the destination is active. Disabled destinations are always denied.

Destinations.description: Approved external destinations. Only entries that are present and enabled are reachable by an external transfer.

AllowUnlistedNumbers.description: Whether an agent who may transfer externally may also dial a number that is not in 'Destinations'. The number must still pass the platform's dial policy.

ContactCenterRecordingSettings.description: Recording governance policy every Contact Center voice interaction must satisfy.

RecordAllCalls.description: Whether every call is recorded automatically while the Call Recording feature is enabled: a Contact Center call when it connects to an agent, an AI voice agent's call when it is answered, and a number dialed on the soft phone keypad when it is answered.

ConsentModel.description: Consent model that governs whether a call may be recorded: every party must consent, or the recording organization's consent is sufficient.

RequireExplicitConsent.description: Whether consent must be captured on the interaction before recording may start. Giving the recording disclosure captures it.

EnableRecordingDisclosure.description: Whether callers are told the call is recorded, using RecordingDisclosureText.

RecordingDisclosureText.description: The notice callers are given that the call is recorded, spoken word for word by the platform or read out by the agent.

DiscloseOnInboundCalls.description: Whether the disclosure is spoken to an inbound caller on an entry point before its welcome message, menu or queue.

DiscloseOnAIVoiceCalls.description: Whether an automated voice agent gives the disclosure before anything else it says.

PromptAgentsToDisclose.description: Whether an agent on a call whose caller has not heard the disclosure is shown it to read out and confirm.

RetentionDays.description: Days a recording is retained before it becomes eligible for erasure. Zero retains recordings indefinitely.

LegalHoldByDefault.description: Whether captured recordings begin under legal hold, which exempts them from retention-driven and subject-request erasure until released.

AllowAgentSecurePause.description: Whether an agent may pause and resume recording on their own live interaction from the agent desktop.

MaxSecurePauseSeconds.description: Longest time, in seconds, a recording may stay paused before it resumes automatically. Zero applies no automatic resume.

RequirePauseReason.description: Whether an agent must supply a reason when pausing recording.

ContentAuditTrailSettings.description: Configuration for content-specific audit trail tracking.

AllowedContentTypes.description: The content types to track in the audit trail.

ContentCulturePickerSettings.description: Configuration for the content culture picker behavior.

RedirectToHomepage.description: Whether to redirect to the homepage when switching cultures.

SetCookie.description: Whether to set a cookie to remember the selected culture.

ContentRequestCultureProviderSettings.description: Configuration for the content request culture provider.

SetCookie.description: Whether to set a cookie with the determined culture.

CopilotSettings.description: Configuration for the GitHub Copilot-style chat experience.

AuthenticationType.description: The authentication method used by the Copilot integration.

ClientId.description: The OAuth Client ID for GitHub OAuth authentication.

Scopes.description: The OAuth scopes requested during authentication.

ProviderType.description: The AI provider type (e.g., OpenAI, Azure).

ProtectedApiKey.description: The encrypted API key for the AI provider.

WireApi.description: The wire API protocol to use for communication.

DefaultModel.description: The default AI model to use for Copilot interactions.

AzureApiVersion.description: The Azure OpenAI API version when using Azure as the provider.

CustomerCheckoutSettings.description: What an order's checkout asks the buyer, under Settings › Commerce › Customers.

BillingAddress.description: Whether the checkout asks for a billing address. A checkout keeps the setting it started with.

CustomerPrivacySettings.description: How long the store keeps guests' personal data, under Settings › Commerce › Customers. Zero keeps it.

InactiveGuestMonths.description: The months after a guest customer's last activity when their personal data is erased.

GuestOrderMonths.description: The months after a guest's order was placed when its name, email, phone and billing address are removed. The lines, totals and dates stay.

DefaultAIDeploymentSettings.description: Default AI deployment assignments for each capability type.

DefaultChatDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default chat deployment.

DefaultUtilityDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default utility deployment.

DefaultEmbeddingDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default embedding deployment.

DefaultImageDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default image generation deployment.

DefaultVisionDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default vision deployment.
