AccessToken.description: The access token for authenticating API requests.

AccessTokenSecret.description: The Twitter access token secret, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'AccessTokenSecretSecretName' instead.

AccessTokenSecretSecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the Twitter access token secret. When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

CallbackPath.description: The request path where the user-agent will be returned after authentication.

SaveTokens.description: Whether to save the access and refresh tokens.

RequireTwoFactorAuthentication.description: Whether to require two-factor authentication for all users.

AllowRememberClientTwoFactorAuthenticati.description: Whether to allow users to remember their two-factor authentication on a device.

NumberOfRecoveryCodesToGenerate.description: The number of recovery codes to generate.

UseSiteTheme.description: Whether to use the site theme for the two-factor authentication pages.

UsaFtcDncRegistrySettings.description: Configuration for the USA FTC Do Not Call Registry provider.

ProtectedApiKey.description: The encrypted API key used to authenticate with the USA FTC Do Not Call Registry.

OrganizationId.description: The USA FTC organization identifier used for registry lookups.

BaseUrl.description: The base URL for the USA FTC Do Not Call Registry API.

Required.description: Whether users are required to upload an avatar.

UseDefaultStyle.description: Whether to use the default avatar styling.

VeriphonePhoneNumberVerificationSettings.description: The Veriphone phone number verification provider.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the provider is enabled and can be selected to verify phone numbers.

ProtectedApiKey.description: The API key. The Settings step stores it exactly as given, so it must already be encrypted by the destination tenant with the 'PhoneNumberVerifications.Veriphone' data protection purpose; a clear-text value cannot be read. Prefer entering it on the settings screen.

WebMcpSettings.description: Which tools the site gives to browser agents through WebMCP, and on which pages.

ExposeAllTools.description: Whether every selectable tool and tool instance is given to browser agents. When true, Tools is ignored.

Tools.description: The names of the tools and tool instances given to browser agents when ExposeAllTools is false.

EnableOnAdminPages.description: Whether admin pages offer WebMCP tools.

EnableOnFrontEndPages.description: Whether front-end pages offer WebMCP tools.

EnablePageTools.description: Whether the pages that get WebMCP also get the page tools, which read the page, list its links, open another page of the site, and read and fill its forms.

WorkflowTrimmingSettings.description: Configuration for automatic trimming of old workflow instances.

RetentionDays.description: The number of days to retain workflow instances before trimming.

Disabled.description: Whether automatic workflow trimming is disabled.

Statuses.description: The workflow statuses to include in trimming.

then.description: Creates or updates shipping zones, matched by ItemId, then by name. Only the members given are changed.

items.description: A shipping zone: the countries and regions it covers and the shipping methods it offers there.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The zone's unique name, such as Domestic. A zone without a matching ItemId is matched by this name.

Position.description: The zone's place in the list, smallest first.

Countries.description: The two-letter country codes the zone covers. Stored upper case.

Regions.description: The region codes the zone covers, such as US-CA (country code, hyphen, region). When the zone lists regions of a country, only those regions of it are covered. Stored upper case.

RestOfWorld.description: Whether the zone covers every address no other zone covers.

items.description: A way to ship the zone offers, priced by a rate provider.

MethodId.description: The method's identifier, which orders refer to. Generated when omitted.

Name.description: The name buyers see, such as Standard.

Description.description: What buyers see under the name, such as 3 to 5 business days.

ProviderName.description: The rate provider that prices the method. Other modules can register more.

Enabled.description: Whether buyers are offered the method. Defaults to true.

Position.description: The method's place in the zone's list, smallest first.

Currency.description: The three-letter currency the method's amounts are in. The method only offers rates for orders in that currency.

TaxCategoryCode.description: The tax category of the shipping charge, or null for the store's default.

ClassSurcharges.description: What each unit of a product in a shipping class (the key) adds to the rate.

Properties.description: The provider's settings, keyed by the name of their type.

PerItemAmount.description: The amount added for each item.

Basis.description: What the table looks the order up by: Weight, Subtotal or Quantity.

From.description: The value the row starts at.

Amount.description: The amount charged from that value.

Maximum.description: The most the method charges, or null for no cap.

MinimumSubtotal.description: The order subtotal from which shipping is free.

PostalCodes.description: The postal codes delivered to; a code ending in * matches every code that starts with it.

FreeFromSubtotal.description: The order subtotal from which delivery is free.

MinimumSubtotal.description: The order subtotal needed for local delivery.

Carriers.description: The carriers whose quotes are offered. Empty offers every carrier.

MaxRates.description: The most quotes offered. Defaults to 3.

MarkupPercent.description: The percentage added to each quote.

MarkupAmount.description: The amount added to each quote.

FallbackAmount.description: The amount charged when no carrier quotes, or null to offer nothing.

Methods.description: The shipping methods the zone offers. When given, the list replaces the stored one.

Zones.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

Hint.description: Short help text shown to editors.

Usage.description: Example usage snippet shown to editors.

Categories.description: Editor categories assigned to the shortcode template.

ShortcodeTemplates.description: A dictionary keyed by shortcode name.

$type.description: The polymorphic sitemap type discriminator. Use 'OrchardCore.Sitemaps.Models.Sitemap, OrchardCore.Sitemaps.Abstractions' for a standard sitemap or 'OrchardCore.Sitemaps.Models.SitemapIndex, OrchardCore.Sitemaps' for a sitemap index.

SitemapId.description: A stable unique identifier for the sitemap. When omitted, one is generated when the recipe runs.

Name.description: The sitemap name.

Enabled.description: Whether the sitemap is included in routing. Defaults to true.

Path.description: The public path the sitemap is served from, for example sitemap.xml.

$type.description: The polymorphic sitemap source type discriminator, for example OrchardCore.Sitemaps.Models.ContentTypesSitemapSource, OrchardCore.Sitemaps.Abstractions. Required so the source deserializes correctly.

Id.description: A stable unique identifier for the source. When omitted, one is generated when the recipe runs.

items.description: A source that contributes entries to the sitemap.

$type.description: Content Types source. Adds content items to the sitemap, either every indexable content type or a selected list. Fixed '$type' for the 'ContentTypesSitemapSource' source.

IndexAll.description: When true, every indexable content type is added to the sitemap. When false, only the content types listed in 'ContentTypes' are added.

LimitItems.description: When true, the sitemap is limited to a single content type described by 'LimitedContentType'.

ChangeFrequency.description: The default change frequency reported for the source's entries. Accepted values: Daily, Hourly, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, Always, Never.

Priority.description: The default priority reported for the source's entries, from 0 to 10, where 10 maps to the highest sitemap priority of 1.0.

ContentTypeName.description: The technical name of the content type to add.

ChangeFrequency.description: The change frequency reported for this content type's entries. Accepted values: Daily, Hourly, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, Always, Never.

Priority.description: The priority reported for this content type's entries, from 0 to 10.

items.description: A content type entry contributed to the sitemap.

ContentTypes.description: The content types to add when 'IndexAll' is false.

ContentTypeName.description: The technical name of the single content type indexed when 'LimitItems' is true.

ChangeFrequency.description: The change frequency reported for the limited content type's entries. Accepted values: Daily, Hourly, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, Always, Never.

Priority.description: The priority reported for the limited content type's entries, from 0 to 10.

Skip.description: The number of content items to skip before adding entries.

Take.description: The maximum number of content items to add. A sitemap file supports up to 50,000 entries.

LimitedContentType.description: The single content type indexed when 'LimitItems' is true.

$type.description: Custom Path source. Adds a single custom URL to the sitemap. Fixed '$type' for the 'CustomPathSitemapSource' source.

Path.description: The custom URL added to the sitemap.

LastUpdate.description: The last update date reported for the URL, as an ISO 8601 date-time. The system updates this value automatically.

ChangeFrequency.description: The change frequency reported for the URL. Accepted values: Daily, Hourly, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, Always, Never.

Priority.description: The priority reported for the URL, from 0 to 10, where 10 maps to the highest sitemap priority of 1.0.

$type.description: Sitemap Index source. References other sitemaps by their identifier to build a sitemap index. Fixed '$type' for the 'SitemapIndexSource' source.

ContainedSitemapIds.description: The identifiers of the sitemaps contained in this index. An empty list contains every sitemap.

SitemapSources.description: The sources that contribute entries to the sitemap.

items.description: A sitemap or sitemap index to create or update.

data.description: Sitemaps and sitemap indexes to create or update.

itemId.description: The certification id; omit to match by name.

validityMonths.description: How many months a certificate stays valid; null when it never expires.

requiresDocument.description: Whether a copy of the certificate is needed before it counts.

reminderDays.description: Days before expiry that a reminder is raised.

enabled.description: Whether the certification can be recorded and required by skills.

Certifications.description: The certifications to create, or update by id or name.

itemId.description: The skill id; omit to match by name.

category.description: The group the skill is listed under.

requiredCertificationId.description: The certification the skill requires, by id.

RequiredCertificationName.description: The certification the skill requires, by name; wins over the id.

enabled.description: Whether the skill can be assigned and used for matching.

Skills.description: The skills to create, or update by id or name.

subjectKind.description: Who holds the skill: User (the default) or Worker for a workforce worker. Other modules may register more kinds.

subjectId.description: The user id or the worker id.

skillName.description: The skill, by name, when the id isn't known.

effectiveFrom.description: The first day the skill counts.

effectiveTo.description: The last day the skill counts.

Assignments.description: The skills people hold. Each one is added, or its proficiency and dates changed.

itemId.description: The record id; omit for a new record.

subjectKind.description: Who holds the certificate: User (the default) or Worker for a workforce worker.

subjectId.description: The user id or the worker id.

subjectName.description: The holder's name, shown in lists.

certificationName.description: The certification, by name; wins over the id.

expiresOn.description: The last day it is valid.

documentPath.description: The media library path of a copy of the certificate.

status.description: Whether the certificate is waiting for a check, valid, expired or revoked.

CertificationRecords.description: The certificates people hold, created or updated by id.

items.description: A stock count. It names the product by 'Sku', or by 'ContentItemId' and, for a variant, 'VariantId'.

Sku.description: The SKU of the product or variant. Used when the ids match nothing, so it matches on any site.

ContentItemId.description: The content item id of the product. A product imported by an earlier step of the same recipe is synced before it is counted.

VariantId.description: The id of the product's variant, when the count is for a variant.

OnHand.description: The counted quantity on hand, a whole number of zero or more.

Items.description: The stock counts to apply.

then.description: Creates or updates the store's own stock locations. A location keeps the id it is given, such as default; one without an id is matched by its name.

items.description: A stock location the store keeps units at.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The location's name, such as Main warehouse.

Address.description: The location's address, as one line of text.

Position.description: The location's place in the list: orders take units from the first locations first.

OwnerKind.description: Leave empty. A location owned by another record, such as an asset's, belongs to that record and is skipped.

Locations.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

then.description: Creates or updates customers' store credit, matched by ItemId, then by customer and currency.

items.description: A customer's store credit in one currency.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

CustomerId.description: The id of the customer who holds the credit. Import the customers first.

Currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of the credit.

Activity.description: The changes to the balance, oldest first.

Accounts.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

Settings.description: Stripe settings. A member the step carries replaces the stored one.

IsLive.description: Whether the live Stripe keys are used. When false, the test keys are used.

LivePublishableKey.description: The live publishable key. It must start with 'pk_live_', or the step fails and nothing is stored.

LivePrivateSecret.description: The live secret key. It must start with 'sk_live_', or the step fails and nothing is stored. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

LiveWebhookSecret.description: The live webhook signing secret. It must start with 'whsec_', or the step fails and nothing is stored. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

TestPublishableKey.description: The test publishable key. It must start with 'pk_test_', or the step fails and nothing is stored.

TestPrivateSecret.description: The test secret key. It must start with 'sk_test_', or the step fails and nothing is stored. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

TestWebhookSecret.description: The test webhook signing secret. It must start with 'whsec_', or the step fails and nothing is stored. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

ItemId.description: The stable identifier of the category. Preserved across environments.

Name.description: The display name of the category.

Code.description: The unique code of the category (for example 'Electronics').

ParentCode.description: The code of the parent category, forming a hierarchy.

ExternalCodes.description: Provider-specific tax codes keyed by provider name.

TaxCategories.description: The tax categories to create or update.

ItemId.description: The stable identifier of the jurisdiction. Preserved across environments.

Name.description: The display name of the jurisdiction.

Level.description: The administrative level of the jurisdiction.

Country.description: The ISO country code the jurisdiction belongs to.

Region.description: The state, province, or region code the jurisdiction belongs to.

County.description: The county the jurisdiction belongs to.

City.description: The city the jurisdiction belongs to.

PostalCode.description: The postal code the jurisdiction covers.

ParentId.description: The identifier of the parent jurisdiction, forming a hierarchy.

EffectiveFromUtc.description: The UTC date the jurisdiction stops being effective.

EffectiveToUtc.description: The UTC date the jurisdiction stops being effective.

TaxJurisdictions.description: The tax jurisdictions to create or update.

ItemId.description: The stable identifier of the rule. Preserved across environments.

Name.description: The display name of the rule.

Version.description: Ignored on import: each site stamps its own version, incremented on every change.

Enabled.description: Whether the rule is enabled.

Priority.description: The evaluation priority. Lower values are evaluated first.

TaxType.description: The type of tax the rule produces (for example 'SalesTax').

TaxName.description: The human readable name of the tax the rule produces.

TaxCode.description: The code of the tax the rule produces.

JurisdictionId.description: The identifier of the jurisdiction the rule belongs to.

CategoryCode.description: The tax category code the rule applies to. Omit to match every category.

CustomerType.description: The customer classification the rule applies to. Omit to match every customer type.

Source.description: The calculation method used by the rule (for example 'Percentage').

Rate.description: The exclusive maximum taxable amount the rule applies to.

FixedAmount.description: The exclusive maximum taxable amount the rule applies to.

TaxTableId.description: The identifier of the tax table the rule uses, when the method is table based.

IncludedInPrice.description: Whether the produced tax is included in the item price.

IsCompound.description: Whether the produced tax is compound (calculated on top of other taxes).

ReverseCharge.description: Whether the recipient accounts for the tax (reverse charge). Produces a zero-amount reverse-charge line when the customer matches.

AppliesToShipping.description: Whether the rule applies to shipping charges.

MinimumAmount.description: The exclusive maximum taxable amount the rule applies to.

MaximumAmount.description: The exclusive maximum taxable amount the rule applies to.

ThresholdBasis.description: What the minimum and maximum amounts are compared with: each item, or the whole order.

EffectiveFromUtc.description: The UTC date the rule stops being effective.

EffectiveToUtc.description: The UTC date the rule stops being effective.

TaxRules.description: The tax rules to create or update.

ItemId.description: The stable identifier of the tax table. Preserved across environments.

Name.description: The name of the tax table, referenced by table-based tax rules.

Version.description: Ignored on import: each site stamps its own version, incremented on every change.

EffectiveFromUtc.description: The UTC date the tax table stops being effective.

EffectiveToUtc.description: The UTC date the tax table stops being effective.

Minimum.description: The inclusive lower bound the row applies to.

Maximum.description: The exclusive upper bound the row applies to. Omit for no upper bound.

Rate.description: The rate applied within the row, expressed as a fraction (for example 0.2 for 20%).

FixedAmount.description: A fixed amount applied within the row.

BaseAmount.description: A base amount added before the rate is applied, used by tiered schedules.

Rows.description: The rows that make up the tax table.

TaxTables.description: The tax tables to create or update.

ItemId.description: The stable identifier of the tax type. Preserved across environments.

Name.description: The name of the tax type (for example 'SalesTax' or 'VAT'). Stored on tax lines.

Description.description: An optional description of the tax type.

TaxTypes.description: The tax types to create or update.

itemId.description: The team id; omit to match by name.

kind.description: The level of the team in the organization chart. Team when omitted.

parentName.description: The name of the team it belongs to, which may be listed after it.

parentId.description: The id of the team it belongs to.

linkedRoleName.description: A role whose members are treated as part of the team.

enabled.description: Whether the team is in use.

Teams.description: The teams to create, or update by id or name, in any order.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the extension. When it matches a stored extension, that extension is updated. Otherwise a new extension is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Catalog name of the extension used for admin display and search. When empty, it is built from the number and the display name.

Number.description: The dialed extension number, for example '1001'. It must be unique within the tenant.

UserName.description: User name of the user the extension rings. It is how the user is found on import, because user identifiers differ between environments; an entry whose user does not exist is not imported.

UserId.description: Identifier of the user the extension rings. Used to find the user only when 'UserName' is empty, and replaced on import by the identifier of the user that was found.

DisplayName.description: Name shown to a colleague who calls the extension. When empty, the user name is used.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the extension, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

Extensions.description: The internal extensions to create or update.

Settings.description: Telnyx voice provider settings. Telnyx authenticates every REST call with one tenant API key.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the Telnyx provider is enabled.

ApiKey.description: Telnyx API key (v2), presented as a bearer token on every REST call. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

ConnectionId.description: Identifier of the Telnyx Call Control (Voice API) application used to place and control calls. It is provisioned by the Connect action and belongs to one Telnyx account.

SipConnectionId.description: Optional Telnyx Credential (SIP) connection browser credentials are issued against. When empty, 'ConnectionId' is used.

OutboundVoiceProfileId.description: Optional outbound voice profile applied to outbound calls when the connection does not bind one.

CredentialLifetimeMinutes.description: Browser SIP credential lifetime, in minutes.

DefaultOutboundCallerId.description: Default E.164 caller identifier presented on outbound calls when no other caller identifier applies.

WebhookPublicKey.description: Telnyx webhook Ed25519 public key (base64) used to verify inbound webhook signatures. Inbound webhooks are rejected while it is empty. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

ApiBaseUrl.description: Optional override of the Telnyx REST API base address. Empty uses https://api.telnyx.com/v2/.

SipWebSocketUrl.description: SIP-over-WebSocket signaling URL browser soft phones register against. Empty uses wss://sip.telnyx.com:7443.

SipDomain.description: SIP domain browser credentials register under. Empty uses sip.telnyx.com.

WebRtcCodecs.description: Comma- or space-separated preferred WebRTC audio codecs advertised to the browser.

WebRtcRegion.description: Telnyx signaling region browser soft phones register on. Empty lets Telnyx geo-routing choose.

IceUrls.description: Comma- or space-separated STUN/TURN URLs advertised to the browser. Empty advertises a default Telnyx STUN server.

TurnUsername.description: Optional TURN user name advertised alongside 'IceUrls'.

TurnCredential.description: Optional TURN credential advertised alongside 'IceUrls'. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

IceTransportPolicy.description: ICE transport policy advertised to the browser, for example 'all' or 'relay'.

EchoTestDestination.description: Optional echo destination (a number or SIP URI that echoes audio back) used by the audio test and the health canary.

OrphanedCallHandling.description: What to do about a call the connection has up that the platform has no record of: record it and leave it connected, or tell the caller and hang up.

AnsweringMachineDetection.description: How an automated call asks the provider whether a person or a machine answered it.

NoiseSuppressionEngine.description: The Telnyx noise suppression engine started on an agent's leg once it is connected, or 'Off'.

NoiseSuppressionAgentVoice.description: Whether noise suppression cleans the agent's voice, which is what the caller hears.

NoiseSuppressionCallerVoice.description: Whether noise suppression cleans the caller's voice, which is what the agent hears.

NoiseSuppressionStrength.description: How hard the noise suppression engine works on each voice it cleans. 'Balanced' (the default) removes line hiss while keeping the soft endings of words.

TtsVoice.description: Text-to-speech voice used by spoken prompts, either 'female', 'male' or a 'Provider.Model.VoiceId' name such as 'AWS.Polly.Joanna-Neural'.

TtsLanguage.description: Language spoken prompts are said in, for example 'en-US'.

Settings.description: Telnyx SMS provider settings, independent of the Telnyx voice settings.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the UI-configured Telnyx SMS provider is enabled.

ApiKey.description: Telnyx API key (v2) presented as a bearer token on the Messaging API. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

MessagingProfileId.description: Optional Telnyx messaging profile identifier used when sending.

WebhookPublicKey.description: Telnyx webhook Ed25519 public key (base64) used to verify inbound messaging webhooks. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

ApiBaseUrl.description: Optional override of the Telnyx REST API base address. Empty uses https://api.telnyx.com/v2/.

Templates.description: A dictionary keyed by template name. Each value has a Content property with Liquid markup.

items.description: Who in the parent tenant may sign in to child tenants, and with which roles there. A grant for the same user or role and child tenant is updated.

PrincipalType.description: Whether the grant is for a user or a role of the parent tenant.

Principal.description: The user's name or email, or the role's name. It must exist in the parent tenant.

ChildEntryId.description: The registry entry id of the child tenant. Leave it and ChildSlug out for every child tenant.

ChildSlug.description: The slug of the child tenant, used when its entry id isn't known on the site.

ChildRoles.description: The roles the user or role gets in the child tenant.

site.description: The theme ID to use for the front-end site.

admin.description: The theme ID to use for the admin dashboard.

items.description: A time category: what time counts toward, such as paid or billable time.

ItemId.description: The category's id. When it matches a stored category, that category is updated; otherwise it is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

factor.description: How a minute counts toward the category. Defaults to 1.

enabled.description: Whether the category is in use.

Categories.description: The time categories to create or update.

items.description: A time stage: what a person is doing, such as working or on a break.

ItemId.description: The stage's id. When it matches a stored stage, that stage is updated; otherwise it is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id so activity codes that point at it still do.

selfService.description: Whether people can switch to it themselves.

enabled.description: Whether the stage is in use.

categories.description: The names of the categories its time counts toward. When present, they replace the stage's categories; a name that doesn't match a category is reported and skipped.

items.description: A time entry. It is skipped when the person already has time in that range.

userName.description: The user name of the person; the user must exist.

stage.description: The name of the stage; it must exist or be listed in Stages.

startUtc.description: When the entry starts, in UTC.

endUtc.description: When the entry ends, in UTC.

source.description: Where the entry came from. Defaults to Import.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the map. When it matches a stored map, that map is updated. Otherwise a new map is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique friendly time zone name. A map whose ItemId matches no stored map is matched by this name, so a second run updates it.

TimeZoneId.description: IANA time zone identifier to store for this map.

items.description: A time zone map. A deployment plan also writes CreatedUtc, ModifiedUtc, OwnerId and Author; the import ignores them and stamps the importing site's own audit values.

Maps.description: The time zone maps to create, or to update when their ItemId or Name matches a stored map.

context.description: Optional translation context used to disambiguate the key.

value.description: Localized value stored for the key.

items.description: Single localization entry.

ConsumerSecret.description: Twitter/X API consumer secret. The step stores the value as given, and Orchard Core decrypts it with the tenant's Data Protection keys, so a clear value does not work. Prefer a secret: create it with the 'Secrets' step and reference it with 'ConsumerSecretSecretName' in the 'TwitterSettings' property of the 'Settings' step.

AccessToken.description: Twitter/X API access token used for authenticated requests.

AccessTokenSecret.description: Twitter/X API access token secret. The step stores the value as given, and Orchard Core decrypts it with the tenant's Data Protection keys, so a clear value does not work. Prefer a secret: create it with the 'Secrets' step and reference it with 'AccessTokenSecretSecretName' in the 'TwitterSettings' property of the 'Settings' step.

Id.description: The identifier of an existing rule to update. Leave it empty to create a new rule.

Name.description: The display name of the rewrite rule.

Source.description: The rewrite rule source provider name, such as Redirect or Rewrite. The well known members of the rule depend on this value.

Order.description: The order in which the rule is evaluated relative to the other rules. Lower values run first.

items.description: A URL rewrite rule to create or update.

Source.description: Redirect rule. Redirects the incoming request to a new URL and returns the configured redirect status code. Fixed 'Source' for the 'Redirect' rewrite rule source.

Pattern.description: The regular expression matched against the incoming request path, for example ^article/(.*)$.

SubstitutionPattern.description: The replacement URL the matched request is redirected to. It can reference capture groups from the match pattern, such as /blog/$1.

IsCaseInsensitive.description: Whether the match pattern ignores case. Adds the 'NC' Apache mod_rewrite flag when true.

QueryStringPolicy.description: How the original request query string is handled. 'Append' keeps it (QSA flag) and 'Drop' removes it (QSD flag).

RedirectType.description: The HTTP redirect status code returned. 'Found' is 302, 'MovedPermanently' is 301, 'TemporaryRedirect' is 307 and 'PermanentRedirect' is 308.

Source.description: Rewrite rule. Rewrites the incoming request to a new URL server-side without changing the address shown to the client. Fixed 'Source' for the 'Rewrite' rewrite rule source.

SkipFurtherRules.description: Whether the remaining rules are skipped once this rule matches. Adds the 'L' Apache mod_rewrite flag when true.

Rules.description: The URL rewrite rules to create or update.

Id.description: Legacy numeric user ID when importing from older exports.

PasswordHash.description: Existing password hash to import. Use only when migrating users.

EmailConfirmed.description: Whether the email address is already confirmed.

NormalizedEmail.description: Normalized email value used by the identity store.

NormalizedUserName.description: Normalized user name used by the identity store.

ResetToken.description: Optional password reset token to import.

PhoneNumberConfirmed.description: Whether the phone number is already confirmed.

IsLockoutEnabled.description: Whether the account can be locked out after failed sign-ins.

Name.description: The name of the subscription shown in the admin.

Url.description: The full https:// address the events are posted to. Addresses on the site's own network are refused, except in development.

Events.description: The names of the events posted to the address, or '*' for every event. Modules register their own events, so the suggested names are not a closed list.

IsEnabled.description: Whether events are posted to the subscription.

Secret.description: Optional signing secret in clear text, encrypted when stored. A deployment plan never exports it. When omitted on a new subscription a random secret is generated; when omitted on an update the stored one is kept.

Subscriptions.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.

WorkflowTypeId.description: A stable unique identifier for the workflow type. Importing a workflow type whose identifier exists saves the import as the next version of that workflow type, discards its draft, and lets running instances finish on the versions they started on.

VersionId.description: Ignored on import: versions belong to the site, and deployment plans do not export it.

Name.description: Workflow type name.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the workflow type is enabled. Disabled workflow types never start.

IsSingleton.description: Whether only a single instance of this workflow type can run at a time.

LockTimeout.description: The timeout in milliseconds to acquire a lock before resuming a workflow instance of this type. Only used when 'IsSingleton' is true.

LockExpiration.description: The expiration in milliseconds of the lock acquired before resuming a workflow instance of this type. Only used when 'IsSingleton' is true.

IsSingletonPerCorrelation.description: Whether an event that starts the workflow with a correlation id, such as the id of a content item or a user, does not start a new instance while an instance with the same correlation id waits. Ignored when 'IsSingleton' is true.

DeleteFinishedWorkflows.description: Whether workflow instances are deleted once they complete.

IsActivity.description: Whether other workflows can run this one with the 'ExecuteWorkflowTask', setting its input variables and getting its output variables back. Such a workflow starts with a 'StartedByWorkflowEvent'.

BranchingMode.description: How an outcome that has several transitions is followed: only the first transition, or all of them in the order they were added, which runs several branches without a 'ForkTask'.

FaultOnScriptErrors.description: Whether a script error faults the instance at the activity that ran the script. Otherwise, the run goes on with the fallback value and the error is recorded in the journal.

RecordActivityData.description: Whether the journal records the data of each activity execution: the evaluated expressions, the outputs, the changed variables and the last result. Values can be large or sensitive.

Name.description: The name of the variable: a letter or an underscore, then letters, digits or underscores. Names are unique in a workflow type, ignoring case.

TypeName.description: The type of the variable. Values are converted to it.

DefaultValue.description: The value of the variable when an instance starts. Omit it for none.

Description.description: What the variable is for, shown in the designer.

IsInput.description: Whether the variable is an input, set by a workflow that runs this one as an activity or by a caller that starts the workflow with an input of that name.

IsOutput.description: Whether the variable is an output, returned to a workflow that runs this one as an activity.

Variables.description: The variables the workflow type declares. Activities read them with variable('name') in JavaScript or Workflow.Variables.name in Liquid, set them with the 'SetVariableTask', and write outputs to them with 'OutputBindings'.

ActivityId.description: A unique identifier for this activity within the workflow type. The recipe step never generates one, so it must be supplied. Referenced by 'Transitions[].SourceActivityId' and 'Transitions[].DestinationActivityId'.

IsStart.description: Whether this activity is a workflow start event.

Y.description: Vertical pixel position of the activity node in the designer.

MaxRetries.description: How many times the task is retried when it faults, from 0 to 10.

DelaySeconds.description: The delay before the first retry, in seconds. With 0, the task is retried at once, in the same run.

Backoff.description: How the delay grows from one retry to the next. Defaults to 'Fixed'. Accepted values: Fixed, Exponential.

OnFailure.description: What the failure does once the attempts are spent: fault the workflow, or follow the 'Failed' outcome. Defaults to 'FaultWorkflow'. Accepted values: FaultWorkflow, FollowFailedOutcome.

ActivityRetryPolicy.description: How the task is retried when it faults, and what its failure does once the attempts are spent. When 'OnFailure' is 'FollowFailedOutcome', the task gets a 'Failed' outcome.

Syntax.description: How the expression is evaluated: 'Literal' (the text is the value), 'Liquid', 'JavaScript', or another registered syntax. When omitted, the legacy 'Syntax' property of the activity decides, and JavaScript is used by default.

Condition.description: An expression evaluating to true or false. The loop iterates while it is true.

Syntax.description: The syntax of the expression: 'Literal', 'Liquid', 'JavaScript' or another registered syntax. Only the activities that let each expression choose its syntax read it; the other activities always use their own syntax.

LiquidCondition.description: Legacy: the Liquid condition, used when 'Condition' has no syntax and 'Syntax' is 'Liquid'. Supports Liquid syntax.

Syntax.description: Legacy: selects the JavaScript expression or its Liquid counterpart when the expression has no 'Syntax' of its own. Defaults to 'JavaScript'. Prefer setting 'Syntax' on the expression. Accepted values: JavaScript, Liquid.

Activities.description: Activities that belong to the workflow type. Exactly one activity should set 'IsStart' to true.

Id.description: Reserved for internal use. Exported workflow types always emit 0.

SourceActivityId.description: The 'ActivityId' of the activity the transition starts from.

SourceOutcomeName.description: The outcome produced by the source activity that triggers this transition. Valid values are listed in the description of the source activity's 'Properties' schema. Outcomes known to this tenant include: Alert started, Already Started, Anonymous, Authenticated, Callback Scheduled, Connected, Converted, Declined, Deleted, Delivered, Disabled, Done, Drew Blank, Enabled, Error, Exhausted, Failed, Failed: no user found, False, Found, Ignored, InRole, Indeterminate, Invalid, Iterate, Joined, Matched, No conversation, No rows, None, Noop, Normal, Not evaluated, Not found, Not in a conversation, Not starting, NotFound, Nothing to analyze, Nothing to remember, Passed, Published, Queued, Resolved, Retrieved, Scheduled, Skipped, Still alerting, Succeeded, Taken, True, UnhandledHttpStatus, Unpublished, Updated, Valid, Waiting In Queue.

DestinationActivityId.description: The 'ActivityId' of the activity the transition leads to.

Transitions.description: Transition objects that connect activity outcomes to the next activity.

Properties.description: Free form property bag stored on the workflow type. Exported workflow types include it as an empty object unless a module persists data there.

data.description: Workflow type definitions to create or update.

then.description: Creates or updates activity codes, teams and workers. Activity codes and teams are matched by itemId, then by name; workers by itemId, then employee number, then user. An activity code or a worker that is updated takes every member of the entry, so a member left out goes back to its default.

items.description: An activity code: a kind of time on a schedule.

itemId.description: The activity code's id. When it matches a stored activity code, that activity code is updated; otherwise the activity code is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

code.description: A short code shown on schedules.

kind.description: What kind of time it is. Defaults to Work.

isPaid.description: Whether the time is paid. Defaults to true.

countsAsWork.description: Whether the time counts toward hours rules. Defaults to true.

countsTowardCoverage.description: Whether the worker counts toward staffing during it. Defaults to true.

enabled.description: Whether the code can be scheduled. Defaults to true.

stageId.description: The id of the Time Tracker stage time clocked in this activity is kept in, when the time clock keeps time in Time Tracker.

ActivityCodes.description: The activity codes to create or update.

items.description: A team with its Workforce settings. The generic members are those of the Teams step; the Workforce settings sit beside them. The team's calendar is never imported.

itemId.description: The team's id. When it matches a stored team, that team is updated; otherwise the team is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

kind.description: What the team is in the organization.

parentName.description: The name of the team it belongs to, which may be listed after it. Wins over parentId.

parentId.description: The id of the team it belongs to.

linkedRoleName.description: A role whose members can read the team's calendar.

timeZoneId.description: The team's IANA time zone, such as America/Chicago.

enabled.description: Whether the team is in use.

leadWorkerId.description: The id of the worker who leads the crew.

openShiftClaimPolicy.description: How the team's open shifts are given out; null uses the parent team's policy.

shiftTradesNeedApproval.description: Whether a manager approves shift trades once a colleague accepts; null uses the parent team's choice.

timeOffShiftHandling.description: What happens to a worker's published shifts when their time off is approved; null uses the parent team's choice.

timeClockPolicyId.description: The id of the time clock policy the team follows.

Teams.description: The teams to create or update, in any order: a team may name a parent listed after it.

items.description: A worker profile.

itemId.description: The worker's id. When it matches a stored worker, that worker is updated; otherwise the worker is matched by employee number, then by user, and a new one keeps this id.

userId.description: The id of the user the worker signs in as.

employeeNumber.description: The employee number, unique when set.

externalId.description: The worker's id in a payroll or HR system.

employmentType.description: The kind of employment. Defaults to FullTime.

status.description: The employment status. Defaults to Active.

seniorityDate.description: The date seniority counts from, when not the hire date.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth, used by the minor labor rules.

managerWorkerId.description: The id of the worker this worker reports to.

primaryTeamId.description: The id of the worker's main team.

items.description: A team the worker belongs to.

teamName.description: The team, by name. Wins over teamId.

role.description: The worker's role in the team. Defaults to Member.

effectiveFrom.description: The first day of the membership; null for always.

effectiveTo.description: The last day of the membership; null for open-ended.

teamMemberships.description: The teams the worker belongs to.

timeZoneId.description: The worker's IANA time zone, when not the team's.

homeBase.description: Where the worker starts and ends the day.

contractedHoursPerWeek.description: The hours a week the worker is contracted for.

minHoursPerWeek.description: The fewest hours a week the worker should be scheduled.

maxHoursPerWeek.description: The most hours a week the worker may be scheduled.

maxHoursPerDay.description: The most hours a day the worker may be scheduled.

items.description: A weekly window of availability.

preference.description: Whether the worker is unavailable, available or prefers to work then. Defaults to Available.

Workers.description: The workers to create or update. Their teams must exist or be listed in Teams.

then.description: Creates or updates adherence rule sets, matched by itemId then name. A rule set that is updated takes every member of the entry.

items.description: An adherence rule set.

itemId.description: The rule set's id. When it matches a stored rule set, that rule set is updated; otherwise the rule set is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

teamNames.description: The teams the rules apply to, by name; added to teamIds. Teams named must exist.

teamIds.description: The teams the rules apply to, by id.

items.description: A rule: which agent states count as adherent during an activity.

kind.description: The kind of scheduled activity the rule is for.

activityName.description: The activity code the rule is for, by name. Wins over activityCodeId.

activityCodeId.description: The activity code the rule is for, by id; null for every code of the kind.

allowedStatuses.description: The agent states that count as adherent.

allowedReasons.description: The state reasons the agent must have; empty for any reason.

startGraceMinutes.description: How many minutes after the activity starts the agent may still be in the previous activity. Defaults to 2.

endGraceMinutes.description: How many minutes before the activity ends the agent may move to the next one. Defaults to 2.

minimumOutMinutes.description: The shortest time out of adherence that counts, in minutes. Defaults to 1.

alertAfterMinutes.description: How many minutes out of adherence raise an alert. Defaults to 5.

RuleSets.description: The adherence rule sets to create or update.

then.description: Creates or updates contact center forecasting settings: planning groups, forecast events and capacity plans, each matched by itemId then name. A record that is updated takes every member of the entry, so a member left out goes back to its default. Planning groups are imported first, so events and plans can name one of the same step.

items.description: A planning group: queues forecast and staffed together.

itemId.description: The planning group's id. When it matches a stored planning group, that planning group is updated; otherwise the planning group is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

queueNames.description: The queues it forecasts, by name; added to queueIds. Queues named must exist.

queueIds.description: The queues it forecasts, by id.

channel.description: The channel it forecasts; null for every channel of its queues.

teamName.description: The team that staffs it, by name. Wins over teamId.

teamId.description: The team that staffs it, by id.

serviceLevelPercent.description: The share of contacts to answer within serviceLevelSeconds, in percent; null to plan by average speed of answer. Defaults to 80.

serviceLevelSeconds.description: The service level time, in seconds. Defaults to 20.

averageSpeedOfAnswerSeconds.description: The average speed of answer to plan for, in seconds, when there is no service level.

maxOccupancyPercent.description: The highest share of time agents should be busy, in percent. Defaults to 85.

concurrency.description: How many contacts an agent handles at once. Defaults to 1.

patienceSeconds.description: How long contacts wait before they give up, in seconds, to plan for abandons.

shrinkagePercent.description: The share of paid time agents are not available, in percent. Defaults to 30.

historyWeeks.description: How many weeks of history the forecast reads. Defaults to 8.

PlanningGroups.description: The planning groups to create or update.

items.description: A forecast event: days whose volume differs from the usual.

itemId.description: The forecast event's id. When it matches a stored forecast event, that forecast event is updated; otherwise the forecast event is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

volumeMultiplier.description: How the usual volume is multiplied on those days, such as 0 for a closure or 1.5 for a promotion. Defaults to 1.

recursYearly.description: Whether the event comes back on the same dates every year.

planningGroupNames.description: The planning groups it affects, by name; added to planningGroupIds. Empty for every planning group.

planningGroupIds.description: The planning groups it affects, by id.

ForecastEvents.description: The forecast events to create or update.

items.description: A long-term capacity plan.

itemId.description: The capacity plan's id. When it matches a stored capacity plan, that capacity plan is updated; otherwise the capacity plan is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

planningGroupName.description: The planning group it plans for, by name. Wins over planningGroupId.

planningGroupId.description: The planning group it plans for, by id.

startDate.description: The first week of the plan; moved back to its Monday.

weeks.description: How many weeks the plan covers. Defaults to 26.

weeklyWorkloadHours.description: The weekly workload to plan for, in hours; null to use the planning group's forecast.

growthPercentPerYear.description: How much the workload grows a year, in percent.

hoursPerFte.description: The weekly hours of one full-time agent. Defaults to 37.5.

attritionPercentPerMonth.description: The share of agents who leave each month, in percent. Defaults to 2.

items.description: A class of new hires.

trainingWeeks.description: The weeks of training before they take contacts. Defaults to 4.

rampWeeks.description: The weeks until they are fully productive. Defaults to 4.

hiringClasses.description: The planned classes of new hires.

CapacityPlans.description: The capacity plans to create or update.

then.description: Creates or updates labor rule sets, matched by itemId then name. A rule set that is updated takes every member of the entry.

items.description: A labor rule set.

itemId.description: The set's id. When it matches a stored set, that set is updated; otherwise it is matched by name.

jurisdiction.description: The place or law it follows, as free text.

teamNames.description: The teams it applies to (with their sub-teams), by name; added to teamIds. A name that doesn't match a team refuses the set.

teamIds.description: The teams it applies to, by id.

workerIds.description: The workers it applies to, by id.

employmentTypes.description: The employment types it applies to; empty for all.

enabled.description: Whether the set is in use. Defaults to true.

items.description: A rule of the set.

id.description: The rule's id within the set; one is made when omitted.

ruleKey.description: The rule's key. These are the built-in rules; other modules add their own.

enforcement.description: What happens when a schedule breaks the rule. Defaults to Warn.

parameters.description: The rule's parameters by name, written invariantly as strings, such as { "Hours": "10" }.

RuleSets.description: The labor rule sets to create or update.

then.description: Creates or updates shift templates and rotations, matched by itemId then name, and coverage requirements, matched by itemId then by team and name. A template or rotation that is updated takes every member of the entry, so a member left out goes back to its default. Teams, activities, templates and skills named here must exist.

items.description: A shift template.

itemId.description: The template's id. When it matches a stored template, that template is updated; otherwise the template is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

lengthMinutes.description: The shift length in minutes. Defaults to 480.

items.description: A part of the shift spent on another activity, such as a break.

activityName.description: The activity code, by name. Wins over activityCodeId.

offsetMinutes.description: Minutes from the start of the shift.

segments.description: The breaks and other activities within the shift.

teamNames.description: The teams that use the template, by name; added to teamIds.

teamIds.description: The teams that use the template, by id; empty for every team.

requiredSkillIds.description: The ids of the skills a worker needs for the shift.

enabled.description: Whether the template can be used. Defaults to true.

Templates.description: The shift templates to create or update.

items.description: A rotation: a repeating pattern of shifts.

itemId.description: The rotation's id. When it matches a stored rotation, that rotation is updated; otherwise the rotation is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

teamName.description: The team, by name. Wins over teamId.

weekCount.description: How many weeks the rotation lasts before it repeats. Defaults to 1.

items.description: A day of the rotation that has a shift.

week.description: The week of the rotation, from 1.

templateName.description: The shift template, by name. Wins over templateId.

items.description: A worker on the rotation.

startDate.description: The day the worker starts week 1 of the rotation.

enabled.description: Whether the rotation is in use. Defaults to true.

Patterns.description: The rotations to create or update. Templates are imported first, so a rotation can name a template of the same step.

items.description: A coverage requirement: the staffing a team needs.

itemId.description: The requirement's id. When it matches a stored requirement, that requirement is updated; otherwise it is matched by team and name.

name.description: The requirement name, unique within the team.

teamName.description: The team, by name. Wins over teamId.

skillName.description: The skill the workers need, by name. Wins over skillId.

skillId.description: The skill the workers need, by id; null for any worker.

source.description: Where the numbers come from. Defaults to Manual.

items.description: How many workers are needed in a window.

day.description: The day of the week it applies to; null when date is set.

date.description: The date it applies to, for a one-off; null for every week.

maximum.description: The most workers wanted; null for no limit.

effectiveFrom.description: The first day it applies; null for always.

effectiveTo.description: The last day it applies; null for open-ended.

CoverageRequirements.description: The coverage requirements to create or update.

then.description: Creates or updates the time clock settings: pay periods, policies and kiosks matched by itemId then name, and pay codes matched by itemId then code. Pay periods, pay codes and policies that are updated take every member of the entry, so a member left out goes back to its default.

items.description: A pay period calendar.

itemId.description: The pay period calendar's id. When it matches a stored pay period calendar, that pay period calendar is updated; otherwise the pay period calendar is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

frequency.description: How often a pay period starts. Defaults to Biweekly.

anchorDate.description: The first day of any one pay period, which the others count from.

weekStart.description: The first day of the week, for weekly overtime. Defaults to Sunday.

enabled.description: Whether the calendar is in use. Defaults to true.

PayPeriods.description: The pay period calendars to create or update.

items.description: A pay code hours are paid under.

itemId.description: The pay code's id. When it matches a stored pay code, that pay code is updated; otherwise it is matched by code, and a new one keeps this id.

kind.description: What the hours are. Defaults to Regular.

multiplier.description: The pay rate multiplier, such as 1.5 for overtime. Defaults to 1.

premiumPerHour.description: For a shift differential: the amount added per hour.

windowStart.description: For a shift differential: when the window starts.

windowEnd.description: For a shift differential: when the window ends.

weekdays.description: For a shift differential: the days it applies; empty for every day.

exportCode.description: The code written in the payroll export, when not the code.

enabled.description: Whether the pay code is in use. Defaults to true.

PayCodes.description: The pay codes to create or update.

items.description: A time clock policy: how punches become paid hours.

itemId.description: The policy's id. When it matches a stored policy, that policy is updated; otherwise the policy is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

payPeriodsName.description: The pay period calendar, by name. Wins over payPeriodCalendarId.

payPeriodCalendarId.description: The pay period calendar, by id.

teamNames.description: The teams that follow the policy, by name; each team's time clock policy is set to it.

roundingMinutes.description: The minutes punches are rounded to; 0 for none.

roundingDirection.description: How punches are rounded. Defaults to Nearest.

earlyGraceMinutes.description: The minutes before the shift a punch-in counts as on time. Defaults to 5.

lateGraceMinutes.description: The minutes after the shift starts a punch-in counts as on time. Defaults to 5.

blockEarlyPunchInMinutes.description: Refuses a punch-in more than these minutes before the shift; null to allow it.

autoMealAfterHours.description: Takes a meal off a day longer than these hours that has none; null for never.

autoMealMinutes.description: The length of that meal in minutes. Defaults to 30.

longMealMinutes.description: A meal longer than these minutes is an exception; null for never.

allowedSources.description: Where workers may punch from; empty for anywhere. A manager can always punch for a worker.

requireGeofence.description: Whether a mobile punch must be near the team's location.

geofenceRadiusMeters.description: How near, in meters. Defaults to 200.

missedPunchHandling.description: What happens to a shift with no punch-out. Defaults to Flag.

dailyOvertimeHours.description: Hours a day after which time is overtime; null for none.

dailyDoubleTimeHours.description: Hours a day after which time is double time; null for none.

weeklyOvertimeHours.description: Hours a week after which time is overtime; null for none. Defaults to 40.

seventhDayOvertime.description: Whether the seventh day in a row worked is overtime.

items.description: The attendance points an exception adds.

attendancePoints.description: The points each kind of exception adds.

pointsWindowDays.description: The days points count for. Defaults to 365.

pointsThreshold.description: The points that raise the threshold event; null for none.

enabled.description: Whether the policy is in use. Defaults to true.

Policies.description: The time clock policies to create or update. Pay periods are imported first, so a policy can name one of the same step.

items.description: A shared device workers punch on.

itemId.description: The kiosk's id. When it matches a stored kiosk, that kiosk is updated; otherwise the kiosk is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

teamName.description: The team whose workers punch on it, by name; null for every team.

enabled.description: Whether the kiosk accepts punches. Defaults to true.

Kiosks.description: The time clock kiosks to create or update. Only the configuration is imported: a kiosk's token is never exported or imported, so issue a new address on the kiosk's page.

PayrollCsv.description: The payroll CSV file layout. When present, its columns replace the stored ones.

items.description: A column of the payroll CSV file.

header.description: The column header. A column without one is dropped.

then.description: Creates or updates time-off types, policies, allotments and blackout periods, each matched by itemId then name. A record that is updated takes every member of the entry, so a member left out goes back to its default. Types are imported first, so the other records can name a type of the same step; teams named must exist.

items.description: A time-off type, such as vacation or sick leave.

itemId.description: The type's id. When it matches a stored type, that type is updated; otherwise the type is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

unit.description: Whether balances are kept in hours or days. Defaults to Hours.

hoursPerDay.description: The hours a day of time off counts as. Defaults to 8.

isPaid.description: Whether the time off is paid. Defaults to true.

requiresBalance.description: Whether a request needs enough balance. Defaults to true.

allowPartialDay.description: Whether part of a day can be asked for. Defaults to true.

requiresReason.description: Whether a request needs a reason.

countsAgainstAllotment.description: Whether the time off takes a place in the team's allotment. Defaults to true.

payCode.description: The pay code the time off is paid under.

visibleToWorkers.description: Whether workers can ask for it themselves. Defaults to true.

enabled.description: Whether the type can be used. Defaults to true.

stageId.description: The id of the Time Tracker stage approved time off of this type is kept in, when Time Tracker is on.

Types.description: The time-off types to create or update.

items.description: An accrual policy: how a balance of a type grows.

itemId.description: The policy's id. When it matches a stored policy, that policy is updated; otherwise the policy is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

typeName.description: The time-off type, by name. Wins over typeId.

accrualMethod.description: How the balance grows. Defaults to PerPeriod.

frequency.description: How often a per-period accrual is added. Defaults to Monthly.

anchorDate.description: A date the accrual periods count from.

rate.description: The amount added each period, each hour worked, or each year, in the type's unit.

items.description: A rate that applies from a length of service.

fromMonths.description: The months of service the rate starts at.

tenureTiers.description: Higher rates after a length of service.

waitingPeriodDays.description: The days after hire before the balance grows.

maxBalance.description: The largest balance; null for no cap.

carryoverMax.description: The most that carries over at the reset; null for all of it.

resetMonth.description: The month the balance resets, 1 to 12. Defaults to 1.

resetDay.description: The day of the month the balance resets. Defaults to 1.

negativeBalanceLimit.description: How far below zero the balance may go.

teamNames.description: The teams the policy applies to, by name; each is added to assignments.

items.description: Who the policy applies to.

workerId.description: A worker's id, for a policy of one worker.

assignments.description: The teams or workers the policy applies to.

enabled.description: Whether the policy is in use. Defaults to true.

Policies.description: The accrual policies to create or update.

items.description: An allotment: how many people of a team may be off each day.

itemId.description: The allotment's id. When it matches a stored allotment, that allotment is updated; otherwise the allotment is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

teamName.description: The team, by name. Wins over teamId.

typeNames.description: The time-off types it counts, by name; added to typeIds.

typeIds.description: The time-off types it counts, by id; empty for every type that counts against allotments.

weekdaySlots.description: How many people may be off on each weekday: seven numbers, Monday first.

items.description: The places on one date, instead of the weekday's.

slots.description: How many people may be off that day.

dates.description: Dates with their own number of places.

autoApprove.description: Whether a request is approved while there are places. Defaults to true.

whenFull.description: What happens to a request when the day is full. Defaults to Waitlist.

enabled.description: Whether the allotment is in use. Defaults to true.

Allotments.description: The allotments (how many people may be off a day) to create or update.

items.description: A blackout period: dates when time off can't be asked for.

itemId.description: The blackout period's id. When it matches a stored blackout period, that blackout period is updated; otherwise the blackout period is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

teamName.description: The team, by name. Wins over teamId.

teamId.description: The team, by id; null for every team.

typeNames.description: The time-off types it blocks, by name; added to typeIds.

typeIds.description: The time-off types it blocks, by id; empty for every type.

message.description: What a worker who asks is told.

enabled.description: Whether the blackout is in use. Defaults to true.

BlackoutPeriods.description: The blackout periods (when time off can't be asked for) to create or update.

then.description: Creates or updates work order checklists, service levels, sub-statuses and types, and service agreements when the agreements feature is on. Records are matched by ItemId only; an existing record takes only the members given. The sections are imported in this order, so a type can point at a checklist or service level of the same step by ItemId.

items.description: A checklist to fill in on a job, such as an inspection.

ItemId.description: The checklist's id. When it matches a stored checklist, that checklist is updated with the members given here; otherwise a new checklist is created, keeping this id when it is a valid id so other records that point at it still do.

Name.description: The checklist name.

items.description: A question on the checklist.

Id.description: The question's id within the checklist, which ShowWhen refers to.

Section.description: The section the question is in.

Choices.description: The choices of a Choice or MultiChoice question.

MinPhotos.description: How many photos a Photo question needs.

Meter.description: The asset meter a MeterReading question records.

ShowWhen.description: Shows the question only after another was answered a certain way; null for always.

QuestionId.description: The id of the question it depends on.

items.description: A service level policy: how fast work orders must be answered and resolved, by priority.

ItemId.description: The service level policy's id. When it matches a stored service level policy, that service level policy is updated with the members given here; otherwise a new service level policy is created, keeping this id when it is a valid id so other records that point at it still do.

Name.description: The policy name.

items.description: The targets of one priority.

Priority.description: The priority.

ResponseMinutes.description: The minutes to the first response; 0 for none.

ResolveMinutes.description: The minutes to resolution; 0 for none.

HoursCalendarId.description: The business hours calendar the clock runs in; null for around the clock or WeeklyHours.

WeeklyHours.description: The same opening hours every week the clock runs in; null for none.

TimeZoneId.description: The IANA time zone of the business hours.

PauseStatuses.description: The statuses the clock stops in.

WarningPercent.description: How far through a target, in percent, the warning is raised. Defaults to 80.

items.description: A finer status inside one, such as Waiting for parts inside On hold.

ItemId.description: The sub-status's id. When it matches a stored sub-status, that sub-status is updated with the members given here; otherwise a new sub-status is created, keeping this id when it is a valid id so other records that point at it still do.

Name.description: The sub-status name.

PausesSla.description: Whether the service level clock stops in it.

items.description: A kind of job, with the defaults a new work order of it takes.

ItemId.description: The work order type's id. When it matches a stored work order type, that work order type is updated with the members given here; otherwise a new work order type is created, keeping this id when it is a valid id so other records that point at it still do.

Name.description: The type name.

DefaultDurationMinutes.description: How long the job usually takes, in minutes. Defaults to 60.

items.description: A skill the job needs.

MinProficiency.description: The lowest proficiency, from 1. Defaults to 1.

RequiredCertificationIds.description: The ids of the certifications it needs.

CrewSize.description: How many people it needs. Defaults to 1.

RequiredEquipmentTypeIds.description: The ids of the asset types of equipment it needs.

ChecklistTemplateIds.description: The ids of the checklists it comes with.

items.description: A line a new work order of the type comes with.

ProductId.description: The product's content item id, for a product or service line.

StockItemId.description: The stock item's id, for a product taken from stock.

LocationId.description: The stock location the product comes from.

Billable.description: Whether the line is billed. Defaults to true.

ServiceLevelPolicyId.description: The id of its service level policy.

Currency.description: The ISO currency code its prices are in. Defaults to USD.

FixedPrice.description: The fixed price, when billed at one.

DefaultPriority.description: The priority of a new work order. Defaults to Normal.

RequiresSignature.description: Whether it can't be completed without the customer's signature.

AppointmentTypeIds.description: The ids of the Scheduling appointment types whose bookings make a work order of this type.

RequiredPhotos.description: How many photos it can't be completed without.

items.description: A service agreement: recurring visits, such as preventive maintenance, for a customer over a period.

ItemId.description: The service agreement's id. When it matches a stored service agreement, that service agreement is updated with the members given here; otherwise a new service agreement is created, keeping this id when it is a valid id so other records that point at it still do.

Name.description: The agreement name.

CustomerId.description: The customer: the Orchard Core user id.

AccountId.description: The CRM account (the company) the agreement is with.

Name.description: The contact's name.
The name of the person or place.

DependentLocality.description: The neighborhood or dependent locality, where the country uses one.

SortingCode.description: The sorting code, where the country uses one.

Phone.description: The phone number at the address.

Latitude.description: The latitude, in degrees, when geocoded.

Longitude.description: The longitude, in degrees, when geocoded.

AssetIds.description: The ids of the assets it covers.

StartDate.description: The first day it is in force, where the schedules start.

EndDate.description: The last day it is in force; null when it doesn't end.

TimeZoneId.description: The IANA time zone its days are in.

items.description: A recurring visit, such as a boiler service every six months.

Id.description: The schedule's id, part of each work order's source.

Name.description: The schedule name, such as Annual inspection.

TypeId.description: The id of the type of the work orders it makes.

Rule.description: When it repeats, as an RFC 5545 rule such as FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL=6, from the agreement's start date.

LeadDays.description: How many days ahead of a visit its work order is made. Defaults to 14.

AssetIds.description: The assets it covers; empty for every asset of the agreement.

Pricing.description: How the visits are paid for.

PricePerVisit.description: The price of a visit, when each is invoiced.

ExpiringNoticeDays.description: How many days before the end date the expiring event starts. Defaults to 30.

ExpiringNotifiedUtc.description: When the expiring event started, so it starts once.

Agreements.description: The service agreements. Read only when the service agreements feature is on; their customers, accounts and assets must be on the site too.
